cards.name: assemble-then-type-flyin
cards.summary: 空的暗底网格上，无文字的组件骨架先从四面八方飞入贴合；随后各处文字逐字从 3D 空间旋转着飞来落位，先大标题后小标注，全部落位后页面成形
cards.use: 页面/海报"自己长出来"的开场；排版类产品的能力展示；从骨架到成稿的两段式叙事
cards.energy: 中高（骨架段稀疏、文字段密集，能量单调上升到收尾）
cards.intention: 把"页面生成"拆成两个语义清楚的阶段：先立骨架（框、卡片、分隔线、 色块，全部无字），再填文字。文字用逐字 3D 旋转落位，是因为骨架段 只有平面位移——两段的运动维度必须不同，否则观众读不出"这是第二步"。

styles.label: assemble-then-type-flyin
styles.description: 空的暗底网格上，无文字的组件骨架先从四面八方飞入贴合；随后各处文字逐字从 3D 空间旋转着飞来落位，先大标题后小标注，全部落位后页面成形
styles.descriptionEn: Textless component shells fly in from every direction onto an empty dark grid, then every character arrives from 3D space with its own large rotation and settles into position.

cards.summaryEn: Textless component shells fly in from every direction onto an empty dark grid, then every character arrives from 3D space with its own large rotation and settles into position.
cards.useEn: Openings where a page or poster "builds itself"; a capability showcase for layout tools; a two-beat narrative from skeleton to finished page
cards.intentionEn: Split "page generation" into two semantically clear phases: first the skeleton (frames, cards, dividers, colour blocks — all wordless), then the text. The text lands with a per-character 3D rotation because the skeleton phase only moves in-plane — the two phases must differ in movement dimension, or the audience cannot read "this is step two".
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (sparse skeleton phase, dense text phase; energy rises monotonically to the end)

cards.name: aurora-bloom-bg-flip
cards.summary: 浅灰底从底部升起紫橙柔焦 blob，随后整个底色在约 0.36s 内压暗到近黑、blob 压成余晖；文案同步 blur-out 换句 blur-in，换句间留空档不 cross-fade
cards.use: 叙事转折点（"多年以来…→一切都变了"）；品牌片从铺垫拉到重音的那一拍；深浅色系之间的段落切换
cards.energy: 由低到高（前 2/3 是酝酿，压暗那一瞬是全片重音）
cards.intention: 把"底色反转"当成重音符号用：前 56% 让极光慢慢升起、观众适应浅底， 然后用不到 0.4s 把整个画面压到近黑——这一下比任何缩放/闪白都更像 "翻页"。文案的换句必须卡在反转之后，且中间留空档，让观众先接住画面 变化再读新句。

styles.label: aurora-bloom-bg-flip
styles.description: 浅灰底从底部升起紫橙柔焦 blob，随后整个底色在约 0.36s 内压暗到近黑、blob 压成余晖；文案同步 blur-out 换句 blur-in，换句间留空档不 cross-fade
styles.descriptionEn: A soft purple-orange aurora blob rises from the bottom of a light frame, then the whole background slams dark in under half a second while the copy blur-swaps to a new line.

cards.summaryEn: A soft purple-orange aurora blob rises from the bottom of a light frame, then the whole background slams dark in under half a second while the copy blur-swaps to a new line.
cards.useEn: Narrative turning points ("for years… → everything changed"); the beat that pulls a brand film from setup to accent; section switches between light and dark palettes
cards.intentionEn: Treat the background flip as an accent mark: for the first 56% the aurora rises slowly and the audience settles into the light ground, then in under 0.4s the whole frame is crushed to near-black — that hit reads as "a page turn" far more than any zoom or white flash. The copy swap must land after the flip, with a gap in between, so the audience absorbs the picture change before reading the new line.
cards.energyEn: Low to high (the first two thirds are buildup; the crush-to-dark instant is the film's accent)

cards.name: autolayout-gap-dial
cards.summary: 间距拨盘驱动布局——一排链接块带框选描边+缝隙间距标注，徽章数字逐格跳动、块被参数实时推开再弹簧回弹归位；"参数驱动布局"的可视化
cards.use: 设计工具/低代码产品的"改一个数、界面跟着动"卖点镜头；"用设计工具语义做包装"的品类语言
cards.duration: ~5s（150f：框选入场 + 预备回收 10f + 拉松 34f + 屏息 hold 20f + 弹簧回弹 + 落定 hold）
cards.energy: 中（工具理性型，爽点在数字与位移的锁定同步）
cards.intention: "参数改了、UI 变了"是设计工具的核心承诺，但通常拍成"点面板→切 结果"的前后对比，因果被剪掉了。本卡把因果拍成连续镜头：间距徽章 数字逐格跳，链接块**同帧**被推开，测量线实时拉长——数字就是缰绳， 布局就是马。框选描边+8 手柄+间距标注全是设计工具的母语，观众一眼 认出"这是在工具里调参数"。回程故意用欠阻尼弹簧过冲（缩到比起点 更紧再回稳），把"归位"做成一次有弹性的收尾。与 type-and-filter 分工：那是"输入内容→列表收敛"的检索因果，本卡是"拨数值→几何 重排"的参数因果。

styles.label: autolayout-gap-dial
styles.description: 间距拨盘驱动布局——一排链接块带框选描边+缝隙间距标注，徽章数字逐格跳动、块被参数实时推开再弹簧回弹归位；"参数驱动布局"的可视化
styles.descriptionEn: A gap value dial pushes a row of blocks apart in real time while badge digits tick, then everything springs back into place.

cards.summaryEn: A gap value dial pushes a row of blocks apart in real time while badge digits tick, then everything springs back into place.
cards.useEn: A selling-point shot for design tools / low-code products — "change one number and the UI follows"; category language that packages itself in design-tool semantics
cards.intentionEn: "Parameter changed, UI changed" is the core promise of design tools, but it is usually shot as a before/after of "click panel → cut to result", which cuts out the causality. This card shoots the causality as one continuous take: the gap badge digits tick, the linked blocks are pushed apart in the same frame, and the measurement line stretches in real time — the number is the reins, the layout is the horse. The selection outline, 8 handles and spacing annotations are all design-tool mother tongue; the audience recognises "this is adjusting parameters inside a tool" at a glance. The return deliberately uses an under-damped spring overshoot (squeezing tighter than the start before settling back), turning "back in place" into an elastic landing. Division of labour with type-and-filter: that one is the search causality of "type content → list narrows"; this one is the parameter causality of "dial a value → geometry re-flows".
cards.energyEn: Medium (tool-rational type; the payoff is the locked sync between digits and displacement)

cards.name: avatar-bracket-carousel
cards.summary: "Your ___ agent" 填空排版，四角对焦框钉在句中不动，头像队列在框内垂直 spring 轮换三次，入框放大清晰、出框按距离缩小淡化模糊，角色标签同步更换，切换瞬间对焦框呼吸 7%
cards.use: "一个位置，多种角色"的能力枚举；团队/身份/预设/人格类产品的核心一句话镜头
cards.energy: 中（三次等距切换构成稳定节拍器，对焦框脉冲是唯一装饰性动作）
cards.intention: "我们的 agent 能当导演、剪辑、动画师、音效师"列成四行就是一张清单。塞进一句话的一个槽位里， 它变成一个承诺加四次证明：句子不动，只有槽里的人在换。四角对焦框是这个手法的关键 ——它不参与轮换，但它把观众的眼睛钉死在那 92×92 的方框里，所以四次更换才读作 "同一个位置"而不是"四张头像飘过"。

styles.label: avatar-bracket-carousel
styles.description: "Your ___ agent" 填空排版，四角对焦框钉在句中不动，头像队列在框内垂直 spring 轮换三次，入框放大清晰、出框按距离缩小淡化模糊，角色标签同步更换，切换瞬间对焦框呼吸 7%
styles.descriptionEn: A four-corner focus bracket stays locked mid-sentence while a vertical queue of avatars springs through it three times, each one sharpening and growing as it enters the frame and shrinking, dimming and blurring as it leaves.

cards.summaryEn: A four-corner focus bracket stays locked mid-sentence while a vertical queue of avatars springs through it three times, each one sharpening and growing as it enters the frame and shrinking, dimming and blurring as it leaves.
cards.useEn: Enumerating "one slot, many roles"; a one-line core shot for team / identity / preset / persona products
cards.intentionEn: "Our agent can direct, edit, animate and sound-design" as four lines is just a list. Placed in one slot of a sentence it becomes a promise plus four proofs: the sentence never moves, only the person in the slot changes. The four corner focus brackets are the key to the trick — they do not take part in the rotation, but they nail the audience's eyes to that 92×92 box, so four swaps read as "the same slot" rather than "four avatars drifting past".
cards.energyEn: Medium (three evenly spaced swaps form a steady metronome; the focus-bracket pulse is the only decorative motion)

cards.name: basic-3d-scene
cards.summary: impress.js 式空间演示：卡片以不同位置/旋转/缩放散布 3D 空间，相机取各步姿态之逆依次飞行对齐，末步拉到 OVERVIEW 总览
cards.use: 概念/路线图/三步法的空间化讲述；替代平面 slides 的"每一步都换个空间视角"
cards.duration: 约 7.5s（225f@30fps；四站，三段飞行 28/32/32f，每站停留 ≥30f）
cards.energy: 中（每次转场有空间惊喜，停留段安静读卡）
cards.intention: 把"翻页"变成"在想法的空间里旅行"：每张卡不仅有位置还有姿态（第二站世界左转 38°、第三站整个画框侧躺 90°），相机对齐它时观众的世界也跟着转——空间变化本身成为"进入新章节"的仪式感。

styles.label: basic-3d-scene
styles.description: impress.js 式空间演示：卡片以不同位置/旋转/缩放散布 3D 空间，相机取各步姿态之逆依次飞行对齐，末步拉到 OVERVIEW 总览
styles.descriptionEn: Impress-style spatial slides: cards sit at scattered 3D poses and the camera flies to align with each one by inverting its transform, ending on a pulled-back overview where every card lights up.

cards.summaryEn: Impress-style spatial slides: cards sit at scattered 3D poses and the camera flies to align with each one by inverting its transform, ending on a pulled-back overview where every card lights up.
cards.useEn: Spatial storytelling for concepts / roadmaps / three-step flows; replacing flat slides with "every step gets a new spatial viewpoint"
cards.intentionEn: Turn "flipping pages" into "travelling through idea-space": every card has a pose as well as a position (station two turns the world 38° left, station three lays the whole frame on its side at 90°), and when the camera aligns to it the audience's world rotates too — the spatial change itself becomes the ritual of "entering a new section".
cards.energyEn: Medium (every transition has a spatial surprise; the holds are quiet card-reading)

cards.name: beat-cut-moves
cards.summary: 硬切当节拍乐器——连闪定格：三次白闪各硬切同一画面的一个裁切（全景→卡片→特写），快门余韵沉降后停在特写收束
cards.use: 高光段落把"切"本身打成鼓点；颁奖连拍式的仪式感、关键信息的加冕
cards.duration: 全程 140f ≈4.7s（活素材 30f + 三闪 + hold 70f）
cards.energy: 高
cards.intention: 库内节奏词汇一直只管"一条运动内"的速率（speed-ramp-freeze 是同一条 take 里定格再解冻）和"落定后停多久"（R 系呼吸判例），没有词管**多镜之间切点 怎么排**。本卡补这一块：硬切不做任何过渡，切点间隔本身就是乐谱—— 三次白闪、间隔渐紧（22f→18f），读作快门连拍（A）。与 R 系不 冲突：R 管落定后的停，本卡管切点排布，切串结束必须接足量 hold 把 呼吸还回去。注意这是刻意的例外——节奏偏好判例是单向"放慢"，硬切 串切得越狠，切完的 hold 要比平常更长。

styles.label: paparazzi-flash 连闪定格
styles.description: 硬切当节拍乐器——连闪定格：三次白闪各硬切同一画面的一个裁切（全景→卡片→特写），快门余韵沉降后停在特写收束
styles.use: 高光时刻仪式感：颁奖连拍、关键数字的加冕
styles.descriptionEn: Three white flashes each hard-cut to a different crop of the same subject (wide, card, digits), settling on the number.

cards.summaryEn: A three-flash freeze montage: white flashes hard-cut through different crops of the same subject and settle on the key number.
cards.useEn: A highlight passage that turns the cut itself into a drumbeat; award-show burst-shoot ceremony, the crowning of key information
cards.intentionEn: The library's rhythm vocabulary has always covered rate within a single motion (speed-ramp-freeze freezes and unfreezes inside one take) and how long to hold after landing (the R-series breathing rules) — nothing covered how to arrange the cut points between shots. This card fills that gap: hard cuts with no transition, where the spacing of the cuts is itself the score — three white flashes, intervals tightening (22f → 18f), read as a shutter burst (A). No conflict with the R series: R governs the hold after landing, this card governs the cut spacing, and after the burst the cut string must be followed by a generous hold to give the breathing back. Note this is a deliberate exception — the rhythm guideline prefers "slowing down", and the harder the hard-cut string cuts, the longer the hold afterwards must be.
cards.energyEn: High

cards.name: beat-step-list-theme-cycle
cards.summary: 三通道节拍器——深色场形容词列表逐拍上移一行，视口中央固定胶囊"接住"下一个词并换色，整场底色同拍跟换；行、色、场三通道锁死同一拍点
cards.use: "同一产品多种气质/多主题展示"段落（modern/playful/expressive 式形容词连打）；全片节奏最密的一段；音乐段对拍
cards.duration: 铺垫 30f + 每拍 18f × 拍数 + 收尾 hold；4 拍约 4.7s（demo 140f）
cards.energy: 高（0.6s 一拍三通道齐跳，密度型高能）
cards.intention: 换一次主题色是功能演示；0.6 秒换一次、连换三次、每次"选中行+胶囊色 +全场底色"三件事同帧齐跳——就成了节拍器。用最便宜的变量切换做出 全片最高的节奏密度。命门有二：一是**三通道必须锁同一拍点**，任何 一通道慢半拍，"齐跳"退化成三个各自为政的动画；二是**跳与滑的分界** ——跳变只占拍头 6f，其余 12f 完全静置，拍点要"跳"不要"滑"， 匀速滚动的列表就只是列表。

styles.label: beat-step-list-theme-cycle
styles.description: 三通道节拍器——深色场形容词列表逐拍上移一行，视口中央固定胶囊"接住"下一个词并换色，整场底色同拍跟换；行、色、场三通道锁死同一拍点
styles.descriptionEn: An adjective list steps up one row per beat while a fixed center pill catches each word and the background recolors on the same beat.

cards.summaryEn: An adjective list steps up one row per beat while a fixed center pill catches each word and the background recolors on the same beat.
cards.useEn: A "same product, many moods / many themes" passage (adjective chains in the modern / playful / expressive vein); the densest rhythm section of the film; cutting on the music
cards.intentionEn: Changing the theme colour once is a feature demo; changing it every 0.6 seconds, three times in a row, with "selected row + chip colour + global ground" all jumping in the same frame every time — that is a metronome. The highest rhythm density in the film from the cheapest variable switch. Two make-or-break points: first, the three channels must be locked to the same beat — if any channel lags half a beat, the "unison jump" degenerates into three separate animations; second, the boundary between jump and slide — the jump occupies only the 6 frames at the head of the beat and the other 12 frames are completely static: the beat must "jump", not "slide", or a constant-speed scrolling list is just a list.
cards.energyEn: High (one beat per 0.6s with all three channels jumping together; density-type energy)

cards.name: before-after-slider-scrub
cards.summary: 前后对比拉杆——"处理前/后"两版叠放，分割杆先猛甩后慢扫，杆过处新版"显影"揭出
cards.use: AI 增强/优化/重构类功能的效果对比段落（"用前 vs 用后"一镜讲清）
cards.energy: 中（快甩是打击点，慢扫是阅读期）
cards.intention: AI 图像产品发布片的标准对比语法：同一画面"处理前"（低对比灰蒙） 与"处理后"（清晰版）叠放，带圆手柄的竖分割杆先从左端猛甩到 70% （overshoot 回弹）、停一拍，再以约 1/5 的速度慢扫回来让观众看清 差异——**快甩慢扫的速度对比就是节奏**：快甩宣告"变了"， 慢扫证明"变在哪"。

styles.label: before-after-slider-scrub
styles.description: 前后对比拉杆——"处理前/后"两版叠放，分割杆先猛甩后慢扫，杆过处新版"显影"揭出
styles.descriptionEn: Before and after views share one frame while a fast-then-slow slider reveals the processed result.

cards.summaryEn: Before and after views share one frame while a fast-then-slow slider reveals the processed result.
cards.useEn: Effect-comparison passages for AI enhancement / optimisation / refactoring features ("before vs after" in a single shot)
cards.intentionEn: The standard comparison grammar of AI image product launch films: one frame with "before" (flat, grey, hazy) and "after" (clean) stacked, a vertical splitter with a round handle whips from the left edge to 70% (with overshoot rebound), holds a beat, then sweeps back at roughly a fifth of the speed so the audience can see the difference — the fast-whip / slow-sweep speed contrast is the rhythm: the whip announces "it changed", the slow sweep proves "what changed".
cards.energyEn: Medium (the fast whip is the hit, the slow sweep is the reading period)

cards.name: bezier-source-converge-merge
cards.summary: 左侧四个来源节点各有一条细贝塞尔曲线连向右侧同一汇聚点，曲线先错峰由左向右 draw-on，节点沿自己的曲线滑向汇聚点并三段式加速缩小到消失，强调色数据包全程沿路径滑行，吞并完成后曲线从左端反向擦除只留品牌标志（demo：白瓷圆片托 Motion Studio Motion Studio标志）
cards.use: "多源整合/统一接入/数据汇聚"的核心机制镜头；集成、聚合、单一入口类产品的说明段落
cards.energy: 中（长镜慢速推进，靠数据包滑行维持活性；吞并瞬间是唯一小高点）
cards.intention: "我们把四个来源统一了"是一句抽象话。这个动效把它变成可看的物理过程：先建立四条独立 的通路（draw-on 是"连上了"），再让四个来源真的顺着通路走进同一个点并被吸进去（缩小 到 0 是"被吞并"），最后擦掉通路只留品牌标志（"现在只有一个"）。三段叙事各自有明确的 起止，观众不需要旁白就能读出因果。

styles.label: bezier-source-converge-merge
styles.description: 左侧四个来源节点各有一条细贝塞尔曲线连向右侧同一汇聚点，曲线先错峰由左向右 draw-on，节点沿自己的曲线滑向汇聚点并三段式加速缩小到消失，强调色数据包全程沿路径滑行，吞并完成后曲线从左端反向擦除只留品牌标志（demo：白瓷圆片托 Motion Studio Motion Studio标志）
styles.descriptionEn: Four source nodes each draw a thin bezier curve toward one convergence point, then slide along their own curve and shrink as if swallowed, while accent data packets glide the paths and the curves erase backward.

cards.summaryEn: Four source nodes each draw a thin bezier curve toward one convergence point, then slide along their own curve and shrink as if swallowed, while accent data packets glide the paths and the curves erase backward.
cards.useEn: A core-mechanism shot for "multi-source consolidation / unified access / data convergence"; explanatory passages for integration, aggregation and single-entry products
cards.intentionEn: "We unified four sources" is an abstract sentence. This motion turns it into a visible physical process: first four independent paths are established (the draw-on means "connected"), then the four sources actually travel down their paths into one point and are sucked in (shrinking to 0 means "absorbed"), and finally the paths are wiped away leaving only the brand mark ("now there is just one"). All three beats have clear starts and ends; the audience reads the causality without narration.
cards.energyEn: Medium (a long, slow push kept alive by the sliding data packets; the absorb instant is the only small peak)

cards.name: blur-slide
cards.summary: 标题逐词入场，y 0.38em→0 + blur 18→0 + opacity 0→1 三通道走同一条 ease-out 同步收敛，词间隔约 4f；副标题在标题收完前就错峰跟进
cards.use: 几乎所有标题/副标题成对出现的场合；产品页首屏文案、章节小标题；需要"专业但不抢戏"的默认文字 reveal
cards.energy: 低（一次性收敛，无峰值无循环）
cards.intention: 这是文字 reveal 的**默认解**——没有奇观、没有机械感，只是把词一个个 柔和地放到位。它的专业感全来自一件事：y、blur、opacity 三个通道共用 同一个进度 `p`、同一条缓动，所以词是"从虚焦里浮出来"而不是"滑进来 顺便淡一下"。当一支片里已经有别的重手法（乱码/滚轮），标题就该 用这一卡，让位给主角。

styles.label: blur-slide
styles.description: 标题逐词入场，y 0.38em→0 + blur 18→0 + opacity 0→1 三通道走同一条 ease-out 同步收敛，词间隔约 4f；副标题在标题收完前就错峰跟进
styles.descriptionEn: Title words rise into place one after another as vertical offset, blur, and opacity converge on a single shared ease, with the subtitle following before the title settles.

cards.summaryEn: Title words rise into place one after another as vertical offset, blur, and opacity converge on a single shared ease, with the subtitle following before the title settles.
cards.useEn: Almost any title/subtitle pairing; hero-page copy, section sub-heads; the default text reveal when you need "professional but not showy"
cards.intentionEn: This is the default answer for text reveals — no spectacle, no mechanical feel, just placing the words softly into position one by one. Its professionalism comes from one thing: the y, blur and opacity channels share a single progress value `p` and a single easing, so the words "float out of soft focus" rather than "slide in and fade along the way". When a film already has a heavier trick elsewhere (glitch / roller), titles should use this card and defer to the star.
cards.energyEn: Low (one-shot convergence; no peak, no loop)

cards.name: bottom-push-stack-wipe
cards.summary: 底边上推换章——新场景连底色整屏从底边向上推入，把旧场景物理顶出画外，连推数章各配一种饱和底色，内容钉死在各自色底坐标系里随底色走
cards.use: 多章节产品片的换章骨架（每章一个卖点一种底色）；需要"翻页节奏感"贯穿全片的段落切换
cards.duration: demo 三连推 170f（~5.7s）；单次推入 26f + 章内 hold ~1.2s
cards.energy: 中
cards.intention: wipe-transitions 是一条边界扫过、新旧页都不动；page-turn 是旧页对开门 裂开滑出。本卡是第三种物性：**新章把旧章顶出去**——两屏刚性接触、同速 同向位移，像自动售货机压栈。命门是"连底色整屏走"：底色+窗口卡+装饰 条焊成一块整料从底边推入，观众读到"换了个世界"而不是"换了张卡"。 重 ease-out（快进慢停）给推入一个"哐"的落位感；上缘 40px 接缝阴影 是两屏物理接触的证据。连推三章且底色饱和度拉满，换章本身就成了全片 的节拍器——slack 原片全片就靠这一招做骨架。

styles.label: bottom-push-stack-wipe
styles.description: 底边上推换章——新场景连底色整屏从底边向上推入，把旧场景物理顶出画外，连推数章各配一种饱和底色，内容钉死在各自色底坐标系里随底色走
styles.descriptionEn: Each new scene pushes up from the bottom edge with its own saturated background color, physically shoving the old scene out of frame.

cards.summaryEn: Each new scene pushes up from the bottom edge with its own saturated background color, physically shoving the old scene out of frame.
cards.useEn: The chapter-switching skeleton for multi-chapter product films (one selling point and one ground colour per chapter); section transitions that need a "page-flip rhythm" throughout
cards.intentionEn: wipe-transitions sweeps one boundary with both pages still; page-turn splits the old page like double doors sliding away. This card is a third physicality: the new section pushes the old one out — two screens in rigid contact, same speed, same direction, like a vending machine dispensing stack. The make-or-break is "the whole screen travels with its ground": ground + window card + decorative strip are welded into one billet pushed in from the bottom edge, so the audience reads "the world changed" rather than "the card changed". A heavy ease-out (fast in, slow stop) gives the push a "clunk" of arrival; the 40px seam shadow at the top edge is the evidence of physical contact between the two screens. Push three sections in a row with saturated grounds and the chapter switch itself becomes the film's metronome — the original slack film builds its whole skeleton on this one move.
cards.energyEn: Medium

cards.name: brace-expand
cards.summary: 一对紧贴的小花括号先在正中出现，随即带一次过冲向左右弹开并放大到标题级，文字 clip 宽度严格绑括号内缘、像被拉开幕布般从中间揭示，落定后字距再细微松弛
cards.use: 开发者/技术产品的标题字卡；章节开场；需要"一个符号完成揭示"的极简一拍
cards.duration: 约 4s（120f@30fps：光标 0–6f → 6f 小括号硬切 → 14f 弹开 → 40–64f 字距松弛 → 副标 → hold）
cards.energy: 中（单次过冲是唯一峰值，其余静止）
cards.intention: 标题揭示的手法里，本卡最省：不做遮罩条、不做逐字、不做位移——只让 一对括号往两边走，文字被"括出来"。它天生带代码语感（`{}` 是花括号）， 所以在技术产品语境里读作"这就是内容本体"。命门是 clip 宽度**必须严格 绑括号位置**：一旦文字自己淡入或自己擦入，括号就退化成装饰，幕布感全失。

styles.label: brace-expand
styles.description: 一对紧贴的小花括号先在正中出现，随即带一次过冲向左右弹开并放大到标题级，文字 clip 宽度严格绑括号内缘、像被拉开幕布般从中间揭示，落定后字距再细微松弛
styles.descriptionEn: A tight pair of braces appears at center, then springs apart and scales up to title size, revealing the text through a clip width bound strictly to the brace gap.

cards.summaryEn: A tight pair of braces appears at center, then springs apart and scales up to title size, revealing the text through a clip width bound strictly to the brace gap.
cards.useEn: Title cards for developer / technical products; section openers; the minimalist beat where "one symbol completes the reveal"
cards.intentionEn: Among title-reveal techniques this one is the cheapest: no mask bar, no per-character, no displacement — just a pair of braces walking apart, with the text "bracketed out". It is born with code feel (`{}`), so in a technical product context it reads as "this is the content itself". The make-or-break: the clip width must be bound strictly to the bracket positions — the moment the text fades or wipes in on its own, the braces degenerate into decoration and the curtain effect is lost.
cards.energyEn: Medium (a single overshoot is the only peak; everything else is still)

cards.name: brand-frame-snap
cards.summary: 品牌色画框语法——一圈粗纯色画框先于内容长出包住全屏，录屏窗口落进框内；模式切换时整圈画框同帧硬翻色+窗内布局同帧换，一个 borderColor 干完章节导航/状态提示/品牌露出三件事
cards.use: 双模式/双章节产品片的全片包装层（蓝=模式A、绿=模式B 颜色编码）；真实录屏素材的品牌化包裹
cards.duration: 单次翻色 ~4.7s（140f）；画框本身可全片驻场
cards.energy: 中（翻色瞬间高，其余时间是安静的包装层）
cards.intention: 真实录屏直接铺满屏没有品牌存在感，加 logo 水印又廉价。本卡用一圈 粗品牌色画框把录屏"装裱"起来：画框**先于内容出现**（先立画框再放 画，仪式感），之后画框颜色成为全片的语义编码——demo 里钴蓝=Design、 橘红=Dev Mode（原片是蓝/绿；关键是色相对冲 + 明度差）。章节切换时整圈画框一帧内硬翻色，无渐变，颜色硬切就是"换挡" 声效的视觉等价物；窗内布局同帧 A→B、角标与徽标同步换字，三处同帧 共振把"模式切换"砸实。与 theme-switch-moves 分工：那换的是 UI 本体 肤色（有扫过边界），本卡换的是"画框"这个包装层（同帧无边界）， 语义是模式/章节切换不是主题切换。

styles.label: brand-frame-snap
styles.description: 品牌色画框语法——一圈粗纯色画框先于内容长出包住全屏，录屏窗口落进框内；模式切换时整圈画框同帧硬翻色+窗内布局同帧换，一个 borderColor 干完章节导航/状态提示/品牌露出三件事
styles.descriptionEn: A thick brand-color frame grows around the screen before content arrives, then hard-flips its color on the same frame the inner layout switches.

cards.summaryEn: A thick brand-color frame grows around the screen before content arrives, then hard-flips its color on the same frame the inner layout switches.
cards.useEn: The whole-film packaging layer for dual-mode / dual-chapter product films (blue = mode A, green = mode B colour coding); branded wrapping for real screen recordings
cards.intentionEn: A raw screen recording blown up to full screen carries no brand presence, and slapping a logo watermark on it looks cheap. This card "frames" the recording with a thick brand-colour border: the frame appears before the content (frame first, picture second — the ceremony), and from then on the frame colour becomes the film's semantic code — in the demo cobalt blue = Design, orange-red = Dev Mode (the original was blue/green; the key is hue opposition plus a lightness difference). On chapter switches the whole ring hard-flips its colour within one frame, no gradient: the hard colour cut is the visual equivalent of a gear-shift sound; the in-window layout flips A→B in the same frame, corner marks and badges swap text in sync, and those three same-frame resonances drive home "mode switched". Division of labour with theme-switch-moves: that one changes the UI's own skin (with a sweeping border), this one changes the "frame" packaging layer (same frame, no border) — the semantics are mode/chapter switching, not theme switching.
cards.energyEn: Medium (high at the colour-flip instant; otherwise a quiet packaging layer)

cards.name: brand-ink-open
cards.summary: 墨线十字准星描画→字标逐字压印→打字机副标→满一秒静止再上浮消散
cards.use: 品牌开场；任何"先立名号再进产品"的片头
cards.energy: 低（起步位，为后续镜头留爬升空间）
cards.intention: 第一拍先给品牌记忆点：观众在任何产品画面出现之前，先看清并记住名字。安静、纸墨质感、有一个完整的静止时刻。

styles.label: brand-ink-open
styles.description: 墨线十字准星描画→字标逐字压印→打字机副标→满一秒静止再上浮消散
styles.descriptionEn: Ink crosshairs draw in, the wordmark stamps letter by letter, a subtitle types on, then the lockup holds and lifts away.

cards.summaryEn: Ink crosshairs draw in, the wordmark stamps letter by letter, a subtitle types on, then the lockup holds and lifts away.
cards.useEn: Brand openers; any film head that "establishes the name before entering the product"
cards.intentionEn: The first beat delivers the brand memory point: before any product imagery appears, the audience sees and remembers the name clearly. Quiet, paper-ink texture, one complete still moment.
cards.energyEn: Low (a starting position that leaves room to climb in later shots)

cards.name: canvas-materialize-moves
cards.summary: 内容"物化上画布"两式——panel-to-canvas 行倒卡（面板表格行沿弧线飞出、跨容器变形成画布卡片）与 diagram-cascade 级联生成树（prompt 打字后节点逐层弹出、连线先于节点生长）
cards.use: AI/协作工具"生成结果落到画布上"的叙事段落；A 式讲"已有内容换了个存在形态"，B 式讲"从一句话长出一棵结构"
cards.energy: 中
cards.intention: 库内生成叙事只有"窗口内逐字写出"（document-typewriter-reveal 文档自己写出来） 和"图表自己活起来"（chart-live-moves），没有词管**内容离开容器、在 开放画布上物化成新实体**。本卡补这一块：画布是舞台，生成物是登台的 演员。A 式的命门是跨容器形态迁移——同一条内容从"行"变成"卡"，位置 /宽高/圆角/内容布局在一条 spring 上同步插值，观众读到"是它飞过去 变的"而不是"删一个加一个"；B 式的命门是级联时序——线牵出节点、层 喂出层，结构感来自先后而非同时。

styles.label: panel-to-canvas 行倒卡
styles.description: 复选框逐个自动打勾→按钮按下→三行沿上抛弧线错峰飞出，途中行形态与卡形态交叉淡化，落位带随机倾角；面板行槽塌陷成虚线留白
styles.use: 批量导入/一键上板：内容从列表态迁移为空间态
styles.descriptionEn: Checkboxes tick themselves, then table rows arc out of the panel and morph mid-flight into canvas cards, landing with casual tilts.

styles.label: diagram-cascade 级联生成树
styles.description: prompt 逐字敲出（敲完描边变深确认）→根（深色）→2 子→4 孙逐层弹出，折角连线描线先行 8f，成树后整棵呼吸一拍
styles.use: AI 生成结构图/脑图/ER 图：一句话长出一棵树
styles.descriptionEn: A typed prompt sprouts a diagram tree: root, children, grandchildren pop layer by layer with connector lines drawing ahead of each node.

cards.summaryEn: Two materialize moves: table rows arc out of a panel and morph into canvas cards, and a typed prompt grows a cascading diagram tree.
cards.useEn: Narrative passages for AI / collaboration tools where "generated results land on the canvas"; style A says "existing content changed form", style B says "a structure grows out of one sentence"
cards.intentionEn: The library's generation narrative had only "typed out inside a window" (document-typewriter-reveal, the document writes itself) and "the chart comes alive" (chart-live-moves) — nothing covered content leaving its container and materialising as a new entity on an open canvas. This card fills that gap: the canvas is the stage, the generated object is the actor walking on. Style A's make-or-break is cross-container form migration — the same content goes from "row" to "card", with position / width / height / radius / content layout interpolating in sync on a single spring, so the audience reads "it flew over and became it" rather than "one deleted, one added". Style B's make-or-break is the cascade timing — lines pull out nodes, layers feed layers; the sense of structure comes from sequence, not simultaneity.
cards.energyEn: Medium

cards.name: card-flip-reveal
cards.summary: 功能卡 3D 翻面揭示——卡片沿 Y 轴翻 180°，正面 UI 翻到侧棱最薄处掠过一道随角度移动的受光，背面揭出大号结论数字，逐张错峰扫过整排
cards.use: "功能→成果"的成对叙事：一排功能卡逐张翻出各自的指标/结论；元素级转场卡
cards.duration: 全程 150f（~5s，含 hold）；单卡 4f 预备 + 16f 翻 + ~10f 弹簧落定，三卡错峰 12f
cards.energy: 中高
cards.intention: 库内"翻"字辈已有 wipe-transitions 百叶窗（叶片逐条翻面，讲换页）。 本卡是**语义翻面**：一张卡的正反两面是一对因果——正面是功能界面， 背面是它带来的数字结论。翻面动作本身 就是"所以呢？"的回答，Apple bento 段落的标准语法。逐张错峰 10f 扫过 一排，三张卡三个数字节奏读作"成果连报"。

styles.label: card-flip-reveal
styles.description: 功能卡 3D 翻面揭示——卡片沿 Y 轴翻 180°，正面 UI 翻到侧棱最薄处掠过一道随角度移动的受光，背面揭出大号结论数字，逐张错峰扫过整排
styles.descriptionEn: Feature cards rotate 180 degrees around the Y axis, flash at the edge, and reveal a large result on the back.

cards.summaryEn: Feature cards rotate 180 degrees around the Y axis, flash at the edge, and reveal a large result on the back.
cards.useEn: Paired "feature → outcome" storytelling: a row of feature cards flips over one by one to reveal their metrics / conclusions; an element-level transition card
cards.intentionEn: The library already had the "flip" family in wipe-transitions' venetian blind (blades flipping one by one, about page changes). This card is a semantic flip: a card's two faces are a cause and effect — the front is the feature UI, the back is the numeric conclusion it brings. The flip itself is the answer to "so what?", the standard grammar of Apple's bento passages. Staggered 10 frames per card sweeping a row, three cards with three numbers read as "consecutive results".
cards.energyEn: Medium-high

cards.name: card-flock-tumble
cards.summary: 三张 UI 页卡从侧棱薄边 3D 翻飞成阶梯站定（全程清晰、样条连续丝滑），站定后保持慢转不停，快速收束吸入中心，炸出单个湍流烟雾环扩散，巨字横贯收场
cards.use: 能量高潮段（功能页群→品牌口号的爆点转场）；霓虹/极光暗场调性；"多页面能力"收束成一句话的段落
cards.duration: 翻飞 ~1.5s + 慢转展示 ~0.3s + 收束 0.3s + 烟环+巨字 ~2s；全段 4.5s
cards.energy: 极高（全片能量顶点用）
cards.intention: 三张页卡像被甩出的扑克在 3D 空间翻飞列队，站定亮相后被瞬间 吸入中心，炸出一圈烟雾环，品牌巨字穿环而出——"能力展示→能量 坍缩→口号爆发"一气呵成。命门有三：**丝滑**（侧棱→翻飞→站定 一条 Catmull-Rom 样条导数连续，分段插值的顿挫会被读出来）、 **不许停**（站定后保持低角速度慢转到收束，静止段被裁"不要停住， 保持旋转"——高潮段没有静帧）、**全程清晰**（motion blur/景深糊 全删，被裁"不要加模糊效果"）。

styles.label: card-flock-tumble
styles.description: 三张 UI 页卡从侧棱薄边 3D 翻飞成阶梯站定（全程清晰、样条连续丝滑），站定后保持慢转不停，快速收束吸入中心，炸出单个湍流烟雾环扩散，巨字横贯收场
styles.descriptionEn: Three UI cards tumble in 3D from edge-on to a stepped formation, keep slowly rotating, then collapse inward and burst into a smoke ring under a giant word.

cards.summaryEn: Three UI cards tumble in 3D from edge-on to a stepped formation, keep slowly rotating, then collapse inward and burst into a smoke ring under a giant word.
cards.useEn: The energy-peak passage (a burst transition from a wall of feature pages to the brand slogan); neon / aurora dark-ground tone; a section where "many pages of capability" collapses into one line
cards.intentionEn: Three page cards tumble and queue through 3D space like thrown playing cards, hold their pose for the reveal, then are instantly sucked into the centre, blasting a smoke ring through which the giant brand word passes — "capability showcase → energy collapse → slogan explosion" in one breath. Three make-or-breaks: silky (edge-on → tumble → lock-off on one Catmull-Rom spline with continuous derivatives; the stutter of segment-wise interpolation gets read), never stop (after locking off, keep a low angular velocity rotating to the end — a cut note reads "do not stop, keep rotating": the peak has no still frames), and stay sharp throughout (motion blur / depth-of-field haze all deleted, per the cut note "no blur effects").
cards.energyEn: Extreme (reserved for the film's energy apex)

cards.name: card-stack
cards.summary: 一组模板卡（demo 9 张）从屏幕下方逐张 spring 弹入、越落越快叠成一摞，全员落位后整摞一次性展成扇面——每张按序号偏转 6.5°、横移 138px，最后中心卡被抽出
cards.use: 需要交代"我们有一组东西"的产品段落；卡片墙/模板库/方案列表的建立镜头，也能当 logo 前的一拍蓄势
cards.energy: 中高（入场是连续小爆发，展开段收成一次平滑的整体动作）
cards.intention: 一摞卡先聚成一个物体，再摊开成一组物体——顺序很关键：先给"整体"再给"个体"。 观众第一眼记住的是有分量的一摞（数量感），第二眼才看清每张不一样（多样性）。 展开动作留到最后一次性完成，是为了不和入场的节拍打架。

styles.label: card-stack
styles.description: 一组模板卡（demo 9 张）从屏幕下方逐张 spring 弹入、越落越快叠成一摞，全员落位后整摞一次性展成扇面——每张按序号偏转 6.5°、横移 138px，最后中心卡被抽出
styles.descriptionEn: Eight cards spring up from below the frame one after another and pile into a single stack, then the whole pile fans out into a 3D arc as each card rotates, slides sideways and steps back in depth.

cards.summaryEn: Eight cards spring up from below the frame one after another and pile into a single stack, then the whole pile fans out into a 3D arc as each card rotates, slides sideways and steps back in depth.
cards.useEn: Product passages that need to establish "we have a set of things"; establishing shots for card walls / template libraries / plan lists, also usable as the wind-up beat before a logo
cards.intentionEn: A stack of cards first gathers into one object, then spreads into a set of objects — the order matters: give "the whole" before "the individuals". The audience's first impression is a weighty stack (a sense of quantity); only at the second look do they see that every card is different (diversity). The spread is saved for one final complete motion so it does not fight the entrance rhythm.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (continuous small bursts on entrance; the spread resolves into one smooth whole-body motion)

cards.name: carousel-3d
cards.summary: 8 张卡排成圆环整环自转一圈（匀速底 + 每 45° 一次停靠的分步），每卡只绕 Y 公转、自身 billboard 朝外，正反两层同向贴图配 backface-visibility:hidden 保证任何时刻都正立不倒置，正前方卡被点亮、环下字幕随之换字，相机全程钉在浅俯角
cards.use: 作品集/模板库/集成清单的循环展示；需要无缝 loop 的背景拍或落地页 hero
cards.energy: 中（可无限循环的稳态运动，每 45° 一次停靠给出节拍）
cards.intention: 展示"一组东西"最省事的办法是排成一排横滑，但横滑有起点和终点。环形没有——它天然 循环，观众看多久都不会觉得"放完了"。这张卡真正要解决的是环形 carousel 最容易翻车 的点：卡片背面。方案是双面同向贴图，所以从环内看和从环外看是同一张正立的卡，环转一圈 不会有任何一帧出现镜像或倒置。

styles.label: carousel-3d
styles.description: 8 张卡排成圆环整环自转一圈（匀速底 + 每 45° 一次停靠的分步），每卡只绕 Y 公转、自身 billboard 朝外，正反两层同向贴图配 backface-visibility:hidden 保证任何时刻都正立不倒置，正前方卡被点亮、环下字幕随之换字，相机全程钉在浅俯角
styles.descriptionEn: Eight cards sit on a circular ring laid out with sin and cos, spinning through exactly one full revolution while each card billboards outward with matched front and back faces so it never reads as mirrored or upside down.

cards.summaryEn: Eight cards sit on a circular ring laid out with sin and cos, spinning through exactly one full revolution while each card billboards outward with matched front and back faces so it never reads as mirrored or upside down.
cards.useEn: Looping showcases for portfolios / template libraries / integration lists; background shots or landing-page heroes that need a seamless loop
cards.intentionEn: The cheapest way to show "a set of things" is a row that slides sideways, but a row has a start and an end. A ring does not — it loops naturally, and however long the audience watches it never feels "that's the end". What this card really solves is where ring carousels most easily fail: the back of the cards. The answer is double-sided, same-direction texturing, so seen from inside the ring or outside it is the same upright card — one full rotation never shows a single mirrored or inverted frame.
cards.energyEn: Medium (an indefinitely loopable steady motion, docking every 45° to give a beat)

cards.name: chart-live-moves
cards.summary: 活体图表三式——oscilloscope-stream 示波流线（曲线右端实时写入+突发尖峰）、unit-dot-swarm-regroup 点阵重组（点群三幕迁徙聚成数字）、axis-rescale-shock 轴爆表重标（新值冲出画框逼 y 轴重标）
cards.use: 数据叙事段落；分别讲"实时性"、"每个数字是一个人"、"增长装不下"
cards.energy: 中高（数据即剧情）
cards.intention: 图表不是插图是剧情。三式共同前提（实测判例）：**必须真图表语境** ——真轴标/真数据/真文案，灰阶占位条测不出数据叙事的表达力。 A 示波流线：曲线写入点钉在右端上下起伏，旧数据左流出画，中途一次 突发尖峰（振幅 2.2×、读数跳大变强调色）——"实时"不用说出口，还有事件； B 点阵重组：320 个点（每点≈40 renders）散布→聚三簇（浮 Promo/Launch film/ Explainer 真标签）→列队成柱（真轴标）→聚成点阵大数字 "12,847"—— 同一批点，观众能跟着某一颗看它归队； C 轴爆表：折线正常爬升，新值顶破图表天花板规线冲出 226px（强调色粗线 插进标题区、撞进右上 KPI 数字），停半拍，y 轴"哗"地重标（旧刻度飞出/新刻度滑入/网格 加密/旧线压扁成地平线），新值落回+弹真值标签——用"坐标轴装不下"演增长。

styles.label: oscilloscope-stream
styles.description: 采样窗平移 8px/f + 余弦包络尖峰 + 刹停真静止
styles.use: 监控/实时类产品："活着"的系统
styles.descriptionEn: A live curve writes itself in at the right edge with sudden spikes, then brakes to a true standstill.

styles.label: unit-dot-swarm-regroup
styles.description: 三幕 spring 错峰迁徙（stiffness 150、错峰 8f），终幕点阵拼数字
styles.use: 用户量/构成叙事："每个点是一个人"
styles.descriptionEn: A dot swarm migrates in three staggered spring acts and finally regroups into a number.

styles.label: axis-rescale-shock
styles.description: 冲出框 220px + 重标三联动（刻度换/网格密/旧线压扁）+ 震 8px
styles.use: 增长曲线高光："off the charts" 字面化
styles.descriptionEn: A new value bursts 220px out of the chart frame, forcing the axis to rescale: ticks swap, the grid densifies, the old line flattens.

cards.summaryEn: Three data-driven motions: a live oscilloscope trace, dots regrouping into a figure, and an axis forced to rescale.
cards.useEn: Data-storytelling passages: "real-time", "every number is a person", and "growth no longer fits"
cards.intentionEn: Charts are not illustration, they are plot. Shared premise for all three styles (tested rule): it must be a real chart context — real axis labels / real data / real copy; grey placeholder bars cannot measure the expressiveness of data storytelling. A, oscilloscope stream: the writing point pins to the right edge and bobs up and down, old data flows out left, with one sudden spike mid-way (amplitude 2.2×, the readout jumps and turns accent colour) — "real-time" is never said out loud, and there are events too. B, dot-swarm regroup: 320 dots (each ≈40 renders) scatter → gather into three clusters (floating Promo / Launch film / Explainer real labels) → queue into a column (real axis labels) → converge into a dot-matrix big number "12,847" — same dots, and the audience can follow one single dot as it rejoins its team. C, axis blowout: the line climbs normally, the new value bursts through the chart's ceiling rule and shoots 226px out (an accent-colour thick line stabbing into the title zone and colliding with the top-right KPI number), holds half a beat, and the y-axis is re-scaled with a whoosh (old ticks fly out / new ticks slide in / the grid densifies / the old line is flattened into a horizon), the new value falls back and pops a real-value label — growth performed as "the axis can no longer contain it".
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (the data is the plot)

cards.name: chip-grid-single-select-blackout
cards.summary: 五个选项 chip 以 3+2 居中排布逐个淡入；选中帧先插一帧灰色按压块，紧接数帧内底色变墨黑、文字变白并做 1→1.04→1 极轻回弹，其余 chip 淡到 18% 但位置锁死；随后余项归零，黑 chip 上移收窄，下方升起结算价格
cards.use: 单选/套餐/档位选择的交互演示；"选了它之后会怎样"的因果镜头；价格/参数结算类链路
cards.energy: 中低（唯一的爆点是那一帧灰闪，其余都在收）
cards.intention: 一帧灰闪 + 三帧反黑，是把真实 UI 的 `:active → :selected` 两级状态 拆开演。观众看到的是"手指按下"再"系统确认"，而不是一次渐变。其余 chip 降到 18% 而**位置绝不移动**：一旦重排，观众会以为页面刷新了， "单选"的语义就丢了。

styles.label: chip-grid-single-select-blackout
styles.description: 五个选项 chip 以 3+2 居中排布逐个淡入；选中帧先插一帧灰色按压块，紧接数帧内底色变墨黑、文字变白并做 1→1.04→1 极轻回弹，其余 chip 淡到 18% 但位置锁死；随后余项归零，黑 chip 上移收窄，下方升起结算价格
styles.descriptionEn: Five option chips fade in, then a single grey press frame flashes before the chosen chip turns solid black with a tiny bounce while the others drop to eighteen percent without moving.

cards.summaryEn: Five option chips fade in, then a single grey press frame flashes before the chosen chip turns solid black with a tiny bounce while the others drop to eighteen percent without moving.
cards.useEn: Interaction demos for single-select / package / tier choice; a causal shot of "what happens once you pick it"; pricing / parameter checkout flows
cards.intentionEn: One frame of grey flash plus three frames of blackout performs the real UI's `:active → :selected` two-stage state as separate steps. The audience sees "finger pressed" then "system confirmed", not one gradient. The other chips drop to 18% while their positions never move: the moment they rearrange, the audience thinks the page refreshed and the "single-select" semantics are lost.
cards.energyEn: Medium-low (the only burst is that single grey-flash frame; everything else pulls in)

cards.name: circle-match-iris
cards.summary: 圆心匹配光圈切——光圈从页面上圆形元素的圆心炸开，圈内新页的圆形图表接在同一个圆上；匹配剪辑给光圈一个语义锚点
cards.use: 前景有圆形元素（头像/图标/圆钮）、后景有圆形主体（donut 图/圆环进度）的接缝；转场技法卡
cards.duration: 5.5s / 165f（入场+定睛 40f + 蓄力 7f + 接圆开圈 37f + sweep 58f + 静止 47f）
cards.energy: 中高
cards.intention: 普通 iris 光圈（词汇表原条目）从任意点开圈，观众只读到"换页了"。 本卡把它和 match-cut 焊死：光圈必须从前景一个**真实圆形元素**的圆心 炸开，圈内长出的新页里有个圆形图表恰好接在同一个圆上——观众看到的 是"头像的圆变成了图表的圆"，圆形本身完成叙事（这个人→这个人的数据）。 这是 match-cut 在 UI 语境里的落地形态：不靠构图巧合，靠语义圆对圆。 与穿越三式同属"后景在前景里预先在场"，但锚点是抽象形状而非容器。

styles.label: circle-match-iris
styles.description: 圆心匹配光圈切——光圈从页面上圆形元素的圆心炸开，圈内新页的圆形图表接在同一个圆上；匹配剪辑给光圈一个语义锚点
styles.descriptionEn: An iris expands from a circular UI element and lands on a matching circle in the next scene.

cards.summaryEn: An iris expands from a circular UI element and lands on a matching circle in the next scene.
cards.useEn: Seams where the foreground has a round element (avatar / icon / round button) and the background has a round subject (donut chart / ring progress); a transition-technique card
cards.intentionEn: An ordinary iris (the vocabulary's original entry) opens its circle from an arbitrary point, and the audience only reads "the page changed". This card welds it to a match cut: the iris must explode from the centre of a real round element in the foreground, and the new page growing inside the circle has a round chart that lands exactly on the same circle — the audience sees "the avatar's circle became the chart's circle", and the circle itself completes the narrative (this person → this person's data). This is the landing form of the match cut in a UI context: not relying on a compositional coincidence, but on semantic circle-to-circle. Like the three travel styles it belongs to "the background pre-exists inside the foreground", but the anchor is an abstract shape rather than a container.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high

cards.name: cloner-depth-echo
cards.summary: 克隆纵队——主卡瞬间"复印"出 7 个半透明分身沿斜向纵深排开成队，停一拍后全体加速吸回本体合一+弹跳
cards.use: "多副本/多租户/规模感/批量处理"卖点；一镜讲完"一个=很多"
cards.energy: 中（陈列-收束型）
cards.intention: Spline/C4D Cloner 语汇的 UI 翻译：一张主卡"啪"地复印出 7 个克隆体 沿 Z 轴向后等距排开（间隔 250px、透明度 100%→28% 递减、越远越只剩轮廓）， 错峰弹出成纵队；停 ~32f 让观众数得清"有很多个"；然后全体 ease-in 加速吸回 本体合一，合体瞬间本体弹 1.06x 收束。demo 把"一个=很多"落到具体卖点： 一张 Motion Studio 渲染卡（launch-film）×8 个镜头，合体时卡底 8 个镜头位同时点亮，标题落「One prompt. / Eight shots.」。与 depth-layer-moves 视差 （不同内容分层）分工：这是**同一内容**的等距重影阵列，语义是规模 不是空间。

styles.label: cloner-depth-echo
styles.description: 克隆纵队——主卡瞬间"复印"出 7 个半透明分身沿斜向纵深排开成队，停一拍后全体加速吸回本体合一+弹跳
styles.descriptionEn: A card duplicates into a diagonal depth trail, holds briefly, then accelerates back into one springy original.

cards.summaryEn: A card duplicates into a diagonal depth trail, holds briefly, then accelerates back into one springy original.
cards.useEn: Selling points around "many copies / multi-tenant / sense of scale / batch processing"; "one equals many" in a single shot
cards.intentionEn: A UI translation of Spline/C4D Cloner vocabulary: one master card "snaps" out 7 clones at even intervals back along the Z axis (250px apart, opacity stepping 100% → 28%, the farther ones reduced to outlines), popping off in stagger into a column; it holds ~32 frames so the audience can count "there are many"; then everything accelerates with ease-in and is sucked back into the master, the merge popping 1.06x to close. The demo grounds "one equals many" in a concrete selling point: one Motion Studio render card (launch-film) × 8 shots, and on merge the 8 shot slots on the card light up together while the title lands on "One prompt. / Eight shots." Division of labour with depth-layer-moves' parallax (different content on layers): this is an evenly spaced echo array of the same content — the semantics are scale, not space.
cards.energyEn: Medium (display-then-collapse type)

cards.name: collab-cursor-moves
cards.summary: 协作光标当演员——cast-ensemble 五光标群演氛围层（错峰飞入+正弦漂移+打字 cameo+聚拢围观）
cards.use: 协作/多人主题的画布场景，给画面铺"团队在场"体温
cards.energy: A 低中（氛围层，可垫任何时长）
cards.intention: 库内光标一直是"操作工具"（cursor-flyover 的光标 是单光标点击导览）。本卡把带身份名牌的协作光标升格成**演员**： 五枚光标错峰入场后持续漂移当氛围粒子，"团队在场"感全靠它，其中一枚 还能停下来打字（cameo 戏份）。SVG 光标+名牌 chip 成本极低、叙事密度 极高，是"协作"主题最便宜的视觉论证。

styles.label: cast-ensemble
styles.description: 协作光标当演员——cast-ensemble 五光标群演氛围层（错峰飞入+正弦漂移+打字 cameo+聚拢围观）
styles.use: 画布/白板类产品全片氛围层；主内容之外需要"别人也在"的背景活性
styles.descriptionEn: Five named cursors spring in staggered, drift on sine paths, one types a cameo line, and the whole cast gathers to watch at the end.

cards.summaryEn: A five-cursor ensemble drifting and typing across a shared board as living collaboration ambience.
cards.useEn: Canvas scenes for collaboration / multi-player themes, laying a "team is present" warmth over the frame
cards.intentionEn: In the library the cursor was always "an operating tool" (cursor-flyover's cursor is a single cursor clicking through a tour). This card promotes named collaboration cursors to actors: five cursors enter in stagger then keep drifting as atmosphere particles, and the sense of "the team is present" rests entirely on them — one of them even stops to type (a cameo part). SVG cursor + name chip is extremely cheap with very high narrative density: the cheapest visual proof of the "collaboration" theme.
cards.energyEn: A low-medium (atmosphere layer; can pad any duration)

cards.name: countdown-arc-scatter
cards.summary: 纸面表盘 9 个等大数字沿大弧切向排布，整盘扫过 96° 后减速急停，"5" 停在弧顶随即平移落位成标题首字符，其余数字带 blur 原地散去，标题逐词模糊淡入、末词转强调色
cards.use: 倒计时/时长承诺类文案（"5 min to install"）；数据揭晓的一拍；需要"仪表盘"语汇的浅底短镜
cards.duration: 约 3.3s（100f@30fps：扫动 ~30f + 落位 20f + 标题成句 + hold 22f；最短可压到 33f 单拍）
cards.energy: 高（96° 大幅扫动压进 ~20 帧，纯冲击）
cards.intention: "5 分钟装完"写成静态字卡没人信。表盘扫过的做法把这个数字放进一个 **量程**里：45、35、28、22、17、10 一路扫过去，停在 5——观众看到的是 "从很多降到很少"，数字自带论证。停下后 "5" 不消失而是**平移变成标题的 首字符**，一个元素完成从仪表到文案的身份切换，这是本卡最值钱的一手。

styles.label: countdown-arc-scatter
styles.description: 纸面表盘 9 个等大数字沿大弧切向排布，整盘扫过 96° 后减速急停，"5" 停在弧顶随即平移落位成标题首字符，其余数字带 blur 原地散去，标题逐词模糊淡入、末词转强调色
styles.descriptionEn: Numbers arranged tangentially along a large arc sweep past and brake to a stop, the winning digit sliding out of the dial to become the first character of the headline.

cards.summaryEn: Numbers arranged tangentially along a large arc sweep past and brake to a stop, the winning digit sliding out of the dial to become the first character of the headline.
cards.useEn: Countdown / time-promise copy ("5 min to install"); the beat of a data reveal; a light-ground short shot that needs "dashboard" vocabulary
cards.intentionEn: Nobody believes "installs in 5 minutes" written as a static card. The sweeping-dial approach puts the number inside a range: 45, 35, 28, 22, 17, 10 sweeping past, stopping on 5 — the audience sees "from many down to few", and the number carries its own argument. After stopping, the "5" does not disappear but translates to become the first character of the title — one element completes its identity switch from gauge to copy, the most valuable move in this card.
cards.energyEn: High (a 96° sweep compressed into ~20 frames; pure impact)

cards.name: crane-rise-reveal
cards.summary: 升降臂拉升揭示——开场怼在一行数据特写，相机沿 Y 轴减速升起后拉，行行涌入直到整面 dashboard 铺满全幅
cards.use: "从细节到全局"的开场定场；与 drone-dive-landing（全局→单点俯冲）互为反向
cards.duration: 5.5s（165f：特写 hold 24f + 拉升 102f + 落定/余波/静止 39f）
cards.energy: 中高（持续单向运动，无冲击拍）
cards.intention: 开场定场库内已有 drone-dive-landing——从上帝视角砸进 hero 特写， "全局→焦点"。本卡是它的镜像："焦点→全局"——先怼在一行真实数据上 让观众看清"这是什么"，再升降臂式拉升后退，一排排内容涌入画面， 最后整面产品铺满——"你看到的这一行，只是这一面墙的一格"。 适合以产品体量/内容丰富度为卖点的开场；两卡同片只用一个方向。

styles.label: crane-rise-reveal
styles.description: 升降臂拉升揭示——开场怼在一行数据特写，相机沿 Y 轴减速升起后拉，行行涌入直到整面 dashboard 铺满全幅
styles.descriptionEn: The camera starts tight on one data row, rises and pulls back, then reveals a full dashboard filling the frame.

cards.summaryEn: The camera starts tight on one data row, rises and pulls back, then reveals a full dashboard filling the frame.
cards.useEn: A "from detail to overview" establishing opener; the mirror of drone-dive-landing (overview → single-point dive)
cards.intentionEn: The establishing opener library already had drone-dive-landing — crashing from a god's-eye view into a hero close-up, "overview → focus". This card is its mirror: "focus → overview" — first pressed onto a row of real data so the audience sees "what this is", then pulling back crane-style as rows of content flood the frame until the whole product wall fills it — "the row you just saw is one cell of this wall". Suited to openers that sell on product scale / richness of content; when both cards appear in one film, use only one direction.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (continuous one-way motion, no impact beat)

cards.name: crash-zoom-punch
cards.summary: 全景一拍急推到目标特写（6f），落位二选一——过冲回弹（弹性）或撞停震屏（重量）
cards.use: 功能段"点名"镜头——把观众视线一拍按到目标卡/模块上；强调级用撞停
cards.duration: 约 0.5s 动作 + 前后 hold（动作 6–11f，前 hold ≥30f 建立全景、后 hold ≥45f 读特写）
cards.energy: 高（瞬时冲击，非持续高能）
cards.intention: 慢推近（spotlight-hero-card）是"请看"，急推是"看这个！"——一拍之内 从全景砸到特写，视线没有选择余地。落位质感分两款：回弹是弹性 （"看这个"），撞停震屏是重量（"就是它"），按强调级选。

styles.label: crash-zoom-punch
styles.description: 全景一拍急推到目标特写（6f），落位二选一——过冲回弹（弹性）或撞停震屏（重量）
styles.descriptionEn: A six-frame push races from a wide view to a target close-up, ending with either an elastic overshoot or a heavy impact stop.

cards.summaryEn: A six-frame push races from a wide view to a target close-up, ending with either an elastic overshoot or a heavy impact stop.
cards.useEn: A "point-and-name" shot for feature passages — slamming the audience's gaze onto the target card / module in one beat; use the impact-stop version for the highest emphasis
cards.intentionEn: A slow push (spotlight-hero-card) says "please look"; a crash zoom says "look at this!" — from wide to close-up in a single beat, the gaze given no choice. Two landing textures: rebound is elasticity ("look at this"), impact-stop with screen shake is weight ("it's this one") — pick by emphasis level.
cards.energyEn: High (instantaneous impact, not sustained energy)

cards.name: cursor-flyover
cards.summary: 整页俯瞰后，相机依次飞到四个功能区 zoom-in 特写，SVG 光标先一步到位指点、点击留下涟漪并触发界面响应，最后拉回俯瞰
cards.use: 单页产品的功能巡览：一镜带观众看完四个功能区，光标当"导游手指"
cards.duration: 约 8.0s（240f@30fps；俯瞰 22f · 四站各 44f（飞行 20f + 停留 24f）· 拉回 24f · hold 18f）
cards.energy: 中（等距巡航，节奏靠点击涟漪打点）
cards.intention: 替代"四个功能四段剪辑"的省镜方案：一个连续相机把四个角串成一条参观动线，光标是观众的注意力代理——它到哪、点哪，观众就看哪。空间连续让功能之间的位置关系也被顺带记住。

styles.label: cursor-flyover
styles.description: 整页俯瞰后，相机依次飞到四个功能区 zoom-in 特写，SVG 光标先一步到位指点、点击留下涟漪并触发界面响应，最后拉回俯瞰
styles.descriptionEn: After an overview fade-in the camera flies to each of four screen corners in turn while an SVG cursor arrives with it, pointing and leaving a click ripple at every stop.

cards.summaryEn: After an overview fade-in the camera flies to each of four screen corners in turn while an SVG cursor arrives with it, pointing and leaving a click ripple at every stop.
cards.useEn: A feature tour for single-page products: four functional areas in one shot, the cursor acting as the "tour-guide finger"
cards.intentionEn: The shot-saving alternative to "four features, four edits": one continuous camera strings the four corners into a tour route, and the cursor is the audience's attention proxy — wherever it goes and clicks, the audience looks. Spatial continuity means the positional relationships between features get memorised for free.
cards.energyEn: Medium (even cruising; the rhythm is dotted by the click ripples)

cards.name: dataviz-landscape-open
cards.summary: 暗场支流线束地景开场——多条流线汇入主干、虚构 ID 标签浮在线上、相机重景深低速飞越
cards.use: 品牌级抽象开场（"数据宇宙"隐喻），接亮场产品段或字标；与 glow-flyline-moves 分工：那卡是段落内卡片之间的连线叙事，本卡是开场专用的全画幅地景
cards.energy: 低开缓升（起步位，为后续爬升留空间）
cards.intention: Linear Releases 发布片开场实证的品牌级开场品类：把产品背后的数据世界 拍成一片**暗场地景**——支流线束从画面深处汇入一条主干（"无数工作流 汇成一个产品"的隐喻），真实感来自三样东西：①虚构 issue/任务 ID 标签 浮在线上（demo 用 Motion Studio 的镜头号 + 运镜名：每条支流是一个镜头，汇成一支成片）（观众认出"这是我每天看到的那种东西"）；②重景深——近景大虚焦 流过、中景标签清晰可读、远景渐隐，三层纵深让平面 SVG 读作空间； ③相机低速匀稳飞越——这是氛围段不是炫技段，速度感交给后面的镜头。 手搓 UI 合规依据：非复刻场景（页面上不存在此画面），按核心理念 1 修订版走质量+表达明确性门槛。

styles.label: dataviz-landscape-open
styles.description: 暗场支流线束地景开场——多条流线汇入主干、虚构 ID 标签浮在线上、相机重景深低速飞越
styles.descriptionEn: Streams of light merge across a dark data landscape while labels hover and a shallow-depth camera glides forward.

cards.summaryEn: Streams of light merge across a dark data landscape while labels hover and a shallow-depth camera glides forward.
cards.useEn: A brand-level abstract opener (the "data universe" metaphor), leading into a light-ground product section or a wordmark; division of labour with glow-flyline-moves: that card is the connector narrative between cards inside a section, this one is the full-frame landscape dedicated to openers
cards.intentionEn: The brand-level opener category proven by Linear Releases' launch-film opening: shoot the data world behind the product as a dark-ground landscape — tributary line bundles converging from deep in the frame into one trunk (the metaphor of "countless workflows converging into one product"), with realism coming from three things: 1) fictional issue / task ID labels floating on the lines (the demo uses Motion Studio's shot numbers + move names: each tributary is one shot, converging into one film) (the audience recognises "this is the kind of thing I see every day"); 2) heavy depth of field — near shots large and defocused sweeping past, mid-ground labels crisp and readable, far shots fading away, three layers of depth making flat SVG read as space; 3) the camera flies over slowly and steadily — this is an atmosphere section, not a showboating section; the sense of speed is handed to the later shots. Hand-built UI compliance basis: a non-replication scene (this frame does not exist on the page), passing the quality + expressive-clarity bar per core principle 1 revised.
cards.energyEn: Low start, gradual rise (a starting position that leaves room to climb later)

cards.name: deck-deal-flyin
cards.summary: 暗色石墨桌面上的实体牌堆特写环绕开局，灯从牌堆亮到旁边的页面板，一摞卡像发牌一样硬加速甩进网格，相机追着发牌升起后仰、落在整块满板的跑道式俯瞰上定格
cards.use: 展示"内容量大/源源不断汇入"的列表页与卡片墙；建立信息密度的第一印象
cards.energy: 高（节奏爬升段主力，不放开场第一镜）
cards.intention: 先给悬念（这一摞是什么？），再给答案（是几十个项目，它们自己飞进页面各就各位）。观众要感受到"东西源源不断地涌进来"，每张卡带着急迫感砸到位。

styles.label: deck-deal-flyin
styles.description: 暗色石墨桌面上的实体牌堆特写环绕开局，灯从牌堆亮到旁边的页面板，一摞卡像发牌一样硬加速甩进网格，相机追着发牌升起后仰、落在整块满板的跑道式俯瞰上定格
styles.descriptionEn: A physical card stack opens the scene, then cards accelerate into a live grid as the camera follows the growing page.

cards.summaryEn: A physical card stack opens the scene, then cards accelerate into a live grid as the camera follows the growing page.
cards.useEn: List pages and card walls that show "a large volume of content / a constant inflow"; the first impression of information density
cards.intentionEn: Suspense first (what is this stack?), then the answer (dozens of projects, flying into the page and taking their places on their own). The audience must feel "content pouring in endlessly", every card slamming into place with urgency.
cards.energyEn: High (the workhorse of the rhythm-climb passage; not for the opening shot)

cards.name: depth-layer-moves
cards.summary: 分层深度运镜——多层视差滑轨：3 层速度梯度横移出纵深，滑轨落定时主角浮起
cards.use: 平面截图要"有厚度"的段落：卡组 / 列表 / 整页的横向巡览
cards.energy: 中（质感型）
cards.intention: 整页平移是"看页面"，分层深度是"在页面的空间里"。视差滑轨给横移 加纵深（迪士尼多平面摄影机原理，Linear 片同款质感）。

styles.label: multiplane
styles.description: 分层深度运镜——多层视差滑轨：3 层速度梯度横移出纵深，滑轨落定时主角浮起
styles.descriptionEn: A multiplane parallax dolly: three layers slide at different speeds, pulling depth out of flat screenshots.

cards.summaryEn: Layered parallax rails: three speed tiers slide past to build depth, and the hero floats up as the rail settles.
cards.useEn: Passages where flat screenshots need "thickness": horizontal tours of card groups / lists / whole pages
cards.intentionEn: Panning the whole page is "looking at the page"; layered depth is "being inside the page's space". The parallax dolly adds depth to the horizontal move (the Disney multiplane camera principle, the same texture as Linear's film).
cards.energyEn: Medium (texture type)

cards.name: doc-park-left-pill-deal
cards.summary: 文档不淡出而是向左滑出只露约 35% 宽并微缩到 0.92，右侧按旁白节奏慢速发牌三张白底描边药丸（outBack 弹入），每张落定后其下方字幕逐词加深、下一张到来前整句淡出，左侧文档全程极缓慢自动滚动保持"正在被读"
cards.use: 旁白驱动的"分析结论逐条给出"段落；文档理解、推荐理由、审阅意见类产品的核心说明镜头
cards.energy: 低（慢发牌节奏，全片无峰值；靠自动滚动维持活性）
cards.intention: 结论要一条一条给，观众才记得住。但如果把来源文档淡出，结论就变成了空中楼阁——观众 不知道这些话从哪来。这张卡的解法是**让来源留在画面里**：文档靠左驻留只露一截，还在 缓慢滚动（说明它正在被读），右侧的每条结论都是从这份文档里长出来的。发牌节奏刻意慢， 是为了给旁白留出说完一句的时间。

styles.label: doc-park-left-pill-deal
styles.description: 文档不淡出而是向左滑出只露约 35% 宽并微缩到 0.92，右侧按旁白节奏慢速发牌三张白底描边药丸（outBack 弹入），每张落定后其下方字幕逐词加深、下一张到来前整句淡出，左侧文档全程极缓慢自动滚动保持"正在被读"
styles.descriptionEn: The source document slides left until only a sliver remains and keeps scrolling slowly, while three outlined pills are dealt one at a time, each followed by a caption that darkens word by word.

cards.summaryEn: The source document slides left until only a sliver remains and keeps scrolling slowly, while three outlined pills are dealt one at a time, each followed by a caption that darkens word by word.
cards.useEn: Narration-driven passages where "analysis conclusions arrive one by one"; the core explanatory shot for document-understanding, recommendation-rationale and review-comment products
cards.intentionEn: Conclusions must be delivered one at a time for the audience to remember them. But if you fade the source document out, the conclusions become castles in the air — the audience has no idea where these words come from. This card's answer is to keep the source on screen: the document parks at the left showing only a slice, still scrolling slowly (proof that it is being read), and every conclusion on the right grows out of that document. The dealing rhythm is deliberately slow to leave the narration time to finish a sentence.
cards.energyEn: Low (slow dealing rhythm, no peak in the whole shot; kept alive by the auto-scroll)

cards.name: document-typewriter-reveal
cards.summary: 悬浮在暗场里的整页真排版文档窗口在光标后自己"写"出来、侧栏跟进、历史条目逐个落入轨道，相机从斜侧标题特写一路后撤到全窗
cards.use: 文档/报告/笔记类功能镜头；信息密度最高的一拍
cards.duration: 150f（约 5s，含 history-list-stack 尾段与标语 hold）
cards.energy: 低中（信息密度最高，节奏放稳让观众读字）
cards.intention: 观众会读清屏幕上每个字——这一镜的说服力全在"文档是真的"。打字机式写入把静态页面变成"正在被写出来的文档"，侧栏历史条目落入补上"持续产出"的时间纵深。

styles.label: document-typewriter-reveal
styles.description: 悬浮在暗场里的整页真排版文档窗口在光标后自己"写"出来、侧栏跟进、历史条目逐个落入轨道，相机从斜侧标题特写一路后撤到全窗
styles.descriptionEn: A fully typeset document writes itself behind one accent-color caret, opens both side columns, and drops history entries into the rail.

cards.summaryEn: A fully typeset document writes itself behind one accent-color caret, opens both side columns, and drops history entries into the rail.
cards.useEn: Feature shots for documents / reports / notes; the beat with the highest information density
cards.intentionEn: The audience will read every word on screen — this shot's persuasiveness rests entirely on "the document is real". Typewriter-style writing turns a static page into "a document being written right now", and the history entries dropping into the sidebar add the time-depth of "continuous output".
cards.energyEn: Low-medium (highest information density; the rhythm is steadied so the audience can read)

cards.name: draw-svg-trace
cards.summary: 描边生长圈注——一条带笔头的墨线沿元素轮廓跑一圈把它"画"出来，闭合瞬间闪黑交棒、内容淡入；同套路可给标题画下划线
cards.use: 单个卡片/图表/标题的被点名入场；元素级手法（整页级蓝图描线归 wall-reveal-moves B 式）
cards.duration: 132f（预告 10f + 描边 40f + 闪黑交棒 16f + 下划线 18f + hold 40f，约 4.4s）
cards.energy: 中
cards.intention: "画出来"是纸墨审美里最顺手的入场隐喻：元素不是飞进来也不是淡进来， 而是被一支看不见的笔当场描出来。库内 wall-reveal-moves B 式已有整页 蓝图版（全屏线框逐段画+区域点亮），本卡是它的**元素级特写版**—— 一条线、一个主体、一次闭合，笔头可见、方向可读，适合"接下来讲它" 的点名时刻。第二用法是标题下划线生长：同一套路 18f 短版，给重点词 一笔手绘强调，与马克笔审美 token 天然同族。

styles.label: draw-svg-trace
styles.description: 描边生长圈注——一条带笔头的墨线沿元素轮廓跑一圈把它"画"出来，闭合瞬间闪黑交棒、内容淡入；同套路可给标题画下划线
styles.descriptionEn: An ink stroke traces an element outline, closes with a dark flash, and hands focus to the revealed content.

cards.summaryEn: An ink stroke traces an element outline, closes with a dark flash, and hands focus to the revealed content.
cards.useEn: Named entrances for a single card / chart / title; an element-level technique (whole-page blueprint tracing belongs to wall-reveal-moves style B)
cards.intentionEn: "Being drawn" is the handiest entrance metaphor in the paper-ink aesthetic: elements neither fly in nor fade in, they are traced on the spot by an invisible pen. The library's wall-reveal-moves style B already has the whole-page blueprint version (full-screen wireframe drawn segment by segment + regions lighting up); this card is its element-level close-up — one line, one subject, one closure, the nib visible and the direction readable, suited to the "we'll talk about this next" naming moment. The second use is a title underline growing: the same recipe in an 18-frame short version, giving the key word a hand-drawn emphasis, a natural sibling of the marker-pen aesthetic token.
cards.energyEn: Medium

cards.name: element-body-moves
cards.summary: 元素身体感——contact-shadow-lift 接触阴影离面抬升：卡抬起时桌上的阴影同步放大变淡，纸片离桌被阴影证明
cards.use: 给"位置在变"之外补"身体在变"：卡片点名给悬浮证据；配 2.5D 运镜与逐张点名
cards.energy: A 低中
cards.intention: 库内运动卡全在管"位置在变"——飞入、滑动、弹跳，元素本身始终是刚体。 这一式管**身体在变**：给悬浮一个可信的证据——卡抬起时正下方阴影同步放大变淡， 纸片离桌，staging 法则给 2.5D 运镜垫的物理台词。与 CameraMotionBlur 的区别： 快门拖影是相机的事，离面抬升是身体的事。

styles.label: contact-shadow-lift
styles.description: 元素身体感——contact-shadow-lift 接触阴影离面抬升：卡抬起时桌上的阴影同步放大变淡，纸片离桌被阴影证明
styles.use: 逐张点名强调；2.5D 段落的离面铺垫
styles.descriptionEn: A card lifts off the page with a growing, fading contact shadow beneath, then drops back with a tiny squash.

cards.summaryEn: A contact shadow that separates during lift, giving interface elements physical weight.
cards.useEn: Adding "the body changes" to "the position changes": card call-outs given floating evidence; pairs with 2.5D camera moves and one-by-one naming
cards.intentionEn: Every motion card in the library manages "the position changes" — flying in, sliding, bouncing, while the element itself stays a rigid body. This style manages the body changing: giving hover credible evidence — when the card lifts, the shadow directly below it simultaneously grows and softens; the paper leaves the table; the physical line the staging rule lays under a 2.5D camera move. The difference from CameraMotionBlur: shutter smear is the camera's business, lifting off the surface is the body's business.
cards.energyEn: A low-medium

cards.name: flying-words
cards.summary: 22 个关键词按黄金角铺在扁椭圆截面上，沿 z 轴从远处飞到相机前擦身而过，透明度走 [0,1,0.5,0.2,0] 生命曲线，跑满 2 整圈首尾无缝
cards.use: 关键词云/能力清单的动态背景；片头片尾的"信息量"垫底层；需要纵深穿越感的转场
cards.duration: 约 6.0s（180f@30fps，2 个完整循环，可无缝接续）
cards.energy: 高（全屏持续 3D 位移，画面无一刻静止）
cards.intention: 关键词列举最土的做法是堆一屏静态词云。词语隧道把同一批词**摊到时间轴上**： 远处生成、由小变大、擦过镜头消失，观众永远只在读三五个词，但主观感受是 "词很多"。它是背景层不是主角层——相机不动、元素动，所以前景压一层标题 或 UI 完全不打架。词表整体替换成项目关键词即可，不改一行运动逻辑。

styles.label: flying-words
styles.description: 22 个关键词按黄金角铺在扁椭圆截面上，沿 z 轴从远处飞到相机前擦身而过，透明度走 [0,1,0.5,0.2,0] 生命曲线，跑满 2 整圈首尾无缝
styles.descriptionEn: Keywords spawn deep in a perspective tunnel and rush past the camera along the z axis, fading in and out on a lifecycle curve across two seamless loops.

cards.summaryEn: Keywords spawn deep in a perspective tunnel and rush past the camera along the z axis, fading in and out on a lifecycle curve across two seamless loops.
cards.useEn: A dynamic background for keyword clouds / capability lists; the "information volume" underlay for heads and tails; transitions that need a sense of depth travel
cards.intentionEn: The crudest way to list keywords is a screenful of static word cloud. The word tunnel spreads the same batch of words across the timeline: generated far away, growing as they approach, wiping past the lens and gone — the audience only ever reads three or five words at a time, yet the subjective feeling is "there are many words". It is a background layer, not a star layer — the camera does not move, the elements do, so overlaying a title or UI in the foreground never collides. Swap the word list wholesale for the project's keywords; not one line of motion logic changes.
cards.energyEn: High (full-screen continuous 3D displacement; the frame is never still)

cards.name: fracture
cards.summary: 5×5 瓦片从 3D 碎片态按中心波纹逐圈聚合成整面海报，停一拍亮字，随后全部碎片背离中心加速旋转飞出画面
cards.use: 开场第一镜"从混沌到成形"的品牌/海报揭示；倒放或只取后半可作硬转场
cards.energy: 高（两头高能、中段静止，适合压 BGM 重音起收）
cards.intention: 把"产品成形"拍成物理事件：碎片从三维空间各自带着旋转飞回原位，观众看着一面完整画面从无序中长出来；hold 读字后再整体炸出画面，把注意力干净地交给下一镜。进出对称，一支素材可正反两用。

styles.label: fracture
styles.description: 5×5 瓦片从 3D 碎片态按中心波纹逐圈聚合成整面海报，停一拍亮字，随后全部碎片背离中心加速旋转飞出画面
styles.descriptionEn: Twenty-five 3D tiles fly in from scattered space and lock into a poster in a center-out ripple, hold for a beat, then accelerate outward off-screen in all directions.

cards.summaryEn: Twenty-five 3D tiles fly in from scattered space and lock into a poster in a center-out ripple, hold for a beat, then accelerate outward off-screen in all directions.
cards.useEn: A brand / poster reveal of "from chaos to form" for the opening shot; played backwards or taking only the second half it works as a hard transition
cards.intentionEn: Shoot "the product takes form" as a physical event: fragments fly back to their places from 3D space each with its own rotation, and the audience watches a complete frame grow out of disorder; after the hold reads the text, the whole thing explodes out of frame, handing attention cleanly to the next shot. Entrance and exit are symmetric — one asset usable forwards and backwards.
cards.energyEn: High (high energy at both ends, still in the middle; suited to hitting BGM accents at start and end)

cards.name: fui-hud-moves
cards.summary: FUI/HUD 准星咬合——reticle-lock-on 四个 L 形角标组成的取景框从画外飞入、超调回弹后咬合锁定目标
cards.use: 任何"看这里"的目标点名（替代箭头圈红，画面不冻结）
cards.energy: 中高（咬合帧是打击点）
cards.intention: 科幻虚构界面（Jarvis/Territory）里可中性化的母题：运动中的捕获。 四个 L 形角标从画外冲入、超调回弹、"咔"地咬合到目标元素四角+弹标签 ——与 freeze-annotate 分工：那卡冻结画面标注，本卡在流动中点名。

styles.label: reticle-lock-on
styles.description: FUI/HUD 准星咬合——reticle-lock-on 四个 L 形角标组成的取景框从画外飞入、超调回弹后咬合锁定目标
styles.use: 目标点名；踩音效重拍
styles.descriptionEn: Four corner brackets fly in and clamp onto the target with an overshoot snap; the target brightens and its label pops.

cards.summaryEn: A reticle that assembles itself around a target and locks on.
cards.useEn: Any "look here" target call-out (replacing red circles-and-arrows without freezing the frame)
cards.intentionEn: A motif from sci-fi fictional UIs (Jarvis/Territory) that can be neutralised: capture in motion. Four L-shaped corner marks rush in from off-screen, overshoot and rebound, and "click" onto the four corners of the target element + pop a label — division of labour with freeze-annotate: that card freezes the frame to annotate, this one names the target while everything keeps flowing.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (the bite frame is the hit)

cards.name: gauge-readout-moves
cards.summary: 仪表读数两式——needle-sweep-selftest 满弧扫针（点火自检指针甩满全弧再回落真值）与 tape-scroll-fixed-pointer 滚带定针（针不动刻度带滚过+冲刺刹车）
cards.use: dashboard 开场仪式/性能指标揭晓；A 多表盘开机感，B 单指标大跳变
cards.energy: 中高（机械仪式型）
cards.intention: 把"报数值"做成仪表的身体动作：A 是汽车点火自检——卡片里三个并排表盘 指针先"唰"地甩满全弧（270°）、扫过的刻度依次点亮，再弹簧回落定格真实值， 多表错峰成波浪，落定同帧盘下数值弹出，先亮量程再报数，开场宣誓感； B 是飞机空速带语法——读数窗 + 指针钉死画面中线，贯穿全画高的刻度带整体从窗后滚过，先顶着旧上限慢爬、升级后冲刺 （峰值 ~100px/f）、末尾 spring 刹车带回摆过冲，"世界动、针不动"， 数值大小变成看得见的位移距离。

styles.label: needle-sweep-selftest
styles.description: 指针去程 ~12f ease-out 甩满弧，回程 ~20f 带 5-8° 过冲回摆落真值；多表错峰 3-5f；落定同帧盘下数值弹出
styles.use: dashboard 开场/系统就绪仪式
styles.descriptionEn: Ignition self-test: gauge needles slam to full arc, then swing back with overshoot to their true values, staggered across dials.

styles.label: tape-scroll-fixed-pointer
styles.description: 长刻度带 translate：慢爬段→45px/f 冲刺 ~25f→spring 刹车过冲回摆停位；窗内读数同步刷新
styles.use: 单指标大跳变（性能翻倍/配额提升）
styles.descriptionEn: The pointer holds still while a long scale tape crawls, sprints at 45px/f, and spring-brakes onto the final reading.

cards.summaryEn: Two instrument reads: a full-range needle self-test and a moving scale that races beneath a fixed pointer.
cards.useEn: Dashboard opening rituals / performance-metric reveals; A is the many-dials power-on feel, B is a single metric's big jump
cards.intentionEn: Turn "reporting a number" into the gauge's physical action: A is a car's ignition self-test — three side-by-side dials in a card, needles first whoosh across the full arc (270°), the swept ticks lighting up in turn, then spring back and settle on the real value, multiple dials staggered into a wave, and on settling the numbers below the dials pop in the same frame: light the range first, report the number second — the opening oath feel. B is aircraft airspeed-tape grammar — a readout window with the needle pinned to the frame's centre line, while the full-height tape rolls past behind the window, first crawling against the old ceiling, then sprinting after the upgrade (peak ~100px/f), ending with a spring brake that swings back past the stop: "the world moves, the needle doesn't", and the size of the number becomes a visible distance of travel.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (mechanical-ritual type)

cards.name: glass-pill-dictation-typing
cards.summary: 一条定宽玻璃胶囊以约 1.25 倍略大弹出后缓落到位，内部自左淡到右浓铺一层强调色暖光；光标先行、随后匀速打出听写句，光（连同胶囊背后的环境光）随打字进度渐渐退去，收尾成一条中性的磨砂玻璃条
cards.use: 语音/AI 输入框的登场；"跟它说话"的交互提示镜头；高能段之间的一个安静过渡拍
cards.energy: 低（全片最安静的一拍，只有光在退）
cards.intention: 用"光随输入熄灭"讲一件很小的事：待命时它在发光（等你说话），你一开口 它就把光让给文字。3.3s 里只做三件事——弹出、打字、光退。任何额外动作 （弹跳、色变、图标动画）都会让这一拍不再是休止符。

styles.label: glass-pill-dictation-typing
styles.description: 一条定宽玻璃胶囊以约 1.25 倍略大弹出后缓落到位，内部自左淡到右浓铺一层强调色暖光；光标先行、随后匀速打出听写句，光（连同胶囊背后的环境光）随打字进度渐渐退去，收尾成一条中性的磨砂玻璃条
styles.descriptionEn: A fixed-width glass pill pops in slightly oversized and settles, glowing with an accent gradient inside that fades out as a placeholder sentence types across it.

cards.summaryEn: A fixed-width glass pill pops in slightly oversized and settles, glowing with an accent gradient inside that fades out as a placeholder sentence types across it.
cards.useEn: The entrance of a voice / AI input box; an interaction-prompt shot for "talk to it"; a quiet transition beat between high-energy passages
cards.intentionEn: "The light goes out as you type" tells a very small story: on standby it glows (waiting for you to speak), and the moment you start it hands the light over to the text. In 3.3s it does only three things — pop in, type, light recedes. Any extra motion (bounce, colour change, icon animation) and this beat stops being a rest.
cards.energyEn: Low (the quietest beat in the film; only the light recedes)

cards.name: glitch-cycle
cards.summary: 同一行等宽槽位循环轮播 4 条状态短语，每条头尾按概率关键帧 [1,0,0,0.1,0,0,1] 全乱码、中段偶发单字抖动，切换瞬间叠 RGB 分离与整行位移；末条概率收 0 保证收尾干净
cards.use: 加载/构建/部署过程的状态播报；技术型片头的"系统自述"；需要机器口吻推进时间的一段垫底
cards.duration: 约 5.6s（168f@30fps；demo 每条短语 38f，末条延续到片尾作收尾 hold）
cards.energy: 中高（持续的高频噪声脉冲，切换点是峰值）
cards.intention: 状态播报最笨的做法是四行字逐条淡入。轮播把它们压进**一个槽位**： 短语头尾用乱码"熔断"再"凝固"，中段几乎干净只偶尔抽一下——观众读到的 是"系统在一步步推进"，而不是四条独立文案。乱码浓度是这卡的语法： 浓 = 正在切换，淡 = 正在这一状态里。底部进度条把四拍串成一条时间线， 最后一条把概率收到 0，落定即结束。

styles.label: glitch-cycle
styles.description: 同一行等宽槽位循环轮播 4 条状态短语，每条头尾按概率关键帧 [1,0,0,0.1,0,0,1] 全乱码、中段偶发单字抖动，切换瞬间叠 RGB 分离与整行位移；末条概率收 0 保证收尾干净
styles.descriptionEn: Status phrases cycle through one monospace slot, each dissolving into noise at both ends with RGB split and jitter, while a progress bar tracks the whole run.

cards.summaryEn: Status phrases cycle through one monospace slot, each dissolving into noise at both ends with RGB split and jitter, while a progress bar tracks the whole run.
cards.useEn: Status reporting for load / build / deploy processes; the "system self-narration" of a technical film head; an underlay that needs a machine voice to advance time
cards.intentionEn: The dumbest status report is four lines fading in one by one. The carousel compresses them into one slot: phrase heads and tails "melt" then "freeze" through glitch noise, the middle almost clean with only an occasional twitch — the audience reads "the system is advancing step by step", not four independent captions. Glitch density is this card's grammar: thick = switching, thin = settling into this state. The bottom progress bar strings the four beats into one timeline, the last entry draws the probability to 0, and landing means the end.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (continuous high-frequency noise pulses; the switch points are the peaks)

cards.name: glow-flyline-moves
cards.summary: 暗场光斑与飞线三式——glow-orb-ambient 光斑底噪、flyline-arc 飞线连接、orb-flyline-relay 同帧共振组合
cards.use: 全片唯一暗场段落的氛围与数据叙事：铺底噪用 A、讲数据流向用 B、要背景给前景搭腔用 C；Linear 官网味
cards.energy: A 低（底噪级）/ B 中 / C 中高
cards.intention: 这是库内第一张整卡住在**暗场**的卡。白底提亮不可见判例反过来读就是： 要玩光，先去暗场。A 是空间的呼吸——深色底三团大光斑有机漂移，从中央 磨砂玻璃卡背后游过、颜色透过玻璃染进卡面，卡缘随最近光斑靠近而泛光， 背景不再是死的；B 是数据的动词——发光弧线从 A 卡"打"到 B 卡， 亮点头领跑、渐隐光尾，落点描边脉冲点亮，指标关联第一次有了方向；C 是 A+B 的焊接——飞线落点帧邻近光斑同帧涨亮一拍， 氛围层与事件层**同帧共振**，互相搭腔而非各演各的（组合命门：拆开共振帧 就退化成两张卡并置）。

styles.label: glow-orb-ambient
styles.description: 三团 500-700px radial 光斑 + blur(100px)，双正弦漂移；卡缘辉光按光斑距离 [180,720]px→[1,0] 加权取 max 驱动
styles.use: 暗场段落铺底；卡呼吸感
styles.descriptionEn: Three huge blurred glow orbs drift on twin sine paths, driving edge-light on nearby cards by distance.

styles.label: flyline-arc
styles.description: 手写 bezier 100 段采样，22f out-cubic 生长；光头条件挂载领跑，段 opacity 按离头距离渐隐；落点描边脉冲，可接力
styles.use: 数据流向/指标关联；dashboard 叙事
styles.descriptionEn: A glowing head draws a bezier flyline between cards in 22 frames, the tail fading behind it; the endpoint pulses on arrival.

styles.label: orb-flyline-relay
styles.description: A+B 焊接：光斑 surge 与卡脉冲共用落点帧，涨亮 1+1.6×surge、5f 起升 15f 消散
styles.use: 暗场高光段；三卡接力收束
styles.descriptionEn: Orbs and flylines welded together: a background orb surges on the exact frame its flyline lands, so backdrop answers foreground.

cards.summaryEn: Three dark-scene accents: ambient glow orbs, connecting flight arcs, and a synchronized orb-to-line relay.
cards.useEn: The atmosphere and data story of the film's only dark-ground passage: ambience noise in A, data flow direction in B, background answering the foreground in C; the Linear website flavour
cards.intentionEn: This is the first card in the library that lives entirely in a dark ground. The tested rule "brightening is invisible on white" read in reverse: to play with light, go to the dark ground first. A is the space breathing — three large light blobs drift organically over the dark ground, swimming behind the central frosted-glass card, their colours bleeding through the glass into the card face, the card edge glowing as the nearest blob approaches — the background is no longer dead. B is the verb of data — glowing arcs "shoot" from card A to card B, the bright head leading with a fading light tail, the landing point's outline pulsing on: metric relationships have direction for the first time. C is A+B welded together — at the arc's landing frame the neighbouring blob brightens in the same frame; the atmosphere layer and the event layer resonate in the same frame, answering each other rather than each performing alone (combination make-or-break: split the resonance frames and it degenerates into two cards side by side).
cards.energyEn: A low (floor-noise level) / B medium / C medium-high

cards.name: gradient-transition
cards.summary: 背景在 linear、radial、conic 三类 CSS 渐变间平滑过渡——角度、色标、中心、半径逐参数插值，段间交叉淡化换类型
cards.use: 氛围底/章节底色的连续变奏；给静态排版段落提供"活着"的背景层
cards.energy: 低（纯背景运动，为前景内容让路）
cards.intention: 渐变不是静态贴图而是可动画的参数集：同类型渐变内部任何参数都能插值出丝滑变化，跨类型则用短交叉淡化衔接。作背景层用，给"没有主体运动"的段落一层持续的低速能量。

styles.label: gradient-transition
styles.description: 背景在 linear、radial、conic 三类 CSS 渐变间平滑过渡——角度、色标、中心、半径逐参数插值，段间交叉淡化换类型
styles.descriptionEn: The background morphs smoothly through linear, radial, and conic CSS gradients — angle, color stops, center, and radius each interpolated per-parameter with narrow cross-fades between types.

cards.summaryEn: The background morphs smoothly through linear, radial, and conic CSS gradients — angle, color stops, center, and radius each interpolated per-parameter with narrow cross-fades between types.
cards.useEn: Continuous variations on atmosphere grounds / section colours; a "living" background layer for static typographic passages
cards.intentionEn: Gradients are not static textures but animatable parameter sets: within one gradient type every parameter interpolates into silky change, while crossing types joins with a short cross-fade. Used as a background layer it gives passages with "no subject motion" a layer of continuous low-speed energy.
cards.energyEn: Low (pure background motion, yielding to the foreground content)

cards.name: gradient-word-sweep
cards.summary: 黑底标语里关键词被渐变彩光从左到右快速扫过"充能"——波前字符辉光最强向后衰减，填满后字符间勾连细紫红闪电、整词稳态泛光呼吸
cards.use: 标语里给单个动词/卖点词充能（Supercharged/faster/AI…）；能量高潮段的文字戏；黑场品牌片的口号帧
cards.duration: 扫充 ~15–20f（要快）+ 稳态闪电呼吸 1–2s；全段 2.5–3.5s
cards.energy: 高（一词爆点，前后都该让位）
cards.intention: 整句白字里只有关键词被"通电"：渐变彩光从左到右快速扫过字符， 像能量注入——扫过的瞬间最亮（波前尾迹），随后衰减到稳态； 填满后字符之间跳起勾连的细闪电，词保持泛光呼吸。三个命门： **快**（扫充 15–20f，慢了读作进度条）、**波前最亮**（刚点亮的 字符效果最强，没有这个梯度就是静态渐变裁切）、**辉光克制** （AE 式多层泛光但别糊成一团，闪电细而稀疏才是点缀）。

styles.label: gradient-word-sweep
styles.description: 黑底标语里关键词被渐变彩光从左到右快速扫过"充能"——波前字符辉光最强向后衰减，填满后字符间勾连细紫红闪电、整词稳态泛光呼吸
styles.descriptionEn: A gradient light sweeps left to right across a keyword, charging each character with glow that decays behind the wavefront until the whole word breathes.

cards.summaryEn: A gradient light sweeps left to right across a keyword, charging each character with glow that decays behind the wavefront until the whole word breathes.
cards.useEn: Charging a single verb / selling word in a slogan (Supercharged / faster / AI…); the text play of the energy-peak passage; the slogan frame of a dark-ground brand film
cards.intentionEn: In a line of white words only the keyword gets "electrified": gradient colour light sweeps quickly across the characters left to right, like energy injection — brightest at the instant of the sweep (wave-front trail), then decaying to a steady state; once filled, thin linking lightning jumps between the characters while the word keeps a glow breathing. Three make-or-breaks: fast (fill in 15–20 frames; slower reads as a progress bar), wave-front brightest (just-lit characters get the strongest effect; without this gradient it is a static gradient crop), and restrained glow (AE-style multi-layer bloom but do not smear into a blob — thin, sparse lightning is the garnish).
cards.energyEn: High (one word's burst point; everything before and after should yield)

cards.name: grain-dissolve
cards.summary: 整行字爆裂成沸腾颗粒噪点并浮现斜纹选区框，噪点云急速凝聚成更大号发光短字标，位移衰减归零定格
cards.use: 收尾"XX. Now Live"式上线宣告；长句信息压缩成品牌短标的能量聚合拍
cards.energy: 中高（短促、一次性的能量脉冲，天然的 outro 卡点）
cards.intention: 把"一句话浓缩成一个词"拍成物理事件：句子先失稳沸腾成颗粒（信息解体），选区框暗示"正在选中提取"，然后所有颗粒能量向中心坍缩成更大更亮的短字标——观众读到的是"这一切归结为它"。

styles.label: grain-dissolve
styles.description: 整行字爆裂成沸腾颗粒噪点并浮现斜纹选区框，噪点云急速凝聚成更大号发光短字标，位移衰减归零定格
styles.descriptionEn: A clean line of text boils into displaced grain noise inside a hatched selection frame, then the particle cloud condenses into a larger glowing wordmark that locks sharp.

cards.summaryEn: A clean line of text boils into displaced grain noise inside a hatched selection frame, then the particle cloud condenses into a larger glowing wordmark that locks sharp.
cards.useEn: "XX. Now Live"-style launch announcements for the outro; the energy-aggregation beat that compresses a long sentence into a brand short-mark
cards.intentionEn: Shoot "one sentence compressed into one word" as a physical event: the sentence first destabilises and boils into grains (information disintegrating), a selection box hints "extracting", then all the grains' energy collapses toward the centre into a bigger, brighter short word-mark — the audience reads "all of this comes down to it".
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (short, one-shot energy pulse; a natural outro downbeat)

cards.name: graze-face-tour
cards.summary: 大倾角贴面游走特写——镜头贴着 UI 表面低飞掠过（侧栏树/顶栏/列表当地形），页面文字初始悬浮在界面上空带同形软影，随镜头行进先后加速贴落回界面
cards.use: 功能区巡礼（把 UI 当地景飞掠）；配合暗场+霓虹缘光做产品"内部世界"段落；界面内容逐区登场
cards.energy: 中高（运镜持续推进+元素连续落位，信息密度高）
cards.intention: 把 UI 拍成地形：大倾角特写让侧栏树、导航、列表行变成掠过的地貌， 浅景深强化"贴面"。戏眼是**文字空中贴落**：文字/组件不是原地淡入， 而是悬浮在界面上空（3D z 轴抬高），在空中时往界面投同形软影， 随镜头行进先后加速贴落、影子随高度收敛消失——观众看见界面在 镜头经过时"完成自己"。影子是可感命门：没有影子，悬浮读作 普通位移入场；有影子，空间关系瞬间成立。

styles.label: graze-face-tour
styles.description: 大倾角贴面游走特写——镜头贴着 UI 表面低飞掠过（侧栏树/顶栏/列表当地形），页面文字初始悬浮在界面上空带同形软影，随镜头行进先后加速贴落回界面
styles.descriptionEn: The camera skims low across the UI surface like terrain while page text hovers above the interface and settles down as the shot advances.

cards.summaryEn: The camera skims low across the UI surface like terrain while page text hovers above the interface and settles down as the shot advances.
cards.useEn: A tour of functional areas (flying past the UI as landscape); pairs with a dark ground + neon rim light for the product's "inner world" passage; interface content arriving zone by zone
cards.intentionEn: Shoot the UI as terrain: a steep close-up turns the sidebar tree, nav and list rows into swept landscape, and shallow depth of field reinforces "grazing the surface".
