The key move is words landing from mid-air: text / components do not fade in place, they hover above the interface (raised on the 3D z axis), casting same-shaped soft shadows onto the interface while airborne, then accelerate and land in sequence as the camera travels, the shadows converging and vanishing with height — the audience sees the interface "completing itself" as the lens passes. The shadow is the make-or-break you can feel: without it, hovering reads as an ordinary displacement entrance; with it, the spatial relationship is established instantly.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (the camera keeps pushing forward + elements land continuously; high information density)

cards.name: hashtag-to-pill-materialize
cards.summary: 话题词打字实体化——居中打出 "#word"（红实心光标恒亮），1 帧硬切变成宽大胶囊标签，hold 后缩小左移落到页面标签位，再 1 帧硬切揭示成品页；"两次硬切一次滑动"的节奏骨架
cards.use: 标签/分类/关键词功能的演示段（笔记 app 打 tag、话题聚合）；"输入 → 变成 UI 实体 → 归位到成品"的三段式叙事
cards.duration: 120f（4s）——打字 ~40f + 硬切胶囊 hold ~18f + 缩移 ~14f + 硬切揭示后静置 ~1.2s（原片 18–21.5s）
cards.energy: 中（干脆利落，靠硬切给劲，不靠弹跳）
cards.intention: 文字变实体的常规做法是渐变/morph/展开，原片帧级拆解证明 Bear 反着 来：**实体化是 1 帧硬切**——上一帧还是文字+光标，下一帧就是完整 胶囊，无展开无 cross-fade 无回弹。硬切给的是"啪、成了"的确定感， 任何渐变都会把"实体"软化成"特效"。全段骨架是**两次硬切夹一次 滑动**：硬切实体化 → 平滑缩移归位 → 硬切揭示成品页。唯一的连续 运动（缩移）被两记硬切框住，才显得又快又稳。这个节奏骨架是命门， 三段挪动任何一段的性质（把硬切改渐变、把滑动改硬切）整卡就塌。

styles.label: hashtag-to-pill-materialize
styles.description: 话题词打字实体化——居中打出 "#word"（红实心光标恒亮），1 帧硬切变成宽大胶囊标签，hold 后缩小左移落到页面标签位，再 1 帧硬切揭示成品页；"两次硬切一次滑动"的节奏骨架
styles.descriptionEn: A typed "#word" hard-cuts into a wide pill tag, holds, shrinks into its slot on the page, then hard-cuts again to reveal the finished view.

cards.summaryEn: A typed "#word" hard-cuts into a wide pill tag, holds, shrinks into its slot on the page, then hard-cuts again to reveal the finished view.
cards.useEn: Demo passages for tag / category / keyword features (tagging in a notes app, topic aggregation); the three-beat narrative of "type → become a UI entity → settle into the finished page"
cards.intentionEn: The conventional way to turn text into an entity is gradient / morph / expand, but the original's frame-by-frame breakdown shows Bear does the opposite: materialisation is a one-frame hard cut — one frame it is text + cursor, the next it is a complete pill, no expand, no cross-fade, no rebound. The hard cut gives the certainty of "snap, done", while any gradient softens the "entity" into a "special effect". The whole passage's skeleton is two hard cuts bracketing one slide: hard-cut materialise → smooth scale-move into place → hard-cut reveal of the finished page. The only continuous motion (the scale-move) is framed by two hard cuts, which is what makes it read as both fast and steady. This rhythm skeleton is the make-or-break: change the nature of any of the three beats (hard cuts to gradients, slide to a hard cut) and the whole card collapses.
cards.energyEn: Medium (crisp and sharp; the punch comes from the hard cuts, not from bounce)

cards.name: icon-field-colorize
cards.summary: 灰阶小图标点阵错峰浮现铺满全屏，停一拍后多道品牌色横带波纹极快向下扫翻全场——"功能全景先摆满，品牌一瞬间点亮"的开场/收束卡
cards.use: 开场铺陈产品能力面（图标=功能宇宙）再一举打上品牌色；功能集合页、生态/集成规模展示、片头 logo 前垫场
cards.duration: 浮现 ~45f 错峰 + 静置 ~10f + 翻色 12–45f + 终态静置；全段 3–6s（demo 170f：翻色走 30f 档 + 标题落版 + 终态 hold 1s）
cards.energy: 中（浮现是铺垫，翻色瞬间是唯一爆点）
cards.intention: 先用灰阶把"多"摆足——上百个小图标错峰浮进来铺满画面，灰阶保证 读作背景纹理不抢戏；停一拍让观众意识到"摆满了"，然后品牌色以 横带波纹形式极快扫过全场，灰世界一瞬间被点亮。命门在**翻色不是 同帧硬翻**：原片实测是 ~0.5s 内多道色波依次向下快扫（蓝先覆盖全场， 橙/绿/红依次覆盖更低行带），终态呈四色横带分层——波纹感让"点亮" 有方向和速度，硬翻只读作换了张图。

styles.label: icon-field-colorize
styles.description: 灰阶小图标点阵错峰浮现铺满全屏，停一拍后多道品牌色横带波纹极快向下扫翻全场——"功能全景先摆满，品牌一瞬间点亮"的开场/收束卡
styles.descriptionEn: A grid of grayscale icons staggers in to fill the screen, holds a beat, then brand-color bands ripple down and light the whole field at once.

cards.summaryEn: A grid of grayscale icons staggers in to fill the screen, holds a beat, then brand-color bands ripple down and light the whole field at once.
cards.useEn: Laying out the product's capability surface in the opener (icons = the feature universe) then striking the brand colour across it all at once; feature-set pages, ecosystem / integration scale showcases, the warm-up before a film-head logo
cards.intentionEn: First lay out "many" in greyscale — a hundred-plus small icons float in in stagger and fill the frame, greyscale guaranteeing they read as background texture without stealing the show; hold a beat so the audience registers "it's full", then the brand colour sweeps across everything as horizontal ripple bands, and the grey world lights up in an instant. The make-or-break: the colour sweep is not a same-frame hard flip — the original measures ~0.5s of multiple colour waves ripping downward in sequence (blue covers the whole field first, orange / green / red sweep over successive lower bands in turn), ending as a four-colour horizontal stratification — the ripple is what gives "lighting up" direction and speed; a hard flip only reads as swapping to another picture.
cards.energyEn: Medium (the float-in is setup; the colour sweep instant is the only burst)

cards.name: icon-performance-moves
cards.summary: 图标表演——attention-bounce 求关注弹跳（图标连跳递增+落地压扁+镜头被吸引）
cards.use: 半屏级 icon 特写段落；新功能引出
cards.energy: 蓄势引入
cards.intention: 库内图标动画品类首批入库：icon 是镜头怼着拍的表演者，不是 UI 角落的 微交互。attention-bounce 是 macOS Dock 语汇——Dock 里的 Motion Studio app 图标原地连跳 4 次一次比一次高（0.35→1.2 倍 icon 高），每次落地压扁 （末跳宽 1.2x 高 0.8x）+涟漪溅点，邻居图标逐渐失焦、跳最高那下镜头向它 轻推 8%（被吸引），落定后弹开「New in Motion Studio」功能面板——把"用户注意力" 剪进叙事。

styles.label: attention-bounce
styles.description: 图标表演——attention-bounce 求关注弹跳（图标连跳递增+落地压扁+镜头被吸引）
styles.use: 新功能引出："看我"→镜头看它→它开面板
styles.descriptionEn: An icon bounces with growing height, squashing on each landing with dust puffs, until the camera leans in and a panel pops.

cards.summaryEn: An escalating attention bounce that compresses on landing to call the eye to an icon.
cards.useEn: Half-screen icon close-up passages; introducing a new feature
cards.intentionEn: The first entries in the library's icon-animation category: the icon is a performer shot straight-on by the camera, not a micro-interaction in a UI corner. attention-bounce is macOS Dock vocabulary — the Motion Studio app icon in the Dock bounces 4 times in place, each bounce higher than the last (0.35 → 1.2× icon height), squashing on every landing (final bounce 1.2× wide, 0.8× tall) + ripple splash, while neighbouring icons gradually defocus and at the highest bounce the camera pushes 8% toward it (drawn in); after settling it pops open a "New in Motion Studio" panel — cutting "user attention" straight into the narrative.
cards.energyEn: Building-up intro

cards.name: impact-feedback
cards.summary: 命中反馈两式——hit-counter 连招计数（顿帧+伤害数字+combo 跳字）、anime-impact 动漫打击帧（负片+集中线+色散）
cards.use: 元素落位/撞击的"命中一瞬"——给砸入、撞停加游戏级手感；按强度阶梯选式
cards.duration: n/a（元素级技法，寄生在落位动作上；各式占用帧数见参数表）
cards.energy: 高（瞬时冲击）
cards.intention: 元素砸到位却没有"砸到了"的一瞬，落位读作 PPT 飞入。游戏 juice （Vlambeer screenshake 理论）与动漫演出 impact frames 给了同一答案： 命中的那几帧把时间咬住，冲量才传到观众手上。两式是一条强度阶梯： B 用局部顿帧叠伤害数字和 combo 跳字，把功能清单剪成一套连招， 叙事感最强；C 是最重的一拳——撞停 3 帧翻负片炸集中线，强调级最高、 最风格化。

styles.label: hit-counter 连招计数
styles.description: 三卡接连砸入，每命中 = 顿帧 2f + 伤害数字上浮 + ×N 计数跳字逐次加码
styles.use: 功能点连打段--"功能很多"用连招讲；游戏化语言浓
styles.descriptionEn: Three cards slam in one after another; every hit freezes 2 frames, floats damage digits, and bumps the combo counter.

styles.label: anime-impact 打击帧
styles.description: crash-zoom 撞停的 3f 整幅负片反色 + 放射集中线 + 红青色散，第 4f 全撤
styles.use: 全片唯一高潮的那一拳；强调级封顶
styles.descriptionEn: On the crash-zoom stop: 3 frames of full-screen negative, radial speed lines, and red-cyan fringing, all gone by frame 4.

cards.summaryEn: Two impact layers: a combo counter with damage feedback, and a full anime-style impact frame.
cards.useEn: The "hit instant" of an element landing / colliding — adding game-grade feel to slams and impact stops; pick a style by the intensity ladder
cards.intentionEn: An element slams into place without the instant of "it hit", and the landing reads as a PowerPoint fly-in. Game juice (Vlambeer's screenshake theory) and anime production impact frames give the same answer: the few frames of the hit bite down on time, and only then does the impulse reach the audience. The two styles are an intensity ladder: B stacks a local freeze-frame with damage numbers and combo jump-text, cutting a feature list into a combo string — the strongest sense of narrative; C is the heaviest punch — a 3-frame impact stop with negative-image flip and exploding speed lines, the highest emphasis level and the most stylised.
cards.energyEn: High (instantaneous impact)

cards.name: integration-hub-map
cards.summary: 旧页面一次性快翻 180°（侧棱瞬间亮闪）落成新中枢页，五个集成 app 图标同帧弹现、随即五条彩虹光管同帧齐连，光管内输送脉冲持续流动——"翻开新一页，生态一齐接入"
cards.use: 集成/生态能力段（一个产品连一切）；版本翻新叙事（旧页翻成新页）；暗场霓虹调性的功能高潮
cards.duration: 前摇 ~0.5s + 快翻 ~1.2s + 图标齐现 → 光管齐连两拍 ~0.7s + 输送呼吸 ≥1.5s；全段 4.5–5s
cards.energy: 中高（翻面是爆点，输送段是余韵）
cards.intention: 翻面是"换时代"：旧文档页整个翻转 180° 得到新中枢页——必须是 完整翻面不是转个角度（判例），翻的动作**快翻+尾段减速**、一口气 完成无分段停顿（"匀速"判例：用户说的匀速=无停顿，不是字面 linear；90° 侧棱停顿版被裁）。侧棱时刻只"闪一下"（1–3f 脉冲， 长光晕平台被裁）。接入是**两拍制**：五图标同帧弹现（第一拍）→ 五管同帧起画齐连（第二拍）——齐，才读作"生态一次到位"；错峰 逐个连读作逐个谈判（两轮被裁）。连通后光管内亮脉冲沿图标→中枢 方向持续循环，"输送感"是终态的生命。

styles.label: integration-hub-map
styles.description: 旧页面一次性快翻 180°（侧棱瞬间亮闪）落成新中枢页，五个集成 app 图标同帧弹现、随即五条彩虹光管同帧齐连，光管内输送脉冲持续流动——"翻开新一页，生态一齐接入"
styles.descriptionEn: A page flips 180 degrees into an integration hub where five app icons pop in together and rainbow light tubes connect with pulses flowing through them.

cards.summaryEn: A page flips 180 degrees into an integration hub where five app icons pop in together and rainbow light tubes connect with pulses flowing through them.
cards.useEn: Integration / ecosystem capability passages (one product connects everything); version-renewal narratives (the old page flips into the new one); the dark-ground neon feature climax
cards.intentionEn: The flip is "changing eras": the old document page rotates a full 180° into the new hub page — it must be a complete flip, not a tilted angle (tested rule); the flip motion is fast with a tail deceleration, done in one breath with no segmented pauses (the "constant speed" rule: what the user means by constant speed is no pauses, not literally linear; the 90° edge-on pause version was cut). At the edge-on moment it only "flashes" once (a 1–3 frame pulse; the long glow platform was cut). The connection is a two-beat structure: five icons pop in the same frame (beat one) → five tubes start drawing and connect all at once (beat two) — all together, that is what reads as "the ecosystem arrived in one go"; staggered one-by-one connections read as one-by-one negotiations (two rounds cut). After connecting, bright pulses keep cycling along the tubes in the icon → hub direction; the sense of "delivery" is the life of the final state.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (the flip is the burst; the delivery passage is the after-ring)

cards.name: lead-word-zoom-assemble
cards.summary: 首词以 2.3 倍字号占据画面中央、hold 期间继续推近 6%，随后一条曲线同时完成「缩回终字号」与「整行左滑归位」，后续词各自从槽位右侧 0.5em 被推进来；支点横向钉首词中心、纵向钉基线（挂载时实测），整行上移的同一时窗副行浮出，停一拍后整幕 crash-zoom 推近失焦交棒
cards.use: 品牌名/产品名的 Introducing 字卡；发布会式开场第二镜；一句话主张需要"先让一个词占满画面、再把整句补齐"的场合
cards.duration: 约 2.8s（84f@30fps；组句 f36 完成、上移与副行 f32–46、静止 26f、末 12f crash）
cards.energy: 中高（起手就是满画面的大字，但全程只有一次运动，没有二次冲击）
cards.intention: 字卡最容易犯的错是"整句一起淡入"——观众同时收到 5 个词，一个都没记住。这张卡把 阅读顺序做成**物理顺序**：先只给一个词，而且大到占满画面、还在继续朝观众推近，观众 被迫先读它；然后这个词退回自己在句子里的尺寸和位置，整句围绕它长出来。落定时观众 已经读过两遍主词。 真正的手感命门不是缩放曲线，而是**支点**。首词从"画面正中"走到"行内第三个字符的 位置"，如果支点取行盒中心，缩放和左滑会各自把字往两边拽，末尾几帧基线抖得肉眼可见。 把 `transform-origin` 横向钉在首词中心、纵向钉在基线，这两点全程不动，整行就只是 "收小"，没有任何漂移。

styles.label: lead-word-zoom-assemble
styles.description: 首词以 2.3 倍字号占据画面中央、hold 期间继续推近 6%，随后一条曲线同时完成「缩回终字号」与「整行左滑归位」，后续词各自从槽位右侧 0.5em 被推进来；支点横向钉首词中心、纵向钉基线（挂载时实测），整行上移的同一时窗副行浮出，停一拍后整幕 crash-zoom 推近失焦交棒
styles.descriptionEn: The lead word fills the frame at 2.3x and keeps drifting toward the viewer, then a single curve recedes it to size while the line slides left and the trailing words are pushed into their slots — pivoting on the lead word centre and the measured baseline.

cards.summaryEn: The lead word fills the frame at 2.3x and keeps drifting toward the viewer, then a single curve recedes it to size while the line slides left and the trailing words are pushed into their slots — pivoting on the lead word centre and the measured baseline.
cards.useEn: Introducing cards for brand / product names; the second shot of a launch-event style opener; when a one-line claim needs "let one word fill the frame first, then complete the whole sentence"
cards.intentionEn: The most common mistake in word cards is "the whole sentence fades in together" — the audience receives 5 words at once and remembers none. This card makes the reading order a physical order: one word first, big enough to fill the frame and still drifting toward the viewer, forcing the audience to read it first; then the word recedes to its own size and position in the sentence, and the whole sentence grows around it. By the time it lands, the audience has read the lead word twice. The true feel make-or-break is not the scale curve but the pivot: the lead word travels from "the centre of the frame" to "the position of the third character in the line"; if the pivot is the line box's centre, the scale and the leftward slide each drag the word in opposite directions and the baseline visibly jitters in the final frames. Pin `transform-origin` horizontally on the lead word's centre and vertically on the baseline — those two points never move, so the whole line simply "shrinks" with zero drift.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (opens on a full-frame big word, but there is only one motion throughout, no second impact)

cards.name: letterspace-materialize
cards.summary: 大字距字标全字符并行连续描画结晶——所有字母同帧起笔、笔画像手写一样连续生长、同帧齐收成词；氛围底景上的品牌字标显影
cards.use: 片尾/片头品牌字标登场（大字距细骨架字标；demo 为 Motion Studio 全小写）；章节题字；needs 静谧/高级感的收束帧
cards.duration: 静置 ~15f + 描画 ~50f + 终态静置 ≥30f；全段 3–4s
cards.energy: 低（静谧仪式感，一次呼吸完成）
cards.intention: 字标不是淡入也不是打字机，而是"结晶"：全部字母的笔画同时 开始连续生长，像一只看不见的手同时写所有字母，同一瞬间齐收 成词。两个命门：**连续**（笔画必须是连续画出的过程，不许遮罩 分段——先半截再另半截会被读穿；任何中间帧都该像"写到一半"）； **同步**（所有字母同帧起笔、同帧完成——逐字错峰是打字机语义， 这里是整词一体的仪式感）。

styles.label: letterspace-materialize
styles.description: 大字距字标全字符并行连续描画结晶——所有字母同帧起笔、笔画像手写一样连续生长、同帧齐收成词；氛围底景上的品牌字标显影
styles.descriptionEn: Every letter of a widely tracked wordmark draws itself in parallel, growing like handwriting and finishing together on the same frame.

cards.summaryEn: Every letter of a widely tracked wordmark draws itself in parallel, growing like handwriting and finishing together on the same frame.
cards.useEn: Brand wordmark entrances for heads / tails (wide-tracking, thin-skeleton wordmarks; the demo is Motion Studio all lowercase); section titles; closing frames that need quiet / premium feel
cards.intentionEn: The wordmark neither fades in nor types; it "crystallises": every letter's strokes start growing continuously at the same moment, like an invisible hand writing all the letters at once, closing into a word in the same instant. Two make-or-breaks: continuous (the strokes must be a continuously drawn process — no masked segmentation; half then the other half gets read through, and every in-between frame should look like "half-written"), and synchronous (all letters start and finish on the same frame — per-character stagger is typewriter semantics; here the ritual is the word as one body).
cards.energyEn: Low (quiet ritual feel, completed in one breath)

cards.name: light-play-moves
cards.summary: 光效两式——spotlight-sweep 聚光扫字、sheen 单点扫光
cards.use: 把光当另一种笔触（扫/擦）：暗场标题揭示（A）、主角卡加冕（B）
cards.energy: A 中 / B 低
cards.intention: 库内"光"一直只有 spotlight-hero-card 一个点射手法；这两式把光做成 体系，两种笔触两种职责：A 是**扫**——暗场里几乎不可见的标题被锥形 光摆动扫亮，光到哪哪亮，与 spotlight-hero-card 的区别是那个打卡片、 这个扫文字；B 是**擦**——深墨主角卡上一道 45° 高光带缓扫一次，被 圆角裁住，无声的加冕。 全部深底或深主角——**白底上提亮不可见**（判例）是这整张卡的地基。

styles.label: spotlight-sweep
styles.description: 双层同文本：暗版 0.07 常驻，亮版 radial mask 随光斑走，锥形光摆两个来回后全亮定格
styles.use: 暗场大标题揭示开场
styles.descriptionEn: Two copies of the text: a dim one always on, a bright one revealed by a radial mask that sweeps twice before locking fully lit.

styles.label: sheen-sweep
styles.description: 深墨卡上 45° 高光带 translateX 扫一次，overflow hidden 圆角裁剪
styles.use: 主角卡静止段的一次加冕
styles.descriptionEn: A single 45-degree highlight band sweeps once across a dark card, clipped by its rounded corners.

cards.summaryEn: Two controlled light effects: a spotlight sweep that reveals the title and a single sheen pass across a card.
cards.useEn: Treating light as another brushstroke (sweep / wipe): dark-ground title reveal (A), the hero card's coronation (B)
cards.intentionEn: In the library "light" had only one spotlight technique, spotlight-hero-card; these two styles turn light into a system, two brushstrokes with two jobs: A is the sweep — a title nearly invisible in the dark ground is lit by a swinging cone of light; where the light goes, it lights, the difference from spotlight-hero-card being that one hits cards and this one sweeps text. B is the wipe — a 45° highlight band sweeps slowly once across a deep-ink hero card, cropped by the rounded corners, a wordless coronation. All deep grounds or deep heroes — "brightening is invisible on white" (tested rule) is the foundation of this whole card.
cards.energyEn: A medium / B low

cards.name: line-carry-transition
cards.summary: 线条接力横移转场——场景 A 的进度条延伸出画，镜头跟线横移，线在移动中拐角围出场景 B 的卡框，全程无剪切
cards.use: 两个有图形亲缘的场景之间（进度条→卡框、下划线→图表轴）；一支片子的招牌转场位，Catch Me If You Can 片头的图形接力
cards.duration: ~6.3s / 190f（进度条走满 36f + 冲出 10f + 横移 56f + 收框 24f + 框内海报 30f + 静止 24f）
cards.energy: 中
cards.intention: 转场库三大族（穿越/藏切/体块）都在回答"场景怎么换"；本卡的回答是 **根本不换——一条线牵着你走过去**。进度条走满后末端延伸成长线冲出 卡缘，镜头跟着线横移 1920px 进入新世界，线在移动中拐直角围出 B 场景 的卡框，框闭合、内容淡入，从头到尾观众的眼睛没离开过这条线。图形 连续性本身就是转场。与 match-cut 的区别：那是切点两侧形状对位—— 终究还是切；这是连续绘制——**没有切**。线的身份要有叙事逻辑（进度条 "走完了"所以延伸出去），无来由的线只是装饰。

styles.label: line-carry-transition
styles.description: 线条接力横移转场——场景 A 的进度条延伸出画，镜头跟线横移，线在移动中拐角围出场景 B 的卡框，全程无剪切
styles.descriptionEn: A progress line exits scene A, guides the camera sideways, then turns corners to become the frame of scene B.

cards.summaryEn: A progress line exits scene A, guides the camera sideways, then turns corners to become the frame of scene B.
cards.useEn: Between two scenes with graphic kinship (progress bar → card frame, underline → chart axis); a film's signature transition slot, the graphic relay of the Catch Me If You Can title sequence
cards.intentionEn: The three great transition families (travel / hidden cut / solid body) all answer "how does the scene change"; this card's answer is that it does not change at all — one line leads you across. After the progress bar fills, its end extends into a long line rushing past the card edge, the camera follows the line 1920px sideways into the new world, the line turns right angles mid-move to frame scene B's card, the frame closes, the content fades in, and from start to finish the audience's eyes never leave this line. Graphic continuity itself is the transition. The difference from a match cut: there the shapes align across the cut — it is still a cut; this is continuous drawing — there is no cut. The line's identity needs narrative logic (the progress bar "finished", so it extends outward); a line without provenance is mere decoration.

cards.intentionEn: The magician's card throw: a blue starburst flashes, and the card seems to be conjured out of the light — launched from an extreme distance behind the frame centre (visually a single dot), flying at the lens along an arc in a rapid spin, and at the instant of arrival hard-freezing into a near-full-frame display. cards.name: mosaic-reframe
cards.summary: 12 张瓦片在规则网格、feature mosaic、对角瀑布串三种排版间连续变形，位置宽高各自插值、逐片微错峰，段间留 hold
cards.use: "同一批内容多种看法"的陈列转场：作品集/模板库/相册产品的布局能力展示
cards.duration: 约 7.1s（214f@30fps；浮现 0–22f · hold A · A→B 56–92f · hold B · B→C 132–176f · hold C 至 214f）
cards.energy: 中（连续流动的重排，无爆点，气质从容）
cards.intention: 让观众看见"布局本身在思考"：同样 12 张内容，从整齐档案态（网格）变成有主次的策展态（feature mosaic），再变成有态度的动态态（对角瀑布）。## 动效核心 - 三套布局按 1920×1080 原生像素硬编码为坐标表（内容区 x 96–1824、y 212–984）：A=4×3 规则网格（间距 24）； B=6×4 单元格 mosaic（首片占 3×2 大位，间距 16）；C=竖幅相纸 300×372 沿 (850,214)→(1724,930) 对角摊开， `rot = −15° + i·3°` 递增旋转 - 每片对中心 x/y、w/h、rot **独立插值**，不走 transform 整体缩放——宽高真实变化，圆角阴影不变形； 位置先到：w/h 晚 2f、旋转晚 4f 收敛，B→C 的旋转带一次轻过冲（bezier 0.45,0,0.3,1.22） - 换位曲线 bezier(0.75,0,0.15,1)（慢起 → 急走 → 长尾软落），A→B 每片 26f、B→C 每片 30f； 途中按段进度 sin 包络抬起（放大 3.5% + 阴影变大变虚），落位贴回 - 因果驱动：右上角分段控件 Grid / Mosaic / Cascade 的强调色胶囊先滑到下一档（snappy 12f，途中横向拉长）， 瓦片晚 4f 才开始重排（父先动、子跟随） - 错峰：A→B 按序号先密后疏扫过（10f 跨度）；B→C 像发牌一样等间隔依次摊开（14f 跨度）， B→C 起叠放次序切换为"后发的压上面"（B 态无重叠，切换不可见） - 三态三种语气：B 态主图压衬线大字图注（Featured shot / Golden Hour / Shot 01 · Crash zoom · 4.5 s 逐词升起）； C 态瓦片长出 14px 相纸白边，左下留白处升起衬线大标题 + 副行，尾帧是完整海报 （demo 是 Motion Studio 的 12 镜分镜板：页眉标志 + 字标 + Storyboard，收尾「Every shot, in sequence.」+ 品牌 tagline） - 开场：12 张照片沿对角线错峰升起（16f snappy），全程相机极缓推近 1→1.025

styles.label: mosaic-reframe
styles.description: 12 张瓦片在规则网格、feature mosaic、对角瀑布串三种排版间连续变形，位置宽高各自插值、逐片微错峰，段间留 hold
styles.descriptionEn: Twelve tiles morph continuously between a regular grid, a feature mosaic with one hero slot, and a rotated diagonal cascade, each tile interpolating position and size independently with a slight stagger.

cards.summaryEn: Twelve tiles morph continuously between a regular grid, a feature mosaic with one hero slot, and a rotated diagonal cascade, each tile interpolating position and size independently with a slight stagger.
cards.useEn: A display transition for "the same content, many views": showcasing layout capability for portfolio / template library / album products
cards.intentionEn: Let the audience see "the layout itself thinking": the same 12 pieces of content go from a tidy archive state (grid) to a curated state with hierarchy (feature mosaic) to an opinionated dynamic state (diagonal waterfall). All three layouts are hard-coded as coordinate tables at 1920×1080 native pixels (content area x 96–1824, y 212–984): A = 4×3 regular grid (24px gutters); B = 6×4 cell mosaic (first tile takes a 3×2 hero slot, 16px gutters); C = 300×372 portrait prints fanned along the (850,214)→(1724,930) diagonal with `rot = -15° + i·3°` incremental rotation. Every tile interpolates its centre x/y, w/h and rot independently — no whole-transform scaling — so widths and heights really change while corners and shadows stay undistorted; position arrives first: w/h converges 2f later and rotation 4f later, and B→C's rotation carries one light overshoot (bezier 0.45,0,0.3,1.22). The repositioning curve is bezier(0.75,0,0.15,1) (slow start → fast travel → long soft tail), 26f per tile A→B, 30f per tile B→C; en route each tile lifts on a sine envelope of its segment progress (3.5% larger + bigger, softer shadow) and settles back on landing. Causality-driven: the accent-colour pill of the segmented control Grid / Mosaic / Cascade at the top right slides to the next stop first (snappy 12f, stretching horizontally en route), and the tiles start rearranging 4f later (parent moves first, children follow). Stagger: A→B sweeps by index, dense then sparse (10f span); B→C fans out like dealing cards at even intervals (14f span), and from B→C on the stacking order switches to "later ones land on top" (B has no overlaps, so the switch is invisible). Three states, three voices: B's hero image carries serif large-type captions (Featured shot / Golden Hour / Shot 01 · Crash zoom · 4.5s rising word by word); C's tiles grow a 14px photo-paper white border, a serif headline + sub-line rise from the white space at lower left, and the final frame is a complete poster (the demo is Motion Studio's 12-shot storyboard: header mark + wordmark + Storyboard, closing on "Every shot, in sequence." + the brand tagline). Opening: 12 photos rise along the diagonal in stagger (16f snappy) while the camera pushes in very slowly 1→1.025 throughout.
cards.energyEn: Medium (continuous flowing rearrangement, no burst; unhurried in temperament)

cards.summaryEn: A neon frame races ahead to outline the scene in steep perspective while components drop from above and the page brightens as they land.
cards.useEn: Giving UI panels an "entrance ceremony" in a dark-ground brand film (frame first, content lands after); a functional area's first appearance; a neon / cyber-toned section opener
cards.intentionEn: Frame first, flesh after: the neon wireframe races in from both ends like runway lights, staking out the position and announcing "something will appear here"; while the page brightens from dark inside the frame, components land from mid-air with shadows — the audience sees the interface being "placed" into the frame. The three layers of action (frame racing / page lighting / components landing) must interlock in sync: the landing progress advances in lockstep with the lighting progress, finishing slightly later, and the frame light finally merges into the panel's glow. The background neon tube group goes dark at the end, yielding brightness to the hero to complete the closing.

cards.duration: 描框 ~0.5s + 旋转&同时贴落 ~2.5s + 落定 ~1s；全段 ~4.7s（140f，旋转到 128f 收住后留落定）

cards.intention: neon-frame-forerun 的孪生变体：同样框先行、内容后落，但镜头 不是固定的——从页面左侧视角连续弧线旋转到右侧视角，旋转进行 的同时全部组件从空中贴落。命门是**同时贴合**：所有组件和文字 同帧起落、同帧贴合、软影同步消失——这是"整体登场"的语法 （判例：错峰版被裁"应该是所有组件和文字同时从空中往下贴合"）。 错峰贴落属于巡礼镜（graze-face-tour），一页一次性亮相 必须齐落，节奏语义不能混用。

cards.summaryEn: After a neon frame draws itself, the camera arcs left to right while every page component drops from the air and lands on the same frame.
cards.useEn: A one-time grand entrance for a single-page UI (as opposed to tours / zone-by-zone reveals); the key-visual unveiling of a dark-ground neon passage; the sibling shot of neon-frame-forerun
cards.intentionEn: The twin variant of neon-frame-forerun: same frame-first, content-lands-after, but the camera is not fixed — it arcs continuously from the page's left viewpoint to its right viewpoint while all components land from mid-air during the rotation. The make-or-break is simultaneous landing: all components and text rise, land and lose their soft shadows in the same frames — this is the grammar of "the whole thing enters" (tested rule: the staggered version was cut — "all components and text should land from above at the same time"). Staggered landing belongs to tour shots (graze-face-tour); a page's one-time reveal must land all together — the rhythm semantics cannot be mixed.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (one big move; still right after landing)

cards.name: neon-triple-marquee
cards.summary: 三行对向霓虹跑马灯 recap——三连词空心霓虹灯管巨字上中下排满一面斜拍的砖墙，奇偶行反向匀速无限横滚，三行按 1/3 相位轮流点亮，结尾逐行断电
cards.use: 片尾主题词复读机段落；三连词口号的"余韵"拍法；音乐段无旁白铺陈
cards.duration: 4–5s（demo 150f：18f 逐行点火上电 + 循环体 + 18f 逐行断电 + 8f 熄灯 hold）
cards.energy: 中高（持续流动 + 逐行脉冲，无瞬时冲击）
cards.intention: 一行 marquee 只是网页装饰；三行叠起来、奇偶反向、再让亮度按相位轮流 走，就成了"主题词在观众眼前列队巡游"。命门是**明暗轮唱**：任一时刻 只有一行是霓虹主角，其余压暗成细描边背景——三行全亮是灯牌事故， 轮流亮才是 recap。反向对滚制造"包围感"：上下行向右、中行向左， 视线被夹在中间，词从两侧源源不断流过，读作"这三个词说不完"。

styles.label: neon-triple-marquee
styles.description: 三行对向霓虹跑马灯 recap——三连词空心霓虹灯管巨字上中下排满一面斜拍的砖墙，奇偶行反向匀速无限横滚，三行按 1/3 相位轮流点亮，结尾逐行断电
styles.descriptionEn: Three rows of outlined neon giants scroll in opposite directions across the full screen, lighting up in turn on a one-third phase offset.

cards.summaryEn: Three rows of outlined neon giants scroll in opposite directions across the full screen, lighting up in turn on a one-third phase offset.
cards.useEn: The outro's theme-word repeater passage; the "after-ring" treatment of a three-word slogan; music-section underlay with no narration
cards.intentionEn: One marquee line is mere web decoration; stack three, counter-rotate odd and even, and let the brightness take turns by phase, and it becomes "the theme words parading past the audience's eyes". The make-or-break is the light/dark round: at any moment only one line is the neon protagonist, the others dimmed to thin outlined background — three lines all bright is a signboard accident; taking turns is the recap. Counter-direction rolling creates a sense of enclosure: top and bottom lines move right, the middle moves left, the gaze trapped between them, words streaming in from both sides, reading as "these three words never run out".
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (continuous flow + line-by-line pulses, no instantaneous impact)

cards.name: orbit-ring-title-open
cards.summary: 石墨暗场上八张 16:9 暗色内容卡按 45° 均布在 720×380 椭圆上匀速公转（卡身永不倾斜，纵深只由 sin θ 给出 ±12% 缩放、z 序与远处压暗失焦），环撑开期间卡内容冻结首帧、f24 之后八张一起开播；居中两级标题逐字解糊下沉落定，关键词到位那一刻荧光马克块自左横扫铺满、扫过处字反白为墨，mono 副行随后浮出；可选末段整行失焦淡出、环继续转着交棒下一镜
cards.use: 开场第一镜 = 「这个产品有一整套东西」；素材库/模板库/功能矩阵/案例集的门面拍；需要用真实运动的产品画面托住一句主张，而不是把截图摆成静态九宫格
cards.duration: 150f（5s@30fps；马克块 f64 落定后 2.9s 稳态巡回 + 极缓推近；开 HANDOFF_EXIT 时 f118 起退场交棒）
cards.energy: 中（唯一的持续运动是匀速公转，全片只有马克块横扫一次冲击）
cards.intention: 开场想说"我们有一整套东西"，最常见的做法是把截图排成网格——但网格是静止的，观众 读到的是"一堆图片"，不是"一套会动的产品"。这张卡把陈列改成**环形巡回**：八张卡沿 椭圆匀速公转，永远有卡在进画、有卡在出画，画面自带"还有更多"的暗示，而标题稳稳 钉在正中间不受影响。 关键的取舍是**卡内容要真的在播**。静态截图上环，观众只会认出"轮播图"；卡里跑着真 动效，同一个环立刻变成"产品在工作"。但八张卡同时开播会八个动效抢戏，谁也读不进去 ——所以入场期把卡内容**冻结在首帧**，等环撑开、标题起手之后再统一开播。观众的注意 力顺序因此是：先认出这是一圈产品画面 → 读标题 → 才注意到卡里都在动。

styles.label: orbit-ring-title-open
styles.description: 石墨暗场上八张 16:9 暗色内容卡按 45° 均布在 720×380 椭圆上匀速公转（卡身永不倾斜，纵深只由 sin θ 给出 ±12% 缩放、z 序与远处压暗失焦），环撑开期间卡内容冻结首帧、f24 之后八张一起开播；居中两级标题逐字解糊下沉落定，关键词到位那一刻荧光马克块自左横扫铺满、扫过处字反白为墨，mono 副行随后浮出；可选末段整行失焦淡出、环继续转着交棒下一镜
styles.descriptionEn: Eight 16:9 content cards orbit an ellipse at a constant rate with their contents frozen on the first frame, then all start playing together while the centred headline de-blurs into place and a marker block sweeps across the key phrase.

cards.summaryEn: Eight 16:9 content cards orbit an ellipse at a constant rate with their contents frozen on the first frame, then all start playing together while the centred headline de-blurs into place and a marker block sweeps across the key phrase.
cards.useEn: The opening shot = "this product has a whole suite of things"; the facade shot for asset libraries / template galleries / feature matrices / case collections; when a claim needs real motion in product imagery to hold it up, rather than screenshots laid out in a static nine-grid
cards.intentionEn: The opener wants to say "we have a whole suite of things", and the most common approach is a grid of screenshots — but a grid is still, and the audience reads "a pile of pictures", not "a product that moves". This card turns the display into a ring tour: eight cards orbit the ellipse at a constant rate, cards always entering and leaving frame, the picture itself implying "there's more", while the title stays nailed dead centre, unaffected. The critical trade-off is that the card contents are really playing. Static screenshots on a ring and the audience only recognises "a carousel"; real motion inside the cards and the same ring instantly becomes "the product at work". But eight cards playing at once means eight motions fighting for the lead and nothing reads — so during the entrance the contents are frozen on their first frames, and only after the ring spreads open and the title starts do they all begin together. The audience's attention order is therefore: first recognise this is a ring of product imagery → read the title → only then notice the cards are all moving.
cards.energyEn: Medium (the only continuous motion is the constant-rate orbit; the whole film has exactly one impact, the marker sweep)

cards.name: outline-word-fill
cards.summary: 空心词（细暖灰描边、500 字重）从 3.2 倍急缓收缩落位，虚线大圆随后从 2.8 倍收到字周围并缓慢自转，左右水平虚线从画框边缘内伸；描边先微微增亮，实心白热字在一帧内硬切点亮，一闪辉光即定格
cards.use: 单词式利益点/口号的重锤一拍；节奏卡点上的"钉子"镜；深底品牌片的强调帧
cards.energy: 高（3.2 倍收缩 + 瞬时点亮，短时高冲击）
cards.intention: 一个词要打成钉子，靠的不是慢慢淡入而是**两次落定**：先是巨大空心字 急速收缩到位（这是尺寸的落定），再是描边在一帧内变实心白（这是质感的 落定）。中间那 1.5s 的虚线圆收缩与水平虚线内伸是"瞄准"过程——技术 制图语汇，让点亮那一下读作"确认"。填充**必须是瞬时**的：慢扫填充会把 钉子变成缓慢的美化动画。

styles.label: outline-word-fill
styles.description: 空心词（细暖灰描边、500 字重）从 3.2 倍急缓收缩落位，虚线大圆随后从 2.8 倍收到字周围并缓慢自转，左右水平虚线从画框边缘内伸；描边先微微增亮，实心白热字在一帧内硬切点亮，一闪辉光即定格
styles.descriptionEn: An outlined word snaps down from triple size while a dashed circle and horizontal guides close in, then the stroke flips to solid white in a single frame with one brief glow.

cards.summaryEn: An outlined word snaps down from triple size while a dashed circle and horizontal guides close in, then the stroke flips to solid white in a single frame with one brief glow.
cards.useEn: The hammer beat of a single-word benefit / slogan; the "nail" shot on a rhythm downbeat; the emphasis frame of a dark-ground brand film
cards.intentionEn: To nail a word, you do not rely on a slow fade but on two landings: first the giant outline word snaps into size (the landing of scale), then the stroke turns solid white within one frame (the landing of material). The 1.5s of dashed-circle contraction and horizontal dashed lines closing in between them is the "aiming" process — technical-drawing vocabulary that makes the light-up read as "confirmed". The fill must be instantaneous: a slow sweep-fill turns the nail into a slow beautification animation.
cards.energyEn: High (3.2× contraction + instantaneous light-up; short high impact)

cards.name: outro-group-photo-launch
cards.summary: 全片元素从四面八方飞来围住字标合影，crane 落机位+舞台光+金尘做成发布会收场
cards.use: outro/品牌收尾；多功能产品的"全家福"式终镜
cards.energy: 峰值（全片最高点）
cards.intention: 把看过的每个功能各抽一个代表元素叫回来合影，字标压轴登场——观众离场前最后记住的是"这些东西属于同一个产品"。规格必须是发布会级：能量推到全片最高。

styles.label: outro-group-photo-launch
styles.description: 全片元素从四面八方飞来围住字标合影，crane 落机位+舞台光+金尘做成发布会收场
styles.descriptionEn: Elements from the film assemble around the wordmark as a crane settle, stage light, and gold dust create a launch-event finale.

cards.summaryEn: Elements from the film assemble around the wordmark as a crane settle, stage light, and gold dust create a launch-event finale.
cards.useEn: Outro / brand closings; the "family portrait" final shot of a multi-feature product
cards.intentionEn: Call back one representative element from every feature the audience has seen for a group photo, with the wordmark entering last — the last thing the audience remembers before leaving is "these things all belong to the same product". The spec must be launch-event grade: energy pushed to the film's highest.
cards.energyEn: Peak (the film's highest point)

cards.name: overhead-camera-moves
cards.summary: 俯拍揭示两式——tilt-reveal 俯仰抬正揭示、overhead-tabletop-drop 桌面卡阵横滑骤降扎入
cards.use: 用"俯仰角"讲故事的开场/转场：单页 establishing 用 A，多页巡视择一扎入用 B
cards.energy: A 中 / B 中高
cards.intention: 库内俯拍视角一直空缺——crane-rise 是"平移+缩放"的升起（俯仰角 不动），space-camera C 式 drone-dive 是俯冲降落一镜到底；这两式让 **俯仰角本身讲故事**：A 是揭示——整页 rotateX 平躺、开场只见远端上缘 一条发光的透视窄带（像天际线上的第一道光），机位"抬头"回正，内容一排排 涌入视野，像掀开桌上的图纸；B 是选择——三张页面卡平躺成桌面卡阵，相机俯拍横向滑过依次 掠过（韦斯·安德森 tabletop），滑到目标页猛地俯冲扎入、抬正成满屏， "巡视一圈，就选这张"。选型：单页开场用 A，多页转场/开场用 B。

styles.label: tilt-reveal
styles.description: perspective 容器内整页 rotateX -80° 平躺，~43f 抬正，rotateX/scale/translateY 共用 out-cubic，末端轻过冲
styles.use: 开场 establishing；单主体
styles.descriptionEn: The whole page lies flat at -80 degrees and tilts upright in one 43-frame ease-out with a slight overshoot at the end.

styles.label: overhead-tabletop-drop
styles.description: 卡阵平躺 rotateX 62°，pan 段只动 translateX 横滑掠过，drop 段角度/缩放/位移三通道同跑扎入落版
styles.use: 多页巡视后择一；转场/开场两用
styles.descriptionEn: A card array lies at 62 degrees overhead; the camera pans across the tabletop, then dives and lands on the layout.

cards.summaryEn: Two overhead reveals: a tilted scene leveling into view, and a tabletop layout dropping sharply into place.
cards.useEn: Openers / transitions that tell the story with "tilt angle": single-page establishing in A, multi-page survey diving into one in B
cards.intentionEn: The library's overhead-view angle had always been empty — crane-rise is a "pan + zoom" rise (the tilt angle unmoving), and space-camera style C's drone-dive is a one-take plunge; these two styles let the tilt angle itself tell the story: A is the reveal — the whole page lies flat via rotateX, and at the opening only a glowing perspective strip at the far top edge is visible (like the first light on a skyline), the camera "looks up" back to level, and content floods the view row by row, like lifting the drawing off a table. B is the choice — three page cards lie flat as a tabletop card formation, the camera pans across them from above in turn (Wes Anderson tabletop), and on reaching the target page it dives sharply in and levels up to full screen: "surveyed the lot, picked this one". Selection: single-page openers use A, multi-page transitions / openers use B.
cards.energyEn: A medium / B medium-high

cards.name: page-turn-transitions
cards.summary: 整页体块转场——barn-door-split 对开门裂幕（旧页裂两半滑出、新页迎上）
cards.use: 章节级换页：新旧交替的两个大段落之间的"翻篇"仪式；与 shot-transitions 系（镜头交棒）分工——那是"航拍机移过去"，这是"页面自己是实体"
cards.duration: 单式 150f（前态建立 30–40f + 转场 24–40f + 跟随与收尾 ≥70f），约 5.0s
cards.energy: 中高
cards.intention: shot-transitions 三式和 transition-travel/hidden-cut 都把页面当"场景" ——相机在场景间移动。本卡把页面当**实体**：它有厚度、有重量、会 裂开。体块隐喻的仪式感更强，适合章节级大换页（功能 A 讲完→功能 B） 而非镜头级小交棒。对开门是"旧的让位"——旧页从正中撕开滑走、新页 从底下迎上来，暗示取代关系，专管新旧交替。

styles.label: barn-door-split
styles.description: 整页体块转场——barn-door-split 对开门裂幕（旧页裂两半滑出、新页迎上）
styles.use: 新旧交替：改版前后、方案 A→方案 B
styles.descriptionEn: The old page splits into two halves that accelerate out to both sides, edges glowing, while the new page rises to meet the gap.

cards.summaryEn: A full-page transition where the old page splits open like double doors to reveal the new one.
cards.useEn: Section-level page turns: the "turning the page" ritual between two large passages of old and new; division of labour with the shot-transitions family (camera handover) — that one "flies the drone over", this one treats "the page itself is a solid object"
cards.intentionEn: The three shot-transitions styles and transition-travel / hidden-cut all treat pages as "scenes" — the camera moves between scenes. This card treats the page as a solid object: it has thickness, weight, and it splits open. The solid-body metaphor has stronger ceremony, suited to section-level big page turns (feature A finished → feature B) rather than shot-level small handovers. The double-door opening is "the old makes way" — the old page tears apart from the centre and slides away, the new page rises from below to meet it, implying replacement, dedicated to the old-to-new swap.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high

cards.name: page-waterfall-wall
cards.summary: 页面瀑布墙——真实页面截图切成 3–4 列在 3D 后仰墙面上差速反向无限滚动，视差 + 镜头缓推做"内容多到流不完"的一览
cards.use: "多页面/多功能/多模板"体量感段落；montage 中段铺陈或 intro 后的产品广度镜头
cards.duration: 4–6s（无限循环体，时长由段落需要裁）
cards.energy: 中（流动陈列型）
cards.intention: 流动式一览：让观众在几秒内"看到很多页面流过"，读感是体量而非细节。 与 outro-group-photo-launch 分工：那是**聚拢式**一览（元素飞来围住 字标定格合影，语义"属于同一产品"），本卡是**流动式**一览（内容持续 流过不定格，语义"还有很多没给你看完"）。 与 wall-reveal-moves 分工：那是整墙**入场动作**，本卡是墙的**持续状态**， 可用那卡入场后交棒本卡续流。

styles.label: page-waterfall-wall
styles.description: 页面瀑布墙——真实页面截图切成 3–4 列在 3D 后仰墙面上差速反向无限滚动，视差 + 镜头缓推做"内容多到流不完"的一览
styles.descriptionEn: Real page captures flow at different speeds across a tilted 3D wall, creating an endless field of content.

cards.summaryEn: Real page captures flow at different speeds across a tilted 3D wall, creating an endless field of content.
cards.useEn: A sense-of-scale passage for "many pages / many features / many templates"; mid-montage setup or the product-breadth shot after the intro
cards.intentionEn: The flowing overview: let the audience "see many pages flow past" in a few seconds; the reading is scale, not detail. Division of labour with outro-group-photo-launch: that one is the gathering overview (elements fly in to surround the wordmark and freeze for the group photo — the semantics "belongs to the same product"), this one is the flowing overview (content keeps flowing without freezing — the semantics "there's plenty more we didn't show you"). Division of labour with wall-reveal-moves: that one is the whole wall's entrance action, this one is the wall's ongoing state — enter with that card, then hand over to this one to keep the flow going.
cards.energyEn: Medium (flowing-display type)

cards.name: panel-grid-moves
cards.summary: 分格节奏——comic-panel-split 漫画斜格劈出同一主体的三个机位，咔咔咔三格定格后末格斜边吃屏成海报
cards.use: 把"格子"当节奏器：同主体多机位定格并列，逐格踩拍劈出；吃拍点
cards.duration: 156f ≈5.2s（全屏侧拍 20f + 三刀分格定格 + 吃屏 + 海报 hold）
cards.energy: 中高
cards.intention: 与 wall-reveal-moves 的区别是本卡的定位锚：那是"整墙怎么入场" （一次性揭示），这是"格子怎么当节奏器"——分格发生在节拍上，格变即鼓点。 A 是并：画面被三刀斜缝咔咔劈开，同一产品三种机位同时定格， 停一拍后末格斜边扫过吃掉全屏——Scott Pilgrim 的分屏语言。 适合单品多视角（demo：一支刻着 Motion Studio 的定焦镜头，三格旁白框按 「Shot 01 / 02 / 03」编号，吃屏后落成「Craft the shot.」海报）。

styles.label: comic-panel-split
styles.description: 分格节奏——comic-panel-split 漫画斜格劈出同一主体的三个机位，咔咔咔三格定格后末格斜边吃屏成海报
styles.use: 同一主体多视角并列；漫画感段落
styles.descriptionEn: Three slanted comic panels show the same subject at three zooms, popping in 2 frames apart, each slowly pushing until the last panel eats the screen.

cards.summaryEn: An angled comic-panel split that cuts one moment into three framings before resolving to a poster.
cards.useEn: Using "the grid" as a rhythm device: the same subject frozen from multiple angles side by side, split out grid by grid on the beat; eats downbeats
cards.intentionEn: The difference from wall-reveal-moves is this card's positioning anchor: that one is "how does the whole wall enter" (a one-time reveal), this one is "how the grid acts as a rhythm device" — the splitting happens on the beat, and a grid change is a drum hit. A is the split: the frame is chopped by three diagonal seams, the same product frozen from three angles at once, and after a beat the last cell's diagonal edge sweeps across and eats the whole screen — Scott Pilgrim's split-screen language. Suited to a single product from multiple angles (the demo: a prime lens engraved with Motion Studio, with the three cells' caption boxes numbered "Shot 01 / 02 / 03", and after the screen-eating it lands as a "Craft the shot." poster).
cards.energyEn: Medium-high

cards.name: paper-title-card
cards.summary: 一句话逐词压印上纸、一个词标强调色斜体、短划线收束
cards.use: 章节转场/价值主张字卡；重要功能出场前的引导卡；全片呼吸位
cards.energy: 低（呼吸位，隔开两段高能镜头）
cards.intention: 在两段产品画面之间给观众一句话的喘息：说清"接下来看什么、它值什么"。letterpress 压印质感让字卡与纸墨风格的产品画面同属一个世界。

styles.label: paper-title-card
styles.description: 一句话逐词压印上纸、一个词标强调色斜体、短划线收束
styles.descriptionEn: A sentence stamps onto paper word by word, highlights one amber italic term, and closes with a short rule.

cards.summaryEn: A sentence stamps onto paper word by word, highlights one amber italic term, and closes with a short rule.
cards.useEn: Section transitions / value-proposition title cards; the lead-in card before an important feature; the film's breathing spots
cards.intentionEn: Give the audience a one-line breath between two product passages: making clear "what's next and what it's worth". The letterpress deboss texture puts the title card in the same world as the paper-ink styled product imagery.
cards.energyEn: Low (a breathing spot separating two high-energy shots)

cards.name: picker-carousel-feature-cycle
cards.summary: 移动端风竖向选择器——焦点药丸不动、内容穿过它，每项带明显 outQuint 减速吸附后完全静止，按到中心距离分层控制透明度/字号/灰度，落定时药丸做 scaleY 极轻呼吸
cards.use: 逐个念出功能名/场景名的列表镜头；"选一个"的交互演示；移动端产品的 picker 类控件展示
cards.energy: 中（每一次吸附都是一个节拍点，5 拍匀速推进）
cards.intention: 把"选择"这件事的物理感做出来：焦点框是固定的，是内容在滚动并被吸住。 每项停下后必须**真的静止几帧**——连续滚动读作 loading 动画，停顿才读作 "这一项被选中了"。距离衰减（透明度 + 字号 + 灰度三通道同时衰减）是让 观众视线始终锁在中间那一行的唯一手段。

styles.label: picker-carousel-feature-cycle
styles.description: 移动端风竖向选择器——焦点药丸不动、内容穿过它，每项带明显 outQuint 减速吸附后完全静止，按到中心距离分层控制透明度/字号/灰度，落定时药丸做 scaleY 极轻呼吸
styles.descriptionEn: A vertical mobile-style picker holds its focus pill still while the list passes through it, each item decelerating hard into place and resting for several frames before the next.

cards.summaryEn: A vertical mobile-style picker holds its focus pill still while the list passes through it, each item decelerating hard into place and resting for several frames before the next.
cards.useEn: List shots that read out feature / scenario names one by one; interaction demos of "pick one"; picker-type control showcases for mobile products
cards.intentionEn: Make the physicality of "choosing" tangible: the focus frame is fixed — it is the content that scrolls and is snapped in. After each item stops it must truly hold still for a few frames — continuous scrolling reads as a loading animation; the pause is what reads as "this item is selected". Distance falloff (opacity + font size + greyscale all falling off together) is the only means of keeping the audience's gaze locked on the middle row.
cards.energyEn: Medium (every snap is a beat point; five beats at constant speed)

cards.name: pill-chip-slot-cycle-handled
cards.summary: 白底句式 "Your `chip` Handled" 里深色胶囊内词竖向滚轮轮换，胶囊宽度按预量文本宽插值平滑伸缩、两侧文字被自然挤开收拢，胶囊上下露出 13% 透明度的灰色幽灵项
cards.use: "我们替你搞定 ___" 这类句式卖点；SaaS 功能列举的一句话收口；浅底品牌片主视觉一拍
cards.energy: 中（三拍稳定节拍，宽度伸缩是唯一的连续运动）
cards.intention: 词槽轮换有两派：让句子躲开变化（宽度固定的滚轮），或者让句子**接受** 变化（胶囊撑宽、两侧文字被挤开）。这卡是后者，代价是必须把宽度算准， 回报是句子读起来活的——"Your" 和 "Handled" 被推着走，观众感到胶囊里 的词有分量。上下露出的灰色幽灵项是第二个记号：它明示"这是个可以滚的 列表"，让观众预期还有下一个词。

styles.label: pill-chip-slot-cycle-handled
styles.description: 白底句式 "Your `chip` Handled" 里深色胶囊内词竖向滚轮轮换，胶囊宽度按预量文本宽插值平滑伸缩、两侧文字被自然挤开收拢，胶囊上下露出 13% 透明度的灰色幽灵项
styles.descriptionEn: A dark chip inside the sentence rolls through feature words, its width easing to each word so the surrounding text is pushed apart while grey ghost items show above and below.

cards.summaryEn: A dark chip inside the sentence rolls through feature words, its width easing to each word so the surrounding text is pushed apart while grey ghost items show above and below.
cards.useEn: "We handle ___ for you"-style sentence selling points; a one-line closer for SaaS feature lists; the key-visual beat of a light-ground brand film
cards.intentionEn: Word-slot cycling has two schools: let the sentence avoid the change (a fixed-width roller), or let the sentence accept the change (the pill widens, the text on both sides is pushed aside). This card is the latter; the cost is that the width must be calculated exactly, and the reward is that the sentence reads alive — "Your" and "Handled" get pushed along, and the audience feels the weight of the word inside the pill. The grey ghost items peeking above and below are the second marker: they make it explicit that "this is a scrollable list", priming the audience to expect the next word.
cards.energyEn: Medium (a steady three-beat metronome; the width breathing is the only continuous motion)

cards.name: pill-slot-cycle
cards.summary: 句中词槽轮换——固定句干钉死不动，句尾 pill 徽章每 ~0.7s 老虎机滚一格（旧的上飞加速淡出、新的从下带模糊滑入），连换 N 个功能词后落成完整句子收束
cards.use: "功能列举"类文案的最优雅解法（比逐条列表快、比字符级滚动有语义）；一句话卖点 + 多个动词短语的段落
cards.duration: 入场 12f + 每拍 21f × 词数 + 收束 14f + hold；6 词约 6.7s（demo 200f，含 48f 完整句 hold）
cards.energy: 中（稳定节拍器，无峰值）
cards.intention: 罗列六个功能，列表要六行、逐条淡入要六拍还占满屏。词槽轮换把它们 塞进**一句话的一个槽位**里：句干 "One skill to ___"（demo 讲 Motion Studio：Storyboard it → Capture the page → Move the camera → Cut on the beat → Design the sound → Render the film）是承诺，槽里 滚过的每个 pill 是证据，最后 pill 飞走、"do it all." 落位——证据 列举完毕，结论盖章。结构自带三幕：承诺→列举→收束。命门是句干 **纹丝不动**：观众的眼睛全程钉在槽位上，句干一晃列举感就散。

styles.label: pill-slot-cycle
styles.description: 句中词槽轮换——固定句干钉死不动，句尾 pill 徽章每 ~0.7s 老虎机滚一格（旧的上飞加速淡出、新的从下带模糊滑入），连换 N 个功能词后落成完整句子收束
styles.descriptionEn: A fixed sentence keeps its trailing pill slot spinning like a slot machine through feature words until the final word locks the sentence.

cards.summaryEn: A fixed sentence keeps its trailing pill slot spinning like a slot machine through feature words until the final word locks the sentence.
cards.useEn: The most elegant solution for "feature list" copy (faster than an itemised list, more semantic than character-level scrolling); passages with a one-line selling point + several verb phrases
cards.intentionEn: Listing six features takes six rows in a list, or six beats of item-by-item fade-in, and still fills the screen. Word-slot cycling stuffs them into one slot of a single sentence: the stem "One skill to ___" (the demo tells Motion Studio's story: Storyboard it → Capture the page → Move the camera → Cut on the beat → Design the sound → Render the film) is the promise, each pill rolling through the slot is the evidence, and finally the pill flies away and "do it all." lands — evidence enumerated, conclusion stamped. The structure is inherently three acts: promise → enumeration → landing. The make-or-break: the stem never moves a hair — the audience's eyes stay nailed to the slot the whole time, and if the stem wobbles the sense of enumeration dissipates.
cards.energyEn: Medium (a steady metronome, no peak)

cards.name: print-texture-transitions
cards.summary: 印刷质感转场——ink-bleed-reveal 墨渗揭示（须状渗边洇开吃掉旧景）
cards.use: 换景接缝的纸墨审美款；与交棒三式/穿越式并列的第三族——"介质显影"型转场
cards.energy: 中（渐进显形，无冲击拍）
cards.intention: 转场语言已有交棒（shot-transitions 三式）和穿越（transition-travel） ，都是空间/光学隐喻。本式开第三族：**介质隐喻**——新画面不是"到来" 而是"印染"出来的，直接调用库内纸墨审美的物理想象：像一滴墨落在 宣纸上洇开吃掉旧景，有机、书写感。天然亲和 paper/ink 调性的片子， 是 light-leak-burn（强调色漏光）之外的另一个"介质系"接缝选择。

styles.label: ink-bleed-reveal 墨渗揭示
styles.description: 印刷质感转场——ink-bleed-reveal 墨渗揭示（须状渗边洇开吃掉旧景）
styles.use: 旧景→新景替换；书写感、叙事调性
styles.descriptionEn: A print-based reveal: ink bleeding outward from a drop point to consume the old scene.

cards.summaryEn: A print-based reveal: ink bleeding outward from a drop point to consume the old scene.
cards.useEn: The paper-ink aesthetic option for scene-change seams; the third family alongside the three handover styles / travel styles — "medium developing" transitions
cards.intentionEn: The transition language already had handover (the three shot-transitions styles) and travel (transition-travel), both spatial / optical metaphors. This style opens a third family: the medium metaphor — the new image does not "arrive" but is "printed on", directly invoking the library's paper-ink physical imagination: like a drop of ink blooming on rice paper and eating the old scene — organic, a written feel. Naturally at home with paper/ink-toned films, it is the second "medium family" seam option alongside light-leak-burn (accent-colour light leak).
cards.energyEn: Medium (gradual manifestation, no impact beat)

cards.name: product-card-progressive-assemble
cards.summary: 详情卡像被逐字段抓取般自建——一枚"填充光标"领先跳格，图→标题→分类 pill 依次 pop→原价出现后被划线降级、强调色新价 spring 跳出→正文逐行揭示且高亮块由左向右刷过→色卡点亮→按钮填满，整卡全程极慢 scale 前推
cards.use: 商品/条目详情页的能力展示；"结构化抽取""自动填充""数据自己长出来"类叙事的主镜头
cards.energy: 中（连续小事件密集排布，无单点爆发；靠前推保持推进感）
cards.intention: 一张详情卡直接淡入，观众只看到"有一张卡"。逐字段落位则把卡变成一份**正在被填写的 表单**：每个字段各自到位，观众的注意力被牵着走一遍卡的信息结构——图在哪、标题在哪、 价格在哪、正文重点在哪。价格划线降级是全片唯一的语义事件（不是"出现"而是"改变"）， 所以它被安排在中段最显眼的位置。

styles.label: product-card-progressive-assemble
styles.description: 详情卡像被逐字段抓取般自建——一枚"填充光标"领先跳格，图→标题→分类 pill 依次 pop→原价出现后被划线降级、强调色新价 spring 跳出→正文逐行揭示且高亮块由左向右刷过→色卡点亮→按钮填满，整卡全程极慢 scale 前推
styles.descriptionEn: A product card builds itself field by field as image, title and pills pop in, the old price gets struck through while an accent new price springs out, and highlighter blocks sweep across the copy.

cards.summaryEn: A product card builds itself field by field as image, title and pills pop in, the old price gets struck through while an accent new price springs out, and highlighter blocks sweep across the copy.
cards.useEn: Capability showcases for product / item detail pages; the main shot for "structured extraction", "auto-fill", "the data grows itself" narratives
cards.intentionEn: A detail card fading in directly shows the audience only "there is a card". Field-by-field landing turns the card into a form being filled in: every field arrives in turn, and the audience's attention is walked through the card's information structure — where the image is, the title, the price, the body's key point. The price's strike-through demotion is the only semantic event in the whole shot (not an "appearance" but a "change"), which is why it is placed in the most visible position mid-way.
cards.energyEn: Medium (dense small events, no single burst; the forward push keeps the momentum)

cards.name: quad-split-parallel-scenes
cards.summary: 画面硬切 2×2 四宫格，四个象限并行跑各自的微场景（打字、急推、逐词、交互链），关键节拍错开 3–6 帧制造信息轰炸
cards.use: 节奏段"功能很多、同时发生"的蒙太奇拍；预告片中段的密度峰值
cards.duration: 90f（3s@30fps：0–62f 并行轰炸 + 28f 终态 hold，全程无转场）
cards.energy: 高（四线并行 + 错拍冲击，标准的 BGM 副歌位）
cards.intention: 用并行密度替代顺序展示：四件事同时在眼前发生，观众来不及逐一细读，但每 3–6 帧就有一个象限"动一下"——扫视节奏被牢牢钉住。这是手法卡：格内内容全部可替换，错拍编排才是配方。

styles.label: quad-split-parallel-scenes
styles.description: 画面硬切 2×2 四宫格，四个象限并行跑各自的微场景（打字、急推、逐词、交互链），关键节拍错开 3–6 帧制造信息轰炸
styles.descriptionEn: The frame hard-cuts into a 2×2 grid where four micro-scenes run in parallel — typing, a whip zoom, word pops, and a cursor interaction chain — with every beat offset by a few frames.

cards.summaryEn: The frame hard-cuts into a 2×2 grid where four micro-scenes run in parallel — typing, a whip zoom, word pops, and a cursor interaction chain — with every beat offset by a few frames.
cards.useEn: The "many features, happening at once" montage shot for rhythm passages; the mid-trailer density peak
cards.intentionEn: Using parallel density instead of sequential display: four things happening at once before the audience's eyes — too fast to read one by one, yet every 3–6 frames one quadrant "moves" — the scanning rhythm is nailed down. This is a technique card: the contents of every cell are fully replaceable; the staggered arrangement is the recipe.
cards.energyEn: High (four parallel lines + staggered hits; the standard BGM chorus slot)

cards.name: radial-ripple-phone-chips
cards.summary: 暖沙底四层同心圆错相呼吸如水波，中央手机 mockup 屏内 feed 自动缓滚，两侧白色 chip 先后 spring pop 入场并悬浮
cards.use: 移动端产品的"这就是它"定格镜头；功能点分列两侧的介绍段；片头/片尾的产品全景
cards.energy: 低（安静、有呼吸感，靠同心圆的持续起伏撑住不冷场）
cards.intention: 用最少的动作把手机放在画面正中并让它"活着"：同心圆负责氛围呼吸， 屏内自动滚屏负责证明"里面有内容在跑"，两侧 chip 负责点出功能名。 三层动作各自极慢，叠起来才不会显得静止——这是产品定格镜头的标准配法。

styles.label: radial-ripple-phone-chips
styles.description: 暖沙底四层同心圆错相呼吸如水波，中央手机 mockup 屏内 feed 自动缓滚，两侧白色 chip 先后 spring pop 入场并悬浮
styles.descriptionEn: Four concentric grey circles breathe out of phase like water ripples while a centered phone mockup auto-scrolls its feed and two white feature chips spring in and hover.

cards.summaryEn: Four concentric grey circles breathe out of phase like water ripples while a centered phone mockup auto-scrolls its feed and two white feature chips spring in and hover.
cards.useEn: The "this is it" freeze shot for mobile products; intro passages with feature points flanking both sides; the product panorama at head / tail
cards.intentionEn: With minimal motion, put the phone dead centre and keep it "alive": concentric rings handle the atmosphere's breathing, the in-screen auto-scroll proves "there's content running inside", and the chips on both sides call out the feature names. All three layers are individually very slow; stacked, they do not read as still — this is the standard recipe for a product freeze shot.
cards.energyEn: Low (quiet, breathing; the concentric rings' continuous rise and fall keep it from going cold)

cards.name: radial-wave
cards.summary: 17×9 圆点阵列按到波源的欧氏距离错峰点亮，每点 scale 过冲到 1.5 再落回常亮，第一道波扫完后第二道亮蓝脉冲从外圈反向收拢回中心
cards.use: 产品/品牌开场的"系统上电"一拍；也用作数据网格、节点地图、覆盖范围类叙事的建立镜头
cards.energy: 中高（起手爆发一次，波前过后转为常亮低能量底子）
cards.intention: 把"很多点同时存在"这件静态事实，改写成"能量从一个源头扩散到全体"的动态事实。观众 看到的不是一张点阵图，而是一次通电：中心先亮，亮度像水波推过去，走完之后整张阵列 留在常亮态——为下一拍要放的内容铺好底。第二道反向波是回执，告诉观众这个系统会回应。

styles.label: radial-wave
styles.description: 17×9 圆点阵列按到波源的欧氏距离错峰点亮，每点 scale 过冲到 1.5 再落回常亮，第一道波扫完后第二道亮蓝脉冲从外圈反向收拢回中心
styles.descriptionEn: A 17x9 dot grid lights up in rings that spread outward from the center, each dot overshooting its scale before settling into a steady glow, then a brighter pulse collapses back inward from the edges.

cards.summaryEn: A 17x9 dot grid lights up in rings that spread outward from the center, each dot overshooting its scale before settling into a steady glow, then a brighter pulse collapses back inward from the edges.
cards.useEn: The "system power-on" beat for product / brand openers; also an establishing shot for data-grid, node-map and coverage narratives
cards.intentionEn: Rewrite the static fact of "many points existing at once" as the dynamic fact of "energy diffusing from one source to all". What the audience sees is not a dot-matrix diagram but an electrification: the centre lights first, brightness pushes across like a water wave, and when it passes the whole array stays in its lit state — laying the ground for the next beat's content. The second, reverse wave is the receipt, telling the audience this system answers back.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (one burst at the start; after the wave-front it settles into a lit low-energy bed)

cards.name: research-card-stack-scroll
cards.summary: 深色论文卡每 12 帧一张沿右下轴线飞入中心叠压，落位带 1 帧压缩，只有最上一张全清晰渲染标题+作者+摘要，下方卡按堆积深度递增模糊变暗只露标题条，背景横向 grid 同步下移做速度参照
cards.use: "读了大量资料/处理了海量文档"的量级交代；研究类、检索类、批处理类产品的能力镜头
cards.energy: 中高（匀速高频，无爆发但持续压迫）
cards.intention: 要说的是"数量"，但一次给 13 张卡会读成一堵墙。改成流水线：卡一张一张进，每张都被 读过（最上一张永远是全文渲染的那张），读完就沉进堆里变模糊。观众感受到的是持续不断 的吞吐量，而不是一个静态的堆。背景 grid 同速下移是速度参照——没有它，堆积会读作 "卡在原地缩小"。

styles.label: research-card-stack-scroll
styles.description: 深色论文卡每 12 帧一张沿右下轴线飞入中心叠压，落位带 1 帧压缩，只有最上一张全清晰渲染标题+作者+摘要，下方卡按堆积深度递增模糊变暗只露标题条，背景横向 grid 同步下移做速度参照
styles.descriptionEn: Dark paper cards drop into the center every twelve frames and pile along a downward-right axis, squashing on landing while only the topmost card renders its full text as the rest blur into the stack.

cards.summaryEn: Dark paper cards drop into the center every twelve frames and pile along a downward-right axis, squashing on landing while only the topmost card renders its full text as the rest blur into the stack.
cards.useEn: Conveying the scale of "read a large amount of material / processed a sea of documents"; capability shots for research, retrieval and batch-processing products
cards.intentionEn: The point is "quantity", but handing over 13 cards at once reads as a wall. Make it a pipeline: cards come in one by one, each is read (the top one is always the fully rendered one), and once read it sinks into the stack and blurs. The audience feels a continuous throughput, not a static pile. The background grid moving down at the same speed is the speed reference — without it, the piling reads as "cards shrinking in place".
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (constant-speed high-frequency; no burst but sustained pressure)

cards.name: rhythm-interrupt-moves
cards.summary: 打断节奏——jump-cut-punch-in 三级跳切推近：同构图三次无补间硬跳放大，逐级逼近目标
cards.use: 用"打断连续性"本身当节奏器：顿挫推近（A）；与 beat-cut-moves（切点排布）互补
cards.energy: A 中
cards.intention: 库内节奏卡管的都是"怎么切、切多密"；本卡管**怎么断**——观众预期 连续，你偏打断，打断方式即表达：A 是空间断——同构图三次无补间跳大 （1x→1.6x→2.6x），戈达尔跳切的顿挫，比连续推近更有"看这里、再近点、 就是它"的指令感。适合强制聚焦指标。

styles.label: jump-cut-punch-in
styles.description: 打断节奏——jump-cut-punch-in 三级跳切推近：同构图三次无补间硬跳放大，逐级逼近目标
styles.use: 逐级逼近核心指标；纪录片式盯住
styles.descriptionEn: Three zoom steps with zero tweening, origin pinned on the target, each jump landing with a darkening pulse like a tick.

cards.summaryEn: Stepped punch-in jump cuts that break cadence on the same frame.
cards.useEn: Using "interrupting continuity" itself as the rhythm device: staccato push-in (A); complementary to beat-cut-moves (cut-point arrangement)
cards.intentionEn: Every rhythm card in the library governs "how to cut and how densely"; this card governs how to break — the audience expects continuity, and you break it on purpose; the way you break it is the expression: A is the spatial break — the same composition jumps three times with no interpolation (1x → 1.6x → 2.6x), the staccato of a Godard jump cut, with more of a "look here, closer, that's it" directive feel than a continuous push-in. Suited to forcibly focusing attention on a metric.
cards.energyEn: A medium

cards.name: riso-print-hits
cards.summary: 套印错位冲击帧——riso-misregistration-hit 单发：标题撞停瞬间裂成双色 riso 印版，抖两下"啪"地套准
cards.use: 标题/卡片的命中强调，纸墨审美版的"故障闪"；全片 1–2 次的单发高潮
cards.energy: 高
cards.intention: RGB 色散故障闪（impact-feedback C 式的一部分）是荧光屏语言，与纸墨 调性相克。这张卡给出印刷版平替：元素裂成两份单色 riso 印版（demo：荧光粉 × 蓝； multiply 油墨感而非 screen 荧光感，两版套准时叠成深色墨）， 像 risograph 没对准版，抖几下 "啪"地套准——同样的冲击力，介质想象完全换成纸上油墨。单发： 撞停瞬间裂版、震荡衰减、硬切套准，给一次命中盖章。demo 是一张 Motion Studio 的 双色 riso 宣传海报（「CRAFT IT / LOUD.」+ 三栏卖点，圆章中心是单色版Motion Studio标志）。

styles.label: misregistration-hit 单发
styles.description: 套印错位冲击帧——riso-misregistration-hit 单发：标题撞停瞬间裂成双色 riso 印版，抖两下"啪"地套准
styles.use: 全片 1-2 次的命中盖章；标题/大字的到位一瞬
styles.descriptionEn: The title slams in and splits into two color plates offset 32px, oscillating down until they snap back into register with a scale pulse.

cards.summaryEn: A risograph impact: a single misregistered colour split that snaps into alignment.
cards.useEn: Hit emphasis for titles / cards — the paper-ink aesthetic's version of the "glitch flash"; a single-shot climax used once or twice per film
cards.intentionEn: RGB dispersion glitch flash (part of impact-feedback style C) is screen language, at odds with the paper-ink tone. This card offers the print-side substitute: the element splits into two single-colour riso plates (demo: fluorescent pink × blue; a multiply ink feel rather than a screen glow, the two plates stacking to a deep ink when registered), like a risograph with misaligned plates, shaking a few times and then snapping into alignment — the same impact, with the medium imagination fully swapped to ink on paper. Single-shot: split at the impact-stop instant, oscillating decay, hard-cut registration, stamping one hit. The demo is a two-colour riso promo poster for Motion Studio ("CRAFT IT / LOUD." + three columns of selling points, with the single-colour Motion Studio mark centred in a round stamp).
cards.energyEn: High

cards.name: row-embed
cards.summary: 内容行像卡片一样从空中降下、rotateX 收平、嵌入瞬间底边亮一道强调色的缝
cards.use: "结构化数据长进页面"的详情页/列表镜头；行级内容的批量入场
cards.energy: 中
cards.intention: 详情页的行不是"显示出来"而是"长进去"——每一行从空中降下并严丝合缝嵌入页面布局，嵌入瞬间的强调色缝是"咔哒"扣上的视觉拟音。

styles.label: row-embed
styles.description: 内容行像卡片一样从空中降下、rotateX 收平、嵌入瞬间底边亮一道强调色的缝
styles.descriptionEn: Content rows descend with perspective, flatten into the page, and flash a thin amber seam at the moment of insertion.

cards.summaryEn: Content rows descend with perspective, flatten into the page, and flash a thin amber seam at the moment of insertion.
cards.useEn: Detail-page / list shots where "structured data grows into the page"; the batch entrance of row-level content
cards.intentionEn: The rows of a detail page do not "display" — they "grow in": every row descends from mid-air and embeds flush into the page layout, the accent-colour seam at the moment of embedding being the visual onomatopoeia of a "click" locked in.
cards.energyEn: Medium

cards.name: sakuga-timing-shift
cards.summary: 一拍三转一拍一——元素先以每 3 帧一步的手翻书顿挫移动，高潮瞬间切成逐帧丝滑冲刺，帧率量化的突变本身就是看点
cards.use: 单元素的强调性位移（卡片入场、指标冲线）；需要"手工感→高潮爆发"反差的段落
cards.energy: 中高
cards.intention: 库内时间轴操纵已有 speed-ramp-freeze 的定格解冻与 hit-counter 的局部顿帧。 本卡是另一种——**改的不是速度是帧率本身**： 顿挫段驱动帧 q=floor(f/3)*3，元素每 3 帧才动一步（10fps 手翻书）， 切换帧起改用原始 f 逐帧驱动，丝滑冲刺。一拍三的钝与一拍一的滑 同屏对切，日式作画的拍数演出（shooting on 3s / on 1s）。顿挫段 不是低级感是手工感，切换点即高潮标记。

styles.label: sakuga-timing-shift
styles.description: 一拍三转一拍一——元素先以每 3 帧一步的手翻书顿挫移动，高潮瞬间切成逐帧丝滑冲刺，帧率量化的突变本身就是看点
styles.descriptionEn: Movement begins in stepped, held drawings and suddenly switches to frame-by-frame acceleration at the climax.

cards.summaryEn: Movement begins in stepped, held drawings and suddenly switches to frame-by-frame acceleration at the climax.
cards.useEn: Emphatic displacement of a single element (card entrance, a metric crossing the line); passages that need the "hand-made feel → climax burst" contrast
cards.intentionEn: The library's timeline manipulation already had speed-ramp-freeze's freeze-thaw and hit-counter's local freeze-frame. This card is another kind — what changes is not the speed but the frame rate itself: the staccato passage drives frame q=floor(f/3)*3, the element moving only every 3 frames (a 10fps flipbook), and from the switch frame the original f drives it frame by frame, a silky sprint. The bluntness of on-threes and the smoothness of on-ones cut against each other on the same screen — the anime cel-shooting performance idiom (shooting on 3s / on 1s). The staccato passage is not low quality, it is hand-made feel; the switch point is the climax marker.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high

cards.name: scan-bracket-sweep
cards.summary: 文档弹到中央，四角落下 L 形取景括号，一条扫描光带拖着渐变尾迹在文档上往复扫 5 趟——文档全程静止，只有光在读它
cards.use: "正在解析/校验这份内容"的过程镜头；文档类产品的能力演示；上传→分析链路的中段
cards.energy: 中低（机械、克制，节奏全在往复扫掠的呼吸上）
cards.intention: 让观众看懂"这份东西正在被机器逐行读过"。取景括号先把目标框住（宣布检查 对象），扫描光带再往复走完全篇（宣布检查过程）。命门是**文档本身完全静止**： 一旦文档也在动，观众就分不清是"被检查"还是"在加载"。

styles.label: scan-bracket-sweep
styles.description: 文档弹到中央，四角落下 L 形取景括号，一条扫描光带拖着渐变尾迹在文档上往复扫 5 趟——文档全程静止，只有光在读它
styles.descriptionEn: A skeleton document pops to center, black L-shaped framing brackets drop into its corners, and a thin line with a gradient trail sweeps up and down across it five times.

cards.summaryEn: A skeleton document pops to center, black L-shaped framing brackets drop into its corners, and a thin line with a gradient trail sweeps up and down across it five times.
cards.useEn: A process shot of "parsing / validating this content"; capability demos for document products; the mid-section of an upload → analysis chain
cards.intentionEn: Let the audience understand "this thing is being read line by line by a machine". The framing brackets lock onto the target first (declaring the object of inspection), then the scanning light band travels back and forth across the whole page (declaring the process of inspection). The make-or-break: the document itself is completely still — the moment the document also moves, the audience cannot tell whether it is "being inspected" or "loading".
cards.energyEn: Medium-low (mechanical, restrained; the rhythm is all in the breathing of the back-and-forth sweep)

cards.name: scanline-annotate-focus
cards.summary: 一条扫描线自上而下匀速掠过已存在的页面，越过哪块区块的下缘，哪块就被四角取景框从外扩处弹簧收拢对准（一次过冲），随后贴出一枚逐字打出的机器标签，顶部状态行同步计数 00/06→06/06
cards.use: "AI 正在读你的页面/品牌"的分析镜头；设计系统/品牌规范的拆解介绍；产品能力的自我说明段
cards.energy: 中（机械冷静，节奏由扫描线匀速推动，标注是节拍点）
cards.intention: 把"分析"这件抽象事做成可见的因果链：扫描线走到哪，那块就被框住、被 命名。观众读的是"机器的视线"，所以扫描线必须匀速、标注必须严格滞后于 扫描线过境——**先扫到再弹框**，顺序一旦错乱就变成了预先编排的动画。

styles.label: scanline-annotate-focus
styles.description: 一条扫描线自上而下匀速掠过已存在的页面，越过哪块区块的下缘，哪块就被四角取景框从外扩处弹簧收拢对准（一次过冲），随后贴出一枚逐字打出的机器标签，顶部状态行同步计数 00/06→06/06
styles.descriptionEn: A bright scanline travels down the page and, as it clears each block, camera framing brackets snap inward onto that region and a monospace caption types out beside it.

cards.summaryEn: A bright scanline travels down the page and, as it clears each block, camera framing brackets snap inward onto that region and a monospace caption types out beside it.
cards.useEn: Analysis shots of "the AI is reading your page / brand"; breakdowns of design systems / brand specs; self-explanatory product-capability passages
cards.intentionEn: Turn the abstract act of "analysis" into a visible causal chain: wherever the scanline goes, that block gets framed and named. What the audience reads is "the machine's gaze", so the scanline must be constant-speed and the annotations must lag strictly behind the scanline's passage — frame first, then pop — once the order scrambles it becomes a pre-choreographed animation.
cards.energyEn: Medium (mechanical and calm; the rhythm is pushed by the scanline's constant speed, the annotations are the beat points)

cards.name: scanline-assemble-flyin
cards.summary: 页面开场是一张只有网格与虚线槽位的蓝图画板，一条亮扫描线自上而下掠过；扫到每个槽位，该处组件就从画外飞入过冲贴合，带方向性残影模糊与落位咬合角标——扫完整页恰好装配完成
cards.use: "页面自己生成"的开场；AI 建站/自动排版类产品的核心演示；从空白到成品的能力叙事
cards.energy: 中高（扫描线是稳的，但每次组件飞入都是一个爆点，密度递进）
cards.intention: 让"页面被生成"这件事有一个可信的施工顺序：扫描线是施工进度条， 组件从画外飞进来贴合是施工动作。关键是**扫完那一刻恰好装完最后一块** ——扫描线提前收工或组件拖尾都会让"扫描驱动装配"的因果关系散掉。

styles.label: scanline-assemble-flyin
styles.description: 页面开场是一张只有网格与虚线槽位的蓝图画板，一条亮扫描线自上而下掠过；扫到每个槽位，该处组件就从画外飞入过冲贴合，带方向性残影模糊与落位咬合角标——扫完整页恰好装配完成
styles.descriptionEn: The page starts as an empty dark grid; a scanline descends and each component flies in from off-screen to snap into place behind it, with motion blur and a bright edge flash on landing.

cards.summaryEn: The page starts as an empty dark grid; a scanline descends and each component flies in from off-screen to snap into place behind it, with motion blur and a bright edge flash on landing.
cards.useEn: Openers where "the page generates itself"; the core demo for AI site-building / auto-layout products; the capability narrative from blank to finished
cards.intentionEn: Give "the page being generated" a credible construction order: the scanline is the progress bar, components flying in from off-screen and landing are the construction actions. The key: the instant the scan finishes is exactly the instant the last piece lands — either the scan finishing early or components trailing behind, and the "scan drives assembly" causality falls apart.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (the scanline is steady, but every component flying in is a burst point; density builds)

cards.name: scroll-brake-moves
cards.summary: 长卷急刹两式——changelog-scroll-brake 基本款（高速长卷指数减速精准停位+目标抬升）与 brake-reticle-lock 组合款（急刹帧同帧准星咬合）
cards.use: changelog/发布史/长列表段落："一直在发货，今天这条最大"；要给停点更强打击感用 B
cards.energy: 高开中收（速度对比型）
cards.intention: Linear changelog 视频语法：一整年的更新日志作为长卷高速掠过 （糊成色带），指数减速精准急刹停在本次发布那条上，该条抬升离面 高亮、其余退暗——密度感讲"一直在发货"，急停讲"今天这条最大"。 B 是组合变异：急刹帧**同帧**四个 L 角标从画外飞入咬合锁定停点 条目——急刹的"哐"与咬合的"咔"叠在同一帧共振（组合命门： 角标起跳帧=列表首停帧，错开退化成两招并置）。

styles.label: changelog-scroll-brake
styles.description: translateY 扫 ~2400px（out exp 指数减速 ~50f），blur 由帧间位移差分驱动（0-6px 自动清零）；停点行 scale 1.03 抬升+阴影+3px 描边，其余 opacity 退 0.38
styles.use: changelog 段落基本款
styles.descriptionEn: A 2400px scroll decelerates exponentially over 50 frames, motion blur driven by per-frame speed, and the target row lifts lit while the rest dim.

styles.label: brake-reticle-lock
styles.description: 滚动三段：sin-in 加速→cubic-out 猛减速冲过头 +30px→回弹落定；blur=v×0.12 封顶 24px；角标从 ±620/±320 画外 Easing.back(2.4) 飞入咬合，高亮 6f 内完成、标签 back(2.6) 弹出
styles.use: 停点需要更强打击感的高光段
styles.descriptionEn: The scroll overshoots 30px past the target and springs back, and on the brake frame corner brackets fly in and bite with a popping label.

cards.summaryEn: Two fast-scroll stops: a long page decelerating precisely onto a target, and the same stop paired with a locking reticle.
cards.useEn: Changelog / release-history / long-list passages: "always shipping, and today's entry is the biggest"; use B for a stronger hit on the stop
cards.intentionEn: The Linear changelog video grammar: a whole year's changelog rushes past as a long scroll (smearing into a colour band), decelerates exponentially into a precise emergency stop on today's release entry, that entry lifting off the plane and highlighted while the rest recede into dimness — the density says "always shipping", the emergency stop says "today's is the biggest". B is the combination variant: at the brake frame, four L-shaped corner marks fly in from off-screen in the same frame and bite-lock the stopped entry — the brake's "clunk" and the lock's "click" resonating in the same frame (combination make-or-break: the corner marks' takeoff frame = the list's first stop frame; offset them and it degenerates into two tricks side by side).
cards.energyEn: High start, medium finish (speed-contrast type)

cards.name: segmented-thumb-hero
cards.summary: 分段控件 thumb 位移当主角特写——超大胶囊 segmented control 弹簧浮入，描边箭头光标画外滑入按下，白 thumb 8f ease-out 滑到另一段，到位瞬间新图标 spring 弹出、旧图标收起
cards.use: "模式切换/二选一"功能的宣告镜头（demo 的 Motion Studio Prompt→Film、Chat→Agent 式）；一个 UI 微交互撑一整镜的特写拍法
cards.duration: ~3.5s（demo 110f：浮入 18f + 光标 24f + 点击 + 滑动 8f + 图标弹出 + hold）
cards.energy: 中（微交互特写，精致不轰）
cards.intention: 产品切到新模式，通常拍法是整个界面换掉。本卡反着来：把 segmented control 放大到 1080px 宽拍特写，**thumb 那 8 帧位移本身就是叙事**—— "我们从 A 走到了 B"。没有任何页面上下文，控件即舞台。因果链完整： 光标滑入（有人来了）→ 按下+涟漪（做了决定）→ thumb 滑动（世界响应） → 新图标弹出（新身份确立）。四拍缺一不可，缺了光标就是 UI 自己在动， 缺了图标弹出就是切换没有奖励。

styles.label: segmented-thumb-hero
styles.description: 分段控件 thumb 位移当主角特写——超大胶囊 segmented control 弹簧浮入，描边箭头光标画外滑入按下，白 thumb 8f ease-out 滑到另一段，到位瞬间新图标 spring 弹出、旧图标收起
styles.descriptionEn: An oversized segmented control gets a close-up: a cursor slides in, presses, and the white thumb snaps to the other segment as icons swap with a spring.

cards.summaryEn: An oversized segmented control gets a close-up: a cursor slides in, presses, and the white thumb snaps to the other segment as icons swap with a spring.
cards.useEn: The announcement shot for "mode switch / either-or" features (the demo's Motion Studio Prompt→Film, Chat→Agent style); the close-up treatment where one UI micro-interaction carries a whole shot
cards.intentionEn: When a product switches to a new mode the usual treatment is the whole interface changing. This card does the opposite: blow the segmented control up to 1080px wide and shoot it in close-up, the thumb's 8-frame displacement being the narrative itself — "we went from A to B". No page context at all; the control is the stage. The causal chain is complete: the cursor slides in (someone arrived) → press + ripple (a decision was made) → the thumb slides (the world responds) → the new icon pops (the new identity is established). None of the four beats can be missing: without the cursor the UI moves itself, without the icon pop the switch has no reward.
cards.energyEn: Medium (micro-interaction close-up; exquisite, not explosive)

cards.name: shot-transitions
cards.summary: 镜头交棒三式——推进流白、whip-pan 甩镜（急刹款）、mask-wipe 穿窗（纵深款），按能量落差与接缝语义选型
cards.use: 任何两镜衔接处（技法卡，分镜阶段排完镜头后逐个接缝选一式）
cards.duration: n/a（技法卡；各式占用帧数见参数表，从相邻镜头预算里划）
cards.energy: n/a（技法卡，不占能量位）
cards.intention: 库内各镜头卡只管自己的入场和收尾，镜与镜"怎么接"一直没有词汇—— 接缝裸切会把逐镜头攒出的电影感一次漏光。公认优秀的发布片 （Linear Releases/Agent，2026-07-11 抽帧逆向）全程没有一次裸切： 换景要么靠深度旅行、要么靠焦点接力、要么靠黑场字卡蓄力。本卡收三式： 白闪盖切、甩镜借糊帧换景、穿窗点进详情世界。

styles.label: 推进流白 flash-cut
styles.description: 前镜相机推进，切点跨骑一层白闪盖住换页
styles.use: 交互穿透、能量相近的页面→页面（库内已有，收编）
styles.descriptionEn: The camera pushes in and a white flash straddles the cut, hiding the page swap inside the flare.

styles.label: whip-pan 甩镜
styles.description: 机位一拍横甩到下一场景，中段运动模糊糊到不可辨，借糊帧换景
styles.use: 快节奏功能段连打（高能量→高能量的轻快款，比 B 式省帧提速）
styles.descriptionEn: The camera whips sideways so hard the middle frames smear illegible, and the new scene is waiting when it stops.

styles.label: mask-wipe 穿窗
styles.description: 页面内真实元素（卡片）放大成全屏窗口，新场景从窗内长出接管
styles.use: 语义化接缝：功能总览→该功能详情（"点开这张卡进入它的世界"）
styles.descriptionEn: A real element in the page — a card — scales up into a full-screen window, and the next scene grows out from inside it.

cards.summaryEn: Three handoff recipes for matching scene energy: flash cut, braking whip pan, and portal mask wipe.
cards.useEn: Any seam between two shots (a technique card: after the storyboard stage lays out the shots, pick one style per seam)
cards.intentionEn: Every shot card in the library governs only its own entrance and exit; how shots connect to each other had no vocabulary — a bare cut at the seam leaks away the cinematic feel accumulated shot by shot in one go. Recognised-excellent launch films (Linear Releases/Agent, reverse-engineered from frames on 2026-07-11) have not a single bare cut: scene changes rely either on a depth journey, a focus relay, or a dark-ground title card charging up. This card collects three styles: white-flash cover cut, whip-pan borrowing the blurred frame for the change, through-the-window point-click into the detail world.
cards.energyEn: n/a (a technique card; does not occupy an energy slot)

cards.name: slam-entrance-moves
cards.summary: 高能砸入三式——kanada-perspective-snap 金田透视急停、score-slam 比分砸落、impact-burst-kit 落点冲击套件（波及邻卡）
cards.use: 主角卡/KPI 卡的重拳入场；impact-feedback 管落位后的反馈，本卡管入场本身就是冲击
cards.duration: 单式动作段 6–22f + 冲击余波 ~16f + hold ≥45f（demo：A 120f / B 135f / C 140f）
cards.energy: 高
cards.intention: 库内入场词汇的力度上限一直是 deck-deal-flyin 的"发牌"——快但不重。 本卡补"砸"这一档，三种口味：A 是方向感——卡片带鱼眼级夸张透视贴着 镜头甩进来，"啪"地弹平，动漫金田流的潇洒；B 是重量感——KPI 卡从 镜头前 2.6 倍大小砸落，圆环+尘点+震屏三件套同帧起爆，体育比分弹窗 的分量；C 是传导感——B 的三件套之上，冲击波前沿扫过左右邻卡时把 它们可见地推开再弹回，"这一下震到了邻居"，一件事说清力量大小。 选型按叙事需要：告诉观众"它来了"用 A，"它很重"用 B，"它震动了 全场"用 C。

styles.label: kanada-perspective-snap
styles.description: perspective 300→1500px + rotate3d 58°→0 + scale 1.7→1 甩入 18f，末 4f 过冲 +5° 弹平，长斜影收正
styles.use: 单卡潇洒亮相；调性偏动漫/轻快
styles.descriptionEn: Kanada-style snap: perspective 300 to 1500, rotate3d 58 degrees to flat, scale 1.7 to 1 in 18 frames, with a 4-frame overshoot as long shadows settle.

styles.label: score-slam
styles.description: 卡从 scale 2.5/rotate 5° 六帧 Easing.in(quad) 砸落，落点帧圆环扩散+尘点飞散+震屏同帧
styles.use: KPI/比分类重磅数字登场
styles.descriptionEn: A card drops from 2.5x scale and 5 degrees in six accelerating frames; the landing frame fires a shock ring, dust, and screen shake at once.

styles.label: impact-burst-kit
styles.description: B 三件套 + 冲击波前沿按半径-距离精算扫过邻卡帧，邻卡外推 30px + rotate ±3° 阻尼弹回
styles.use: 页面上已有邻居时的"全场震动"
styles.descriptionEn: The full landing kit plus a physically-timed shockwave that shoves neighboring cards 30px outward with damped tilts as it passes.

cards.summaryEn: Three high-energy arrivals: a perspective snap, a score drop, and an impact burst that pushes nearby elements.
cards.useEn: The heavy-punch entrance of hero / KPI cards; impact-feedback governs the feedback after landing, this card makes the entrance itself the impact
cards.intentionEn: In the library the upper bound of entrance force had always been deck-deal-flyin's "dealing" — fast but not heavy. This card adds the "slam" tier in three flavours: A is direction — the card whips toward the lens with fisheye-grade exaggerated perspective and snaps flat, the anime Kanada-style panache. B is weight — the KPI card slams down from 2.6× size in front of the lens, with ring + dust particles + screen shake all detonating in the same frame, the heft of a sports-score popup. C is conduction — on top of B's three-piece set, the shockwave front visibly pushes the neighbouring cards left and right away and back as it sweeps past them: "this one shook the neighbours", saying the size of the force in one thing. Choose by narrative need: to tell the audience "it's here" use A, "it's heavy" use B, "it shook the whole room" use C.
cards.energyEn: High

cards.name: space-camera-moves
cards.summary: 3D 空间化运镜两式——exploded-view 爆炸分解（构件沿 Z 炸开再合体）、drone-dive-landing 无人机俯冲降落
cards.use: 把平面页面当 3D 实体拍的高光段落；两式都是"大动作"，一支片合计 ≤2 次
cards.duration: A 170f（5.7s，炸开-悬停-合体-收尾标题全程）；C 105f（3.5s，俯冲 69f + 落定 hold 36f）单向俯冲
cards.energy: 高
cards.intention: depth-layer 卡是给平移加纵深——层在动、页面还是页面。这两式更进一步： 整页被当成一个 3D 实体，相机（或世界）绕着它做实拍级机动。两式叙事 语义各占一格：A 说"看看它由什么组成"（拆解展示，Apple 发布片语言）； C 说"从全局俯瞰砸到主角"（上帝视角一头扎进 hero 特写，全景→焦点）。

styles.label: exploded-view
styles.description: 整页 3D 倾斜后构件沿 Z 轴错峰炸开悬停，一拍后逆序合体震屏收口
styles.use: 架构/组成展示："这个产品里有什么"；模块总览段
styles.descriptionEn: The page tilts into 3D and its parts blast apart along Z, hover a beat, then reassemble in reverse with a closing shake.

styles.label: drone-dive-landing
styles.description: 近垂直俯角悬停 → 猛扎俯冲 → 气垫减速停在 hero 卡特写
styles.use: 开场定场→入题；全局地图砸进单点的章节启动
styles.descriptionEn: From a near-vertical hover the camera plunges, then air-brakes to a stop on the hero card close-up.

cards.summaryEn: Three spatial camera moves: exploded assembly, subject-locked rotation, and a drone-like dive to the landing point.
cards.useEn: High-light passages that shoot flat pages as 3D solids; both styles are "big moves" — at most 2 per film
cards.intentionEn: The depth-layer cards add depth to a pan — the layers move but the page stays a page. These two styles go further: the whole page is treated as a 3D solid, with the camera (or the world) performing live-action-grade manoeuvres around it. The two styles each occupy one narrative slot: A says "see what it's made of" (exploded-view showcase, Apple launch-film language); C says "crash from an overview down onto the hero" (a god's-eye dive into the hero close-up, overview → focus).
cards.energyEn: High

cards.name: speed-ramp-freeze
cards.summary: 帧号非线性 remap 的节奏手法——定格标注（流动→定格圈注→解冻）
cards.use: 卡片流/长横移中把一个重点"停下给人看"；教学解说、评审语境
cards.energy: 中高（速度反差本身即energy beat）
cards.intention: 匀速流读作 PPT（R2），全程快流观众抓不住重点（R3）。定格标注在一条 运动里干脆停下来——马克笔圈出重点再走。技术根是帧号 remap（斜率即速率）， 语义是"停课划重点"。

styles.label: freeze-annotate
styles.description: 帧号非线性 remap 的节奏手法——定格标注（流动→定格圈注→解冻）
