styles.descriptionEn: The stream freezes mid-flow, a circled annotation pops on the frozen frame, then everything thaws and keeps moving.

cards.summaryEn: A freeze used for on-screen annotation before motion resumes.
cards.useEn: Stopping one highlight "for a look" inside a card flow / long pan; teaching commentary and review contexts
cards.intentionEn: A constant-speed flow reads as PowerPoint (R2); an all-fast flow and the audience cannot catch the key point (R3). Freeze-annotate stops cleanly inside a motion — circles the key point with a marker and moves on. The technical root is frame-number remapping (the slope is the rate); the semantics are "pausing class to underline the key point".
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (the speed contrast itself is the energy beat)

cards.name: spotlight-hero-card
cards.summary: 关灯的剧场里一束钨丝聚光（带体积光柱）扫过页面锁定一张卡，斜侧推进后卡片弹起悬浮、香槟色光束沿轮廓两圈、连同 3D 注记一起贴回原位
cards.use: "单一主角"式产品开场；把一个核心对象（卡片/条目/模块）立成全片主角
cards.duration: 172f（约 5.7s；锁定 f34 → 触地 f142 → 30f 真静止 hold）
cards.energy: 中（质感最高的一镜，节奏慢而稳）
cards.intention: 开场只讲一件事：这一张卡就是产品的原子单位。聚光灯替观众做视线引导，弹起悬浮给它体积和重量，轮廓光束是"扫描/检视"的隐喻，最后贴回原位表示它属于这个页面。

styles.label: spotlight-hero-card
styles.description: 关灯的剧场里一束钨丝聚光（带体积光柱）扫过页面锁定一张卡，斜侧推进后卡片弹起悬浮、香槟色光束沿轮廓两圈、连同 3D 注记一起贴回原位
styles.descriptionEn: A spotlight selects one card, the camera pushes diagonally, the card lifts for two outline passes, then returns to the page.

cards.summaryEn: A spotlight selects one card, the camera pushes diagonally, the card lifts for two outline passes, then returns to the page.
cards.useEn: A "single protagonist" product opener; establishing one core object (card / item / module) as the whole film's hero
cards.intentionEn: The opener says only one thing: this one card is the product's atomic unit. The spotlight does the audience's gaze guidance for them, the bounce-and-hover gives it volume and weight, the contour beam is the metaphor of "scanning / inspecting", and finally it settles back into place, showing it belongs to this page.
cards.energyEn: Medium (the shot with the finest texture; slow and steady rhythm)

cards.name: spotlight-sweep-moves
cards.summary: 暗场聚光显影三式——A 醒睡扫过（光到即亮光走即暗）、B 贴边泛光横摇（紫光贴 UI 边缘渗入+聚光匀速右移）、C 角落匀速显影（径向聚光从角落匀速扩张点亮全屏）；黑场里"光即叙事"的 UI 展示
cards.use: 暗色调品牌片里逐个介绍 UI 面板/功能区；黑场开场把界面"点亮"登场；段落间光转场
cards.duration: 单式 3.5–4.5s；A/B 可串联成巡礼段
cards.energy: 中低（克制、神秘感，爆点在"亮起"瞬间）
cards.intention: 黑场里观众只能看见光给看的东西——聚光既是照明也是运镜和剪辑： 光到哪里哪里登场，光走即谢幕。三式共用"贴边紫色辉光光线"这个 身份元素（光线贴着 UI 边框/logo/顶边走，辉光要亮要糊，是光在 "抚摸"界面而不是描边动画）。命门是**匀速**：聚光的移动/扩张 严格 linear——缓动会让光有"意图"，匀速才读作探照灯的机械扫掠 （C 式判例：linear 但半径终值过大＝前 1/4 就饱和，观感照样不匀速）。

styles.label: glow-wake-sleep-panel
styles.description: 醒睡扫过：radial 显影罩跟随光头从左向右匀速移动，贴顶边紫色光线三层辉光同行，经过 logo 描光、到右缘点亮竖直残光，尾段面板沉回黑暗
styles.use: 暗色调品牌片里介绍单个 UI 面板——有醒有睡的登场与谢幕
styles.descriptionEn: Wake-and-sleep sweep: a reveal mask follows the light head left to right — lit where it passes, sinking back to dark behind it.

styles.label: slide-spotlight-pan
styles.description: 贴边泛光横摇：光线先绕左上角竖缘、转角后沿顶边横走，紫光晕染渗入 UI 顶部内侧；聚光头匀速右移显影 + 面板匀速左滑＝相机右摇感
styles.use: 横向巡礼宽面板/多列看板，逐段点亮功能区
styles.descriptionEn: Edge-hugging glow: the beam rounds the corner and rides the top edge, violet bleed seeping into the UI, while the panel slides opposite like a camera pan.

styles.label: corner-spotlight-reveal
styles.description: 角落匀速显影：左上角径向聚光半径严格 linear 扩张，照到显影照不到沉黑，最终全屏亮起——光即转场
styles.use: 黑场开场点亮界面登场；段落间光转场
styles.descriptionEn: A radial spotlight expands from the corner at strictly linear speed — lit inside, black outside — until the full screen is on. Light as the transition.

cards.summaryEn: Three dark-scene spotlight moves: a wake-sleep sweep, an edge-glow pan with purple bleed, and a radial reveal expanding from a corner.
cards.useEn: Introducing UI panels / functional areas one by one in a dark-toned brand film; the dark-ground opener that "lights up" the interface; light transitions between passages
cards.intentionEn: In a dark ground the audience sees only what the light gives them — the spotlight is at once illumination, camera move and edit: where the light arrives, things enter; as the light leaves, they exit. All three styles share the "edge-hugging purple glow light" identity element (the light runs along the UI borders / logo / top edge, the glow bright and soft — the light is "caressing" the interface, not a stroke animation). The make-or-break is constant speed: the spotlight's movement / expansion is strictly linear — easing gives the light "intent", while constant speed reads as a searchlight's mechanical sweep (style C's tested rule: linear but with too large a final radius = saturation in the first quarter, and the feel is still not constant speed).
cards.energyEn: Medium-low (restrained, mysterious; the burst point is the instant of "lighting up")

cards.name: steep-tilt-glide
cards.summary: 固定镜头下直立页面以 60° 强透视侧立（右近左远），页面自身沿其 3D 横面方向滑移掠过镜头（物动镜不动），滑移带速度重影、文字组件悬空贴落、由暗揭亮
cards.use: 长页面/多区块 UI 的炫技巡览（内容依次滑过固定机位）；暗场霓虹调性；与贴面运镜卡互补的"侧掠"机位
cards.energy: 中高（透视炫技+持续运动，但节奏是匀的）
cards.intention: 把页面立成一堵斜墙：镜头钉死不动，60° 强透视让右缘贴脸、左缘 消失在灭点，页面自己沿自身平面横向滑移——内容像列车车厢一样 依次掠过。命门是**物动镜不动**：perspective/origin/rotY 全程常数， 唯一动的量是页面局部 translateX——镜头一动语义就变成运镜炫技， 这里的戏是"页面在自我展示"。角度经三轮收敛为精确 60° （-45°"不对"→-53°"再大一点"→-60°选中）。

styles.label: steep-tilt-glide
styles.description: 固定镜头下直立页面以 60° 强透视侧立（右近左远），页面自身沿其 3D 横面方向滑移掠过镜头（物动镜不动），滑移带速度重影、文字组件悬空贴落、由暗揭亮
styles.descriptionEn: A page stands at a steep 60-degree perspective and glides across a fixed camera with speed ghosting while text settles onto the surface mid-flight.

cards.summaryEn: A page stands at a steep 60-degree perspective and glides across a fixed camera with speed ghosting while text settles onto the surface mid-flight.
cards.useEn: The showpiece tour of long pages / multi-block UIs (content sliding past a fixed camera in turn); dark-ground neon tone; the "side-swipe" camera position complementary to the surface-grazing camera card
cards.intentionEn: Stand the page up as a slanted wall: the camera is nailed still, a 60° strong perspective puts the right edge in your face and the left vanishes into the vanishing point, while the page itself slides horizontally along its own plane — content sweeping past like train cars. The make-or-break is that the object moves and the camera does not: perspective / origin / rotY are constants throughout; the only moving quantity is the page's local translateX — the moment the camera moves, the semantics become camera-move showboating; the act here is "the page showing itself". The angle converged over three rounds to exactly 60° (-45° "no" → -53° "a bit more" → -60° selected).
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (perspective showpiece + continuous motion, but the rhythm is even)

cards.name: stroke-segment-build
cards.summary: 断笔成字——标题拆成十几段互不相连的笔画乱序逐段点亮，前 70% 不可读，末段落位瞬间语义"啪"地成立
cards.use: 开场吊悬念的产品名/大数字揭晓；一支片 ≤1 次；与 type-assembly/draw-svg-trace 分工：那些是"看着字被组装/描画"，本卡是"意义延迟揭晓"
cards.energy: 低起中收（悬念型，落位帧是能量点）
cards.intention: 《异形》片头判例：标题不是被画出来的，是"显影"出来的——拆成离散 笔画段乱序点亮，观众前 70% 时间只看到神秘碎段，最后几段落位的瞬间 突然读出是什么字。"认出的那一刻"就是钩子，钩子的强度取决于 不可读期撑多久、钥匙段压多晚。

styles.label: stroke-segment-build
styles.description: 断笔成字——标题拆成十几段互不相连的笔画乱序逐段点亮，前 70% 不可读，末段落位瞬间语义"啪"地成立
styles.descriptionEn: Disconnected title strokes illuminate in a scrambled order and become readable only when the final segments snap into place.

cards.summaryEn: Disconnected title strokes illuminate in a scrambled order and become readable only when the final segments snap into place.
cards.useEn: Revealing a product name / big number on opening suspense; at most once per film; division of labour with type-assembly / draw-svg-trace: those are "watching the characters be assembled / drawn", this one is "the meaning revealed late"
cards.intentionEn: The Alien title-sequence rule: the title is not drawn, it is "developed" — split into discrete stroke segments lit in random order; for the first 70% of the time the audience sees only mysterious fragments, and in the instant the final segments land they suddenly read what the word is. "The moment of recognition" is the hook, and the hook's strength depends on how long the unreadable period holds out and how late the key segments are held back.
cards.energyEn: Low start, medium finish (suspense type; the landing frame is the energy point)

cards.name: tear-streak-transitions
cards.summary: 撕裂转场——glitch-displace 噪声撕裂（16 横条错位抖动中硬切），数字故障语义的条带级撕裂
cards.use: 高能换页：数字故障/断裂语义；页面完整性不破、能量拉满的条带级撕裂
cards.energy: 高
cards.intention: 本卡管**条带级撕裂**——页面被切成横条高速运动，但每条内容完整。 这是反复裁决划出的品味分界：碎块系转场三连否（doom-melt 竖条坠落、 pixel-dissolve 方块翻黑、facade-block 砖块翻飞全部淘汰），条带系过关。碎块读作"页面被破坏"，条带读作"页面在高速 运动"——完整性不破、能量却拉满。横向撕：条带左右错位抖动 + 双色剪影重影（RGB split 的克制版：同一页内容的两份单色剪影，只用画面强调色两色，±12px 错开）。 适用系统故障/瞬间跳变语义——demo 用它做"发布控制台从 Rolling out 99% 跳到 is live"的状态跳变。

styles.label: glitch-displace
styles.description: 撕裂转场——glitch-displace 噪声撕裂（16 横条错位抖动中硬切），数字故障语义的条带级撕裂
styles.use: 故障/断裂语义；高潮前的暴力换页
styles.descriptionEn: A high-energy tear: horizontal glitch strips whose displacement hides the hard cut.

cards.summaryEn: A high-energy tear: horizontal glitch strips whose displacement hides the hard cut.
cards.useEn: High-energy page changes: digital-glitch / rupture semantics; streak-level tearing that keeps the page intact while energy runs full
cards.intentionEn: This card governs streak-level tearing — the page is cut into horizontal strips moving at high speed, but each strip's content stays complete. This is a taste boundary drawn by repeated rulings: the fragment-family transitions were rejected three times over (doom-melt's vertical bars falling, pixel-dissolve's squares flipping to black, facade-block's bricks flying — all eliminated), while the streak family passed. Fragments read as "the page is broken", streaks read as "the page is moving at high speed" — integrity intact, energy full. The horizontal tear: strips jitter with left-right displacement + two-colour silhouette ghosting (a restrained RGB split: two single-colour silhouettes of the same page content, using only the frame's two accent colours, offset ±12px). Suited to system-failure / instant-jump semantics — the demo uses it for the "release console jumping from Rolling out 99% to is live" state change.
cards.energyEn: High

cards.name: tension-camera-moves
cards.summary: 情绪运镜两式——bullet-time 冻结环绕、pull-back 拉远孤立，相机替观众"感受"而非"看"
cards.use: 情绪节点（震撼/收束）的运镜语言；与 space-camera-moves 的"炫技大动作"互补——这两式动作小、情绪重
cards.energy: A 高 / B 低收
cards.intention: space-camera-moves 三式是"把页面当 3D 实体拍"的高光炫技；这两式相反—— 动作本身克制，全部劲道在情绪语义上：A 说"这一刻值得停下时间看" （运动中的元素被冻住、相机绕行审视）；B 说"最后只剩这一件事" （后拉中周围逐层熄灭，孤悬一点收束全片）。两式各占一个情绪格， 是分镜阶段"这一段观众该感到什么"的直接词汇。

styles.label: bullet-time-freeze-orbit 冻结环绕
styles.description: 图表生长到一半全冻住，相机绕悬停的 UI 平面 rotateY 扫 55° 再回，时间恢复接着长完
styles.use: 核心数据/图表的加冕时刻；"值得停表看"的一格
styles.descriptionEn: A growing chart freezes mid-animation while the camera orbits the hovering UI plane 55 degrees and back, then time resumes.

styles.label: pull-back-isolation 拉远孤立
styles.description: 从发光主卡特写后拉，兄弟卡按距离错峰熄灭、背景沉黑，孤卡悬在暗场中央
styles.use: 结尾收束；"全片只为这一个数字"的谢幕
styles.descriptionEn: The camera pulls back from one glowing card while its siblings go dark by distance, leaving it alone in a black field.

cards.summaryEn: Two emotional camera tools: a frozen orbit and an isolating pull-back.
cards.useEn: The camera language for emotional nodes (shock / closure); complementary to space-camera-moves' "showpiece big moves" — these two styles are small in action, heavy in emotion
cards.intentionEn: The three space-camera-moves styles are the highlight showpieces of "shooting the page as a 3D solid"; these two are the opposite — the action itself is restrained, all the force in the emotional semantics: A says "this moment is worth stopping time for" (an element in motion is frozen, the camera orbits to scrutinise it); B says "in the end only this one thing remains" (while pulling back, the surroundings go dark layer by layer, a lone suspended point closing the whole film). Each style occupies one emotional slot, direct vocabulary for the storyboard-stage question "what should the audience feel in this passage".
cards.energyEn: A high / B low finish

cards.name: terminal-3d
cards.summary: 三个终端窗散布 3D 空间，相机窗间飞行、途中正弦拉远，每到一窗打字机敲命令、结果逐行滑出——命令执行的空间叙事流
cards.use: 开发者产品的 CLI/工作流演示：把"三步命令"拍成三站空间旅程
cards.duration: 约 8.2s（246f@30fps；三站各约 2–3s 停留 + 两段 30f 飞行）
cards.energy: 中（飞行给动感、打字给节奏，整体是沉稳的技术叙事；收在 ● READY 一记亮点）
cards.intention: 终端输出天生是"平面滚动"的反电影语言，这张卡把它空间化：每条命令占据空间中一个实体窗口，相机像穿过机房一样逐窗拜访。飞行途中的拉远让观众瞥见"还有更多窗口"——工作流的全貌感。

styles.label: terminal-3d
styles.description: 三个终端窗散布 3D 空间，相机窗间飞行、途中正弦拉远，每到一窗打字机敲命令、结果逐行滑出——命令执行的空间叙事流
styles.descriptionEn: Three terminal windows float at different poses in 3D space; the camera flies between them with a sine pull-back, and at each stop a command types out and its results slide in line by line.

cards.summaryEn: Three terminal windows float at different poses in 3D space; the camera flies between them with a sine pull-back, and at each stop a command types out and its results slide in line by line.
cards.useEn: CLI / workflow demos for developer products: shooting "three commands" as a three-station spatial journey
cards.intentionEn: Terminal output is inherently the anti-cinematic language of "flat scrolling"; this card spatialises it: each command occupies a physical window in space, and the camera visits them one by one like walking through a server room. The pull-back during the flight lets the audience glimpse "there are more windows" — a sense of the workflow's full shape.
cards.energyEn: Medium (the flight gives momentum, the typing gives rhythm; overall a composed technical narrative; it closes on a single highlight, "● READY")

cards.name: text-as-mask
cards.summary: 文字视频遮罩——瓷白舞台上切出超粗大标题字，字内部透出缓慢平移的暗色实时产品面板，结尾吸一口气后字形指数冲入放大 46 倍溢出、内部画面接管全屏
cards.use: 品牌词/口号与产品画面二合一的开场或章节卡；字是门、产品在门里
cards.duration: 165f（入场 18f + 字内漂移 78f + 吸气 8f + 冲入接管 24f + 落定/hold 37f）
cards.energy: 中高（漂移段沉稳，接管段一次爆发）
cards.intention: 标题和产品画面抢屏幕是老问题——先字后画慢，画上压字挤。这一式让 两者同体：字形就是遮罩，产品只透过笔画显形，观众同时读到词和画面 质感；结尾字形胀开溢出画幅，产品自然接管全屏——"从品牌词走进产品" 一条镜头说完，兼任章节转场（与 transition-travel A 字腔穿越同族： 那边是镜头钻进字腔，这边是字形自己胀开，前者相机动、后者门动）。

styles.label: text-as-mask
styles.description: 文字视频遮罩——瓷白舞台上切出超粗大标题字，字内部透出缓慢平移的暗色实时产品面板，结尾吸一口气后字形指数冲入放大 46 倍溢出、内部画面接管全屏
styles.descriptionEn: Product footage moves inside oversized title letters before the type expands until the footage takes over the frame.

cards.summaryEn: Product footage moves inside oversized title letters before the type expands until the footage takes over the frame.
cards.useEn: Openers or section cards fusing a brand word / slogan with product imagery; the word is the door, the product is behind it
cards.intentionEn: Title and product imagery fighting over the screen is an old problem — word first then picture is slow, picture with text on top is cramped. This style makes them one body: the glyphs are the mask, the product visible only through the strokes, and the audience reads both the word and the picture's texture at once; at the end the glyphs swell past the frame and the product naturally takes the whole screen — "from brand word into product" told in one shot, doubling as a section transition (in the same family as transition-travel style A's glyph-cavity travel: there the camera bores into the glyph cavity, here the glyph itself swells open — in the former the camera moves, in the latter the door moves).
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (composed during the drift; one burst at the takeover)

cards.name: text-column-converge
cards.summary: 双词对峙合拢——左"NEW"右特性词钉死在等屏边距两侧硬切轮换、全程零收缩，换到最后一词才唯一一次 ease-in-out 滑到居中咬合成短语，下方小字近乎硬切浮现；收尾揭晓型文字卡
cards.use: 特性清单收束到产品名/口号的段落（"NEW × 一串特性 → NEW <产品名>"式）；发布会式 recap、版本号揭晓
cards.duration: 轮换 7–16f/词 × 8–9 词 + 合拢 ~36f + 小字后静置；全段约 5–6s
cards.energy: 中低（机器节奏、小字规格清单气质，不是砸字）
cards.intention: 两词分踞左右像目录页对峙，观众以为只是轮换字幕；直到最后一词 停稳才发现左右其实是同一句话的两半——唯一一次连续合拢把整段 轮换追认为"悬念铺垫"。命门是**钉死**：轮换期两词位置一像素不动、 左右屏边距完全相等（原片实测 412 vs 413@1280），任何渐进收缩都会 提前剧透合拢、把揭晓稀释成进度条。合拢只许发生一次，且必须在 最后一词之后——这是收尾揭晓，不是持续动效。

styles.label: text-column-converge
styles.description: 双词对峙合拢——左"NEW"右特性词钉死在等屏边距两侧硬切轮换、全程零收缩，换到最后一词才唯一一次 ease-in-out 滑到居中咬合成短语，下方小字近乎硬切浮现；收尾揭晓型文字卡
styles.descriptionEn: Two words pinned at opposite screen edges hard-swap through options, then slide together exactly once to lock into the final phrase.

cards.summaryEn: Two words pinned at opposite screen edges hard-swap through options, then slide together exactly once to lock into the final phrase.
cards.useEn: Passages collapsing a feature list onto a product name / slogan ("NEW × a string of features → NEW <product name>" style); launch-event recaps, version-number reveals
cards.intentionEn: Two words holding left and right like a table of contents facing off; the audience assumes it is just rotating subtitles — until the last word settles and they realise the left and right were two halves of the same sentence: the one and only continuous closing re-reads the whole rotating passage as "suspense setup". The make-or-break is nailed dead: during the rotation the two words move not a single pixel and the left and right screen margins are exactly equal (the original measures 412 vs 413 @1280); any gradual contraction spoils the closing early and dilutes the reveal into a progress bar. The closing may happen exactly once, and only after the last word — this is a closing reveal, not a sustained animation.
cards.energyEn: Medium-low (machine rhythm, small-type spec-list temperament; not a word-slammer)

cards.name: theme-switch-moves
cards.summary: 主题切换两式——theme-sweep 斜向扫场（边界扫过处就地换肤）与 palette-ripple 组合款（⌘K 面板收缩成点、涟漪从点荡开换肤）
cards.use: 深色模式/主题功能的叙事段落；同一 UI "在你眼前变色"而非切到新场景
cards.energy: A 中 / B 中高（组合款有完整因果链）
cards.intention: 深浅模式切换的两种拍法。A（Notion/Figma/Linear 惯用）：15° 斜向 边界带亮线扫过全画面（demo 从开关所在的右侧扫向左侧），边界经过处浅色**就地**变深色，同布局 双主题共存一瞬——观众看到的是"同一个 UI 换肤"，不是转场。 B（组合变异）：⌘K 面板输入 "dark" 回车，面板收缩成一个亮点， 深色涟漪**从该点**荡开扫过全 UI——"命令引发换肤"的因果链完整可读。 组合命门：涟漪圆心必须是面板收缩点、起始帧必须是收缩完成帧。

styles.label: theme-sweep-toggle
styles.description: 深色版 clip-path polygon 15° 斜边扫场（out poly3 先快后缓 ~38f），边界 4px 白亮线+18px 辉光，扫完 2f 淡出；深版 scale 1→0.995→1 坐实
styles.use: 主题功能直接展示
styles.descriptionEn: The dark theme sweeps across as a slanted clip-path edge with a glowing 4px line, recoloring everything it passes in one 38-frame pass.

styles.label: palette-theme-ripple
styles.description: 面板 back(1.9) 弹落→逐字输入→回车面板 ease-in 收缩到 0 + 白色高光核钉住位置→圆形 clip 半径 12→1250px cubic-out 荡开，边缘 5px 白环双向辉光
styles.use: 命令面板+主题联动的高光段
styles.descriptionEn: The command palette collapses to a bright point, and from that point a circular ripple floods the new theme across the screen.

cards.summaryEn: Two theme-change patterns: a diagonal sweep that recolors content in place, and a command-palette ripple with a clear cause and effect.
cards.useEn: Narrative passages for dark mode / theme features; the same UI "changing colour before your eyes" rather than cutting to a new scene
cards.intentionEn: Two treatments for the light/dark mode switch. A (the Notion/Figma/Linear staple): a 15° diagonal boundary band with a bright line sweeps the whole frame (in the demo, from the switch's side on the right toward the left), and where the boundary passes, the light colours turn dark in place, both themes of the same layout coexisting for an instant — the audience sees "the same UI reskinned", not a transition. B (combination variant): type "dark" into the ⌘K panel and hit return, the panel contracts into a single bright point, and the dark ripple spreads from that point across the whole UI — the causal chain of "the command caused the reskin" fully readable. Combination make-or-break: the ripple's centre must be the panel's contraction point and the start frame must be the contraction-completion frame.
cards.energyEn: A medium / B medium-high (the combination version has a complete causal chain)

cards.name: timeline-travel
cards.summary: 时间轴横移——镜头沿水平刻度轴加速掠过版本刻度，每过一格卡片弹立短停，末刻度急停推近
cards.use: changelog/里程碑/发展史段落（"我们一直在发货"的另一种拍法）；与 scroll-brake-moves 分工：那卡是纵向列表急刹，本卡是横向时间旅行
cards.energy: 中高（加速→急刹的节奏型镜头）
cards.intention: 把产品的版本史拍成一次沿时间轴的旅行（《反恐王国》片头判例）： 镜头缓起→冲刺→急刹三段变速横移，v1.0/v2.0/v3.0 刻度依次掠过， 每过一格对应卡片从刻度线上 spring 弹立——历史在窗外闪过， 急停在"今天"并推近。速度本身讲"发展快"，急停讲"现在最重要"。

styles.label: timeline-travel
styles.description: 时间轴横移——镜头沿水平刻度轴加速掠过版本刻度，每过一格卡片弹立短停，末刻度急停推近
styles.descriptionEn: The camera accelerates along a horizontal version timeline, raises cards at each stop, then brakes sharply on the final milestone.

cards.summaryEn: The camera accelerates along a horizontal version timeline, raises cards at each stop, then brakes sharply on the final milestone.
cards.useEn: Changelog / milestone / history passages (another way to say "we've been shipping all along"); division of labour with scroll-brake-moves: that card is the vertical list emergency brake, this one is the horizontal time travel
cards.intentionEn: Shoot the product's version history as a trip along a time axis (The Kingdom title-sequence rule): the camera eases up → sprints → emergency-brakes in three variable-speed horizontal moves, the v1.0 / v2.0 / v3.0 ticks sweeping past in turn, each tick's corresponding card springing up from the scale line — history flashing past outside the window, the emergency stop landing on "today" and pushing in. The speed itself says "we develop fast", the emergency stop says "now matters most".
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (an acceleration → emergency-brake rhythm-type shot)

cards.name: title-demote-to-label
cards.summary: 大标题降格为节标签两式——A 大标题居中显影站稳一拍后连续缩小 0.3x 平移到左上角落成小节标签、内容区在其下生长；B 同套路但登场时带文本选中态高亮块扫入再撤掉
cards.use: 章节开场（标题先当主角再让位给内容）；教程/功能演示片的小节交接；B 式给"文字/编辑"类产品加身份暗示
cards.energy: 低中（版式变换型，氛围镜头）
cards.intention: 章节标题的常规命运是"出现→消失→内容登场"，标题和内容互不认识。 本卡让标题**降格而不退场**：居中大字站稳一拍宣告主题，然后一次连续 补间缩到 0.3x 飞到左上角，落成这一节的栏目标签——它还在屏幕上， 只是从主角变成了门牌。观众获得免费的空间记忆：刚才那个大词就是 现在左上角那个小词，本节讲的就是它。内容骨架在降格进行中就开始 生长，交接零空档。

styles.label: title-demote-to-label
styles.description: 大标题降格为节标签两式——A 大标题居中显影站稳一拍后连续缩小 0.3x 平移到左上角落成小节标签、内容区在其下生长；B 同套路但登场时带文本选中态高亮块扫入再撤掉
styles.descriptionEn: A centered headline stands for a beat, then shrinks and slides to the top-left corner to become a section label as content grows beneath it.

cards.summaryEn: A centered headline stands for a beat, then shrinks and slides to the top-left corner to become a section label as content grows beneath it.
cards.useEn: Section openers (the title plays the lead then yields to content); sub-section handovers in tutorials / feature demos; style B adds an identity hint for "text / editing" products
cards.intentionEn: A section title's usual fate is "appear → disappear → content enters", title and content never meeting. This card lets the title be demoted without leaving: the centred big word holds a beat to declare the theme, then a single continuous tween shrinks it to 0.3x and flies it to the top-left corner, landing as this section's column label — still on screen, just changed from lead actor to doorplate. The audience gets free spatial memory: that big word from a moment ago is that small word in the top-left now, and this section is about it. The content skeleton starts growing while the demotion is in progress — zero gap in the handover.
cards.energyEn: Low-medium (layout-transform type; an atmosphere shot)

cards.name: trailer-grammar-moves
cards.summary: 预告片语法一式——trailer-bumper 前置速剪钩子：三镜 9f 速剪 + 黑场静默一拍，再开场标题
cards.use: 预告片的开场钩子（cold open）：正片前先塞三个最抓眼的镜头，再静默一拍正式开场
cards.energy: A 高
cards.intention: 库内节奏卡各管一段：beat-cut 管切点排布、rhythm-interrupt 管打断。 本卡管**预告片的结构性时刻**——不是某个 镜头怎么动，是整片的关节怎么接：A 是开场钩——正片前 0.9 秒塞 三个最抓眼镜头速剪 + 黑场静默一拍再开场，预告片的"预告"。

styles.label: trailer-bumper
styles.description: 预告片语法一式——trailer-bumper 前置速剪钩子：三镜 9f 速剪 + 黑场静默一拍，再开场标题
styles.use: 正片开场前的钩子；cold open
styles.descriptionEn: Three 9-frame shots hard-cut in strict time, each with a tiny internal push, then 6 frames of black silence before the title rises.

cards.summaryEn: A trailer bumper hook: three 9-frame rapid cuts, a beat of black silence, then the opening title card.
cards.useEn: The trailer's opening hook (cold open): stuff the three most eye-catching shots in before the main film, then a silent beat, then the formal opening
cards.intentionEn: Each rhythm card in the library governs one segment: beat-cut governs cut-point arrangement, rhythm-interrupt governs interruption. This card governs the structural moments of a trailer — not how a shot moves, but how the whole film's joints connect: A is the opening hook — 0.9 seconds of three most-eye-catching shots speed-cut before the main film, plus a dark-ground silent beat, then the opening: the trailer's "trailer".
cards.energyEn: A high

cards.name: transition-hidden-cut
cards.summary: 藏切点转场三式——前景遮挡隐形切、对撞开屏、暖色漏光，硬切藏进遮挡/撞击/光峰的 1-3 帧里，观众看不见剪刀
cards.use: 两镜衔接处需要"无痕换景"或"仪式感开屏"时（技法卡，与 shot-transitions 三式同层选型）
cards.duration: n/a（技法卡；各式占用帧数见参数表，从相邻镜头预算里划）
cards.energy: n/a（技法卡，不占能量位）
cards.intention: 与 shot-transitions A 式 flash-cut 同族：flash-cut 用一层白闪盖住硬切， 这三式换了三种"障眼物"——扫过的前景卡片（A）、对撞的撞击帧（B）、 爬到顶峰的漏光（C）。共同原理是魔术误导：观众的眼睛被大动作/强光 吸走的那 1-3 帧里完成硬切，回过神来景已经换了，全程"看不见剪刀"。 flash-cut 是最素的一款；要方向感选 A，要仪式感选 B，要温度选 C。

styles.label: invisible-cut 前景遮挡隐形切
styles.description: 一张超画幅卡片带重运动模糊贴脸横扫，糊满全屏的遮挡帧内背景 A→B 硬切，卡片飞出观众以为还是同一镜
styles.use: 想让换景完全无痕的页面→页面；伪"一条 take"的主力款
styles.descriptionEn: An oversized card sweeps past the lens with heavy motion blur, and the background swaps scenes inside the fully-covered frames.

styles.label: versus-slam 对撞开屏
styles.description: 左右两半屏带斜切边从画外加速对冲撞合，撞击帧白闪+震屏+VS 盖章，切点就是撞击本身
styles.use: 对比/对阵语义的开屏或章节头（新旧方案、双产品、before/after）
styles.descriptionEn: Two half-screens with slanted edges charge from opposite sides and collide; the impact frame is the cut — white flash, shake, VS stamp.

styles.label: light-leak-burn 琥珀漏光
styles.description: 三团琥珀柔光沿对角线斜扫，光峰帧吞掉旧页约七成时硬切新页，光退散时新页已就位
styles.use: 想要暖调/胶片味的章节过渡；比白闪柔、有方向、有温度
styles.descriptionEn: Three amber light blooms sweep the diagonal, and at peak coverage the old page hard-cuts away beneath the flare.

cards.summaryEn: Three ways to conceal the edit: foreground occlusion, opposing impacts, and a brief amber light leak at the cut.
cards.useEn: When a seam between two shots needs an "invisible scene change" or a "ceremonial reveal" (a technique card, selected at the same level as the three shot-transitions styles)
cards.intentionEn: In the same family as shot-transitions style A's flash-cut: flash-cut covers the hard cut with a layer of white flash; these three styles swap in three kinds of "misdirection" — a sweeping foreground card (A), a colliding impact frame (B), a light leak climbing to its peak (C). The shared principle is magical misdirection: the hard cut happens in the 1-3 frames while the audience's eyes are pulled away by a big motion / strong light; when they come back, the scene has changed, and they never "see the scissors". flash-cut is the plainest of them; choose A for a sense of direction, B for ceremony, C for warmth.
cards.energyEn: n/a (a technique card; does not occupy an energy slot)

cards.name: transition-travel
cards.summary: 穿越式转场——字腔穿越：巨型章节标题的字形就是一扇窗，镜头钻进字形笔画完成换景
cards.use: 前后两镜存在"元素/容器"级空间关系的接缝（技法卡，与 shot-transitions 三式互补选用）
cards.duration: n/a（技法卡；demo 150f，主推动作段 52f，前后 hold 另计，帧数从相邻镜头预算里划）
cards.energy: n/a（技法卡，不占能量位）
cards.intention: shot-transitions 三式是"交棒"型——前镜收尾、后镜入场，接缝靠白闪/糊帧/ 窗口盖住换页瞬间。本卡是"穿越"型——后景在前景画面里 以真实元素存在（字形洞），镜头一条连续空间运动钻进去， 观众从头到尾跟着同一个物体，没有交棒瞬间。选型口径：后景能在前景里"预先 在场"→穿越；两景只是先后关系、无空间嵌套→交棒。字腔穿越的语义是 "标题即是门"（章节字卡与转场二合一）。

styles.label: 字腔穿越 letterform-zoom
styles.description: 穿越式转场——字腔穿越：巨型章节标题的字形就是一扇窗，镜头钻进字形笔画完成换景
styles.use: 章节标题→正文；替代 D 式黑场字卡的高能量款
styles.descriptionEn: The next page shows through a giant letterform cut as a mask; the camera zooms through the letter until it swallows the frame.

cards.summaryEn: A passage transition that pushes through the counter of a giant letterform into the next scene.
cards.useEn: Seams where the two shots have an element- / container-level spatial relationship (a technique card, used complementarily with the three shot-transitions styles)
cards.intentionEn: The three shot-transitions styles are the "handover" type — the front shot exits, the back shot enters, the seam covered by a white flash / blurred frame / window across the page-change instant. This card is the "travel" type — the background exists inside the foreground as a real element (a glyph cavity), and the camera bores in through one continuous spatial move; the audience follows one single object from start to finish, with no handover moment. Selection rule: if the background can "pre-exist" inside the foreground → travel; if the two scenes are merely sequential with no spatial nesting → handover. The glyph-cavity travel's semantics are "the title is the door" (section title card and transition in one).
cards.energyEn: n/a (a technique card; does not occupy an energy slot)

cards.name: type-and-filter
cards.summary: 真实 UI 上打字搜索、网格自己收敛成一张卡、点击穿透进详情页
cards.use: 功能演示的"操作叙事"段；搜索/筛选/进入详情的任何交互链路
cards.energy: 中（发牌高能段之后的从容一拍）
cards.intention: 让观众"跟着做一遍"：看清输入了什么、页面怎么响应、点了哪里。这是全片唯一模拟真人操作的镜头，节奏必须像人手，不能像脚本。

styles.label: type-and-filter
styles.description: 真实 UI 上打字搜索、网格自己收敛成一张卡、点击穿透进详情页
styles.descriptionEn: A real interface types a search, collapses the grid to one result, then clicks through into the detail view.

cards.summaryEn: A real interface types a search, collapses the grid to one result, then clicks through into the detail view.
cards.useEn: The "operation narrative" section of feature demos; any interaction chain of search / filter / entering detail
cards.intentionEn: Let the audience "do it along with you": see clearly what was typed, how the page responded, where was clicked. This is the only shot in the film that simulates a real person's operation; the rhythm must feel like a human hand, not a script.
cards.energyEn: Medium (the unhurried beat after the dealing high-energy passage)

cards.name: type-assembly-moves
cards.summary: 文字集结三式——split-text-stagger 逐字裂升、letterform-drift-assembly 漂移合拢、text-on-path 沿线流入
cards.use: 大标题/标语的入场；与 type-entrance-moves、document-typewriter-reveal 同属标题入场大品类，全片 ≤2 种
cards.duration: 单式 4–5.5s（动作段 A ~56f / B ~104f / C ~110f；demo 全长含 hold：A 130f / B 150f / C 160f，各自导出 `*_DURATION`）
cards.energy: A 中 / B 中高 / C 中
cards.intention: 标题入场已有"原位变形系"（字符坠落/打字机——字在原地换形态）。本卡补"集结系"：字符从别处**汇聚成**标题，运动轨迹 本身有戏。A 琴键式——每字从看不见的裁切线下滑升，理性利落，通用度 最高；B 片头式——字符四散带模糊漂入、逐个锁定加深，Stranger Things 的仪式感，适合品牌名亮相；C 语义式——字符沿一条上升曲线鱼贯流入 再摆正，曲线可以正好描着图表增长线走，文字与数据同框叙事。

styles.label: split-text-stagger 裂升
styles.description: 每字 overflow 盒内 translateY(115%→0) 带 10% 过冲，delay i×2f，基线同步生长
styles.use: 通用默认；利落理性
styles.descriptionEn: Each character rises inside its own overflow box from 115% with a 10% overshoot, two frames apart, as the baseline grows beneath.

styles.label: drift-assembly 漂移合拢
styles.description: 字符 seed 方向 ±300px + blur 8px 漂入错峰归位，锁定帧加深脉冲，合体后整词呼吸 1.04
styles.use: 品牌名/片头级亮相
styles.descriptionEn: Characters drift in from seeded directions with blur, locking into place one by one, each lock landing a darkening pulse.

styles.label: text-on-path 沿线流入
styles.description: 字符沿贝塞尔曲线鱼贯滑入（切线角旋转），到达后 12f 摆正水平
styles.use: 曲线有语义时（增长线/流程线）
styles.descriptionEn: Characters slide in single-file along a bezier curve, rotating with the tangent, then straighten level over 12 frames.

cards.summaryEn: Three typography assemblies: split-letter rise, drifting convergence, and text flowing along a path.
cards.useEn: Entrances for big titles / slogans; with type-entrance-moves and document-typewriter-reveal it belongs to the great title-entrance family — at most 2 kinds per film
cards.intentionEn: Title entrances already had the "in-place deformation family" (characters falling / typewriter — the word changes form where it sits). This card adds the "assembly family": characters converge from elsewhere into the title, the motion trajectory itself carrying the drama. A, keyboard style — each letter slides up from an invisible clipping line, rational and neat, the most versatile; B, title-sequence style — characters drift in scattered with blur and lock on one by one while deepening, the Stranger Things ritual feel, suited to brand-name reveals; C, semantic style — characters stream in along a rising curve then straighten up, and the curve can exactly trace a chart's growth line, text and data narrating in the same frame.
cards.energyEn: A medium / B medium-high / C medium

cards.name: type-entrance-moves
cards.summary: 标题文字入场一式——letter-drop-physics 字符坠落（重力砸落、弹跳、歪斜站定，最后一拍集体立正归位）
cards.use: 大标题/章节字卡的入场；与 type-assembly-moves（集结系）、document-typewriter-reveal（打字机）同品类互斥选用
cards.duration: 单式 5s（含 hold 与静止收尾；动作段 ~116f，demo 150f）
cards.energy: 中高（物理趣味）
cards.intention: 标题入场库内已有打字机（沉稳文档感）和集结系（字从别处汇聚），本卡补 物理喜剧感——字符从天而降、砸地弹跳、歪歪扭扭站定，最后一拍 集体立正归位，适合轻松调性的开场破冰（demo 让品牌名「Motion Studio」砸落站定， 副标题「Every shot lands on the beat.」随归位一拍浮出）。标题入场同片 ≤2 种（P4）。

styles.label: letter-drop-physics 字符坠落
styles.description: 标题文字入场一式——letter-drop-physics 字符坠落（重力砸落、弹跳、歪斜站定，最后一拍集体立正归位）
styles.use: 轻松调性开场；"活物感"的标题破冰
styles.descriptionEn: Characters fall from above under gravity, bounce twice, land crooked, then square up together on the final beat.

cards.summaryEn: Letters falling under gravity and bouncing into alignment as a title entrance.
cards.useEn: Entrances for big titles / section title cards; used mutually exclusively with type-assembly-moves (assembly family) and document-typewriter-reveal (typewriter) within the same family
cards.intentionEn: Title entrances in the library already had the typewriter (composed documentary feel) and the assembly family (characters converging from elsewhere); this card adds physical comedy — characters fall from the sky, bounce off the ground, and stand up wobbling, with the final beat snapping to attention all together, suited to breaking the ice in a light-toned opener (the demo has the brand name "Motion Studio" slam down and stand straight, with the subtitle "Every shot lands on the beat." floating in on the settle beat). At most 2 title-entrance kinds per film (P4).
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (physical playfulness)

cards.name: type-rhythm-sync
cards.summary: 文字随声同步两式——font-weight-pump 字重脉冲（笔画随鼓点变粗弹回）与 karaoke-fill-sync 卡拉OK填色（词随旁白逐个点亮）
cards.use: 标题/标语与音轨强绑定的段落；A 绑节拍（鼓点），B 绑语音（旁白逐词）
cards.duration: A FontWeightPump 165f / B KaraokeFillSync 150f；A 128 BPM 每拍 14f、衰减窗 9–13f，B 每词按语速 18–33f
cards.energy: A 高（蹦迪感）/ B 中（跟读引导）
cards.intention: 文字动效库内此前全是"入场怎么进"，没有词管"在场的字怎么跟着声音活"。 这两式补上：A 让标题变成节奏器官——笔画随低音鼓抽动变粗又弹回， 文字在蹦迪，适合高能段落的视觉低音炮；B 让标语变成跟读字幕—— 旁白读到哪个词哪个词从左到右填色点亮，视线被牵着走，适合口播/ 标语强调段。共同点是**字不动、属性动**：无位移、无入退场， 纯粹是字重/颜色在声音的拍点上呼吸。

styles.label: font-weight-pump 字重脉冲
styles.description: 命中帧笔画瞬间变粗（stroke+字重跳变），~10f 衰减弹回；重音拍额外撑宽 8%
styles.use: 音乐驱动的高能段；标题当低音炮
styles.descriptionEn: On each hit the strokes jump bold and spring back thin over 10 frames; accent beats also widen the word 8%.

styles.label: karaoke-fill-sync 填色随读
styles.description: 每词深色从左到右填亮，进度跟语速，读完保持；活跃词下带读指下划线
styles.use: 旁白/口播强调段；多词标语的视线引导
styles.descriptionEn: Each word fills dark-to-bright left to right at speech speed and stays lit, a reading underline tracking the active word.

cards.summaryEn: Two voice-and-beat synchronizations: font weight pulsing on percussion and spoken words filling like karaoke.
cards.useEn: Passages where a title / slogan is strongly bound to the audio track; A binds to the beat (drum), B binds to speech (narration word by word)
cards.intentionEn: The text-motion library had previously been all about "how the entrance enters", with nothing on "how present words come alive with sound". These two styles fill that in: A turns the title into a rhythm organ — strokes pulse thick and spring back with the bass drum, the text dancing, the visual subwoofer for high-energy passages; B turns the slogan into a karaoke subtitle — whichever word the narration reaches fills with colour from left to right and lights up, the gaze led along, suited to voice-over / slogan-emphasis passages. The common point is the word doesn't move, its properties do: no displacement, no entrance or exit — purely weight / colour breathing on the sound's beats.
cards.energyEn: A high (dancing feel) / B medium (reading-along guidance)

cards.name: typewriter-moves
cards.summary: 打字机 error-retype——误删重打的"改口"三幕剧：打出平庸词 → 犹豫 → 退格删掉 → 更快打出卖点词
cards.use: slogan/卖点字卡、否定式文案；文字自带时间性的入场
cards.energy: 中低
cards.intention: 打字是唯一自带时间性的文字入场——字符一个个到来本身就是节奏， 不需要额外动效。A 式把打字当**独白**：逐字打出平庸词 （demo 眉题 Introducing Motion Studio 下的 "just a slideshow"）→ 停顿犹豫 → 退格删掉 → 更快打出卖点词（"your cinematic crew"），犹豫-否定-宣言的 三幕剧，戏全在三档速度差里。

styles.label: error-retype
styles.description: 打字机 error-retype——误删重打的"改口"三幕剧：打出平庸词 → 犹豫 → 退格删掉 → 更快打出卖点词
styles.use: slogan 字卡的"改口"戏；否定式文案
styles.descriptionEn: Type, pause with a blinking cursor, backspace, retype without hesitation — a three-act correction that reads as human.

cards.summaryEn: A three-act typing narrative: a plain word, a hesitation and deletion, then a faster retype of the selling point.
cards.useEn: Slogan / selling-point cards, negative-form copy; the entrance where text carries its own temporality
cards.intentionEn: Typing is the only text entrance that carries its own temporality — characters arriving one by one is itself the rhythm, needing no extra motion. Style A treats typing as a monologue: typing out a mediocre word character by character (in the demo, "just a slideshow" under the Introducing Motion Studio kicker) → a hesitant pause → backspacing it away → typing the selling word faster ("your cinematic crew"): a three-act play of hesitation-negation-declaration, the drama all in the three speed tiers' difference.
cards.energyEn: Medium-low

cards.name: ui-strip-away-outro
cards.summary: 减法式收尾——点击 Publish 后整个编辑器 UI 从外围到中心层层错峰蒸发，黑场上只剩那颗按钮滑到屏心放大，按钮再淡出交棒字标定版
cards.use: "发布/完成"语义的 outro；想讲"一键之后一切复杂性消失"的产品收尾
cards.duration: ~4.8s（144f：光标就位 34f → 蒸发 ~40f → 按钮独占 → 字标接棒 → 字标 hold ≥1s）
cards.energy: 中（前段安静操作，中段持续退场，无瞬时冲击）
cards.intention: 库内收尾全是"加法"：outro-group-photo-launch 元素飞来合影，logo sting 是定住再彩蛋。本卡是唯一的"减法"路线——点击引爆全 UI 退场， 黑场只留语义焦点（那颗被点的按钮），把"发布 = 复杂性归零"翻译成 动效叙事。命门有二：**蒸发要有秩序**——从外围到中心每 4f 一层、 每层带方向性位移（各自往画外散），乱序或同帧齐灭读作断电故障； **按钮是唯一幸存者且必须迁移**——蒸发期间从工具条角落滑到屏心 放大 1.5 倍、白晕随黑场增强，完成从"UI 控件"到"仪式主角"的升格， 最后淡出把黑场交给字标。

styles.label: ui-strip-away-outro
styles.description: 减法式收尾——点击 Publish 后整个编辑器 UI 从外围到中心层层错峰蒸发，黑场上只剩那颗按钮滑到屏心放大，按钮再淡出交棒字标定版
styles.descriptionEn: After Publish is clicked the editor UI evaporates layer by layer from the edges inward, leaving one button to slide center, grow, and hand off to the wordmark.

cards.summaryEn: After Publish is clicked the editor UI evaporates layer by layer from the edges inward, leaving one button to slide center, grow, and hand off to the wordmark.
cards.useEn: Outros with "launch / complete" semantics; product closings that want to say "after one click, all the complexity disappears"
cards.intentionEn: Every outro in the library is "addition": outro-group-photo-launch flies elements in for the group photo, the logo sting is a freeze then an easter egg. This card is the only "subtraction" route — a click detonates the whole UI's exit, the dark ground leaving only the semantic focus (the button that was clicked), translating "launch = complexity zeroed" into a motion narrative. Two make-or-breaks: the evaporation must have order — from the periphery to the centre one layer every 4 frames, each layer with directional displacement (each scattering out of frame); disorder or a same-frame collective blackout reads as a power failure. And the button is the only survivor and must migrate — during the evaporation it slides from the toolbar corner to the screen centre at 1.5× size, its white halo strengthening with the dark ground, completing its promotion from "UI control" to "ritual protagonist", then finally fading out to hand the dark ground to the wordmark.
cards.energyEn: Medium (quiet operation up front, sustained exit in the middle, no instantaneous impact)

cards.name: ui-to-brand-morph
cards.summary: UI 变品牌两式——icon-flip-bloom 图标 Y 轴翻扁成竖线、从竖线撑开成品牌标志（琥珀斜切随后划入）+ wordmark 逐字落定，与 input-morph-assemble 输入框收缩成取景框竖笔、三块图元落进构造槽位拼成完整标志
cards.use: 品牌收尾/outro 前最后一拍；"你每天用的那个 UI 就是这个品牌"的视觉论证
cards.energy: 中高（收尾点睛，一次完整变形讲完）
cards.intention: 品牌收尾库里已有两条路：brand-ink-open 是开场描画压印、 outro-group-photo-launch 是元素围拢合影（聚而不变）。本卡补第三条： **产品 UI 元素自己变形成品牌符号**——A 式是图标翻一个身变成 logo （同位实体交换），B 式是全片反复出现的输入框在最后一次发送后集结成 品牌标志（多元素落位拼装）。观众看到的不是"logo 出现了"，而是 "刚才用的东西原来就是它"，因果链本身就是品牌论证。

styles.label: icon-flip-bloom
styles.description: 图标 anticipation 晃两下→Y 轴 scaleX 压扁成竖线（双层拖影+blur）→最薄处实体交换、spring 展开成 Motion Studio「Motion Studio」标志、琥珀斜切第二拍划入→标志左移让位、字标逐字落定
styles.use: 单图标产品；图标与 logo 形态差异大、需要"翻过去变身"的魔术感
styles.descriptionEn: The icon rocks twice, flips flat to a sliver with double ghosting, swaps identity at the thinnest frame, and unfolds into the Motion Studio Motion Studio mark — the amber cut slicing in on a second beat — as the wordmark lands.

styles.label: input-morph-assemble
styles.description: 光标点发送→文字飞走→输入框 x/y/w/h/r 五量 spring 插值成标志的竖框→上下横条与琥珀斜切从虚线构造框里依次落位拼成「Motion Studio」标志→左移让位、字标逐字落定
styles.use: 输入框/卡片等矩形 UI 是全片主角的片子；logo 可拆解为几何图元组合
styles.descriptionEn: Send is clicked, the text flies off, the input box spring-morphs into a capsule that becomes the frame stem of the mark; the top and bottom bars and the amber cut drop into dashed construction outlines to assemble the Motion Studio mark.

cards.summaryEn: Two UI-to-brand morphs: an icon flips flat and blooms into a logo mark, and an input field contracts into a capsule as glyphs assemble the logo.
cards.useEn: The final beat before the brand closing / outro; the visual argument that "the UI you use every day is this brand"
cards.intentionEn: The brand-closing library already had two routes: brand-ink-open's opening draw-and-deboss, and outro-group-photo-launch's elements gathering for a photo (gathered but unchanged). This card adds a third: the product UI elements themselves morph into the brand symbol — style A is an icon flipping over to become the logo (a same-position entity swap), style B is the input box that recurs throughout the film assembling into the brand mark after its final send (multiple elements landing and assembling). What the audience sees is not "the logo appeared" but "the thing we were just using was it all along" — the causal chain itself is the brand argument.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (the closing touch; one complete morph tells it all)

cards.name: value-stagger-gradient
cards.summary: 16 根柱入场时 delay 是时间错峰，同时高度/色相/位移/模糊四个属性各自铺成从首到末的数值梯度；第二拍把错峰原点换成中心，脉冲幅度以中心为最大重新铺开
cards.use: 技法演示与参数化能力的展示镜头；也可直接当数据/频谱/均衡器类界面的入场
cards.energy: 中高（第一拍是连续铺开，第二拍中心脉冲是明确的一次峰值）
cards.intention: stagger 通常只被用来错开时间。这张卡要说的是它还能错开**值**——同一个索引既决定 "什么时候动"，也决定"动到多少"。两拍是一组对照实验：第一拍原点在首位（梯度从左到 右单调铺开），第二拍原点换到中心（梯度以中轴对称铺开）。观众看到的不是两个动画， 而是同一个配方换了一个参数。屏幕上的代码字幕同步换成对应的 stagger 调用，明说这件事。

styles.label: value-stagger-gradient
styles.description: 16 根柱入场时 delay 是时间错峰，同时高度/色相/位移/模糊四个属性各自铺成从首到末的数值梯度；第二拍把错峰原点换成中心，脉冲幅度以中心为最大重新铺开
styles.descriptionEn: Sixteen bars rise in a staggered sweep where height, hue, travel distance and blur are each spread as a gradient across the row, then a second beat re-origins the stagger at the center so the pulse amplitude fans out symmetrically.

cards.summaryEn: Sixteen bars rise in a staggered sweep where height, hue, travel distance and blur are each spread as a gradient across the row, then a second beat re-origins the stagger at the center so the pulse amplitude fans out symmetrically.
cards.useEn: Showcase shots for technique demos and parametric capability; also directly usable as the entrance for data / spectrum / equaliser-style interfaces
cards.intentionEn: Stagger is usually only used to offset time. What this card says is that it can also offset values — the same index decides both "when it moves" and "how far it moves". The two beats are a controlled experiment: the first beat has the origin at the head (the gradient spreading monotonically left to right), the second beat moves the origin to the centre (the gradient spreading symmetrically about the middle). What the audience sees is not two animations but one recipe with one parameter swapped. The on-screen code caption switches in sync to the corresponding stagger call, stating exactly this.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (the first beat spreads continuously; the second beat's centre pulse is a clear single peak)

cards.name: vertical-word-roll-blur-cycle
cards.summary: 句尾词换成竖向滚轮，3 次换词各 0.55s（outQuint 七成 + outBack 三成，前快后极慢带微过冲），相邻行按距离上垂直 blur 与灰度，中心词落定瞬间从灰染成强调色
cards.use: "Crafted for ___" / "Built for ___" 这类句干 + 受众/对象列举的一句话卖点；浅底品牌片的干净一拍
cards.duration: 约 5.0s（150f@30fps：静置 → 3 次换词 → 尾部整组淡出）
cards.energy: 中（稳定三拍，无峰值）
cards.intention: 句尾换词的最优解是滚轮而不是淡入淡出：滚轮自带**方向**（往上翻页）， 观众知道"还有下一个"。这卡的两个身份记号是相邻行的**垂直 blur** （滚轮景深，模拟机械转筒的失焦）和落定时的**染色**（灰→强调色， "这个才是答案"）。句干（demo `Crafted for`）全程纹丝不动——眼睛钉在滚轮上， 句干一晃列举感就散。

styles.label: vertical-word-roll-blur-cycle
styles.description: 句尾词换成竖向滚轮，3 次换词各 0.55s（outQuint 七成 + outBack 三成，前快后极慢带微过冲），相邻行按距离上垂直 blur 与灰度，中心词落定瞬间从灰染成强调色
styles.descriptionEn: The closing word of a tagline rolls vertically through a three-line reel, neighbouring rows blurring into grey depth while the settled word takes the accent color.

cards.summaryEn: The closing word of a tagline rolls vertically through a three-line reel, neighbouring rows blurring into grey depth while the settled word takes the accent color.
cards.useEn: One-line selling points in the "Crafted for ___" / "Built for ___" stem + audience / subject lists; a clean beat for light-ground brand films
cards.intentionEn: The optimal solution for swapping the word at the end of a sentence is a roller, not a cross-fade: the roller carries direction (a page flipping upward), and the audience knows "there's a next one". This card's two identity markers are the vertical blur of the neighbouring rows (the roller's depth of field, simulating a mechanical drum's defocus) and the dyeing on landing (grey → accent colour, "this one is the answer"). The stem (in the demo, `Crafted for`) never moves a hair the whole time — the eyes stay nailed to the roller, and if the stem wobbles the sense of enumeration dissipates.
cards.energyEn: Medium (a steady three beats, no peak)

cards.name: voice-waveform-live
cards.summary: 录音胶囊实时声纹——64 根细竖条随"说话"起伏，说话时中部高耸、停顿缩成点线，波形从右往左滚动；说→停→说→提交塌缩的完整表演
cards.use: 语音输入/AI 助手"正在听你说"的功能镜头；无 UI 内容可展示但需要持续活性撑画面的段落
cards.duration: 172f（~5.7s：入场 14f + 说 1.4s + 停 0.8s + 说 1.4s + 提交塌缩 / 收进气泡 0.8s + hold 0.7s）
cards.energy: 中（功能性活性，不是炫技）
cards.intention: 本卡是**功能性**声纹："正在听你说"的实时回执。命门在因果： 波形跟"用户说话"跳、是产品功能本身，不是跟 BGM 跳的装饰包装。 说话时波形高耸、停顿时缩成一排点线、历史向左滚出——观众从波形的起伏读出"它真的在听"，一段 6s+ 的画面全靠这份 活性撑住，不需要任何别的内容。与 gauge-readout-moves 分工：仪表是 "报一个数值"的机械仪式，本卡是"持续监听"的生命体征，没有终值。

styles.label: voice-waveform-live
styles.description: 录音胶囊实时声纹——64 根细竖条随"说话"起伏，说话时中部高耸、停顿缩成点线，波形从右往左滚动；说→停→说→提交塌缩的完整表演
styles.descriptionEn: A recording capsule shows 64 live bars that surge with speech, shrink to a dotted line in pauses, and collapse on submit.

cards.summaryEn: A recording capsule shows 64 live bars that surge with speech, shrink to a dotted line in pauses, and collapse on submit.
cards.useEn: Feature shots for voice input / AI assistants "listening to you right now"; passages with no UI content to show but needing continuous aliveness to hold the frame
cards.intentionEn: This card is a functional waveform: the real-time receipt of "listening to you right now". The make-or-break is causality: the waveform bounces to "the user speaking" — it is the product's own function, not decorative packaging bouncing to the BGM. While speaking the waveform towers, while paused it shrinks to a row of dots and lines, and the history scrolls out left — the audience reads from the waveform's rise and fall that "it really is listening"; a 6s+ passage is held up entirely by this aliveness, needing nothing else. Division of labour with gauge-readout-moves: the gauge is the mechanical ritual of "reporting a value", this card is the vital sign of "continuous listening" — it has no final value.
cards.energyEn: Medium (functional aliveness, not showboating)

cards.name: wall-reveal-moves
cards.summary: 整墙批量入场两式——bento 逐格点亮、蓝图描线成形，全部原位显形不位移，与 deck-deal-flyin 的飞入位移型互补成品类矩阵
cards.use: 功能墙/卡片墙/整页界面的整体亮相；内容已在原位、要"显形"而非"涌入"的段落
cards.duration: 单式约 5s（A 150f / B 150f @30fps，含建立 hold 与静止收尾）
cards.energy: 中
cards.intention: "一墙内容怎么出场"库内此前只有 deck-deal-flyin 一个答案——高能量、位移型、 "东西涌进来"。但不是每面墙都该涌：品牌段要庄重、 "从设计到实物"要讲工序。这两式共同点是**非位移批量入场**——元素原地显形， 版式从第一帧就成立，观众看的是"状态变化的波前扫过一面墙"而不是"物体飞行"。 选型先问一句：这面墙该"涌进来"还是"亮起来"？前者去 deck-deal-flyin，后者进本卡。

styles.label: bento-light-up 逐格点亮
styles.description: 暗场 3×2 bento 墙压暗待命，琥珀流光逐格描边一圈、内容随即提亮上浮，全亮后镜头缓推收住
styles.use: 内容庄重/暗场品牌段；节奏沉稳的功能总览
styles.descriptionEn: A dark 3x2 bento wall waits dimmed; amber light traces each cell border and the content brightens and lifts, cell by cell, until a slow push seals it.

styles.label: wireframe-draw-on 蓝图描线成形
styles.description: 界面先以 SVG 细线蓝图分组描画，再一条琥珀发光竖线左→右扫过，扫过处线框实体化成真实界面
styles.use: "从设计到实物/从想法到产品"叙事；产品首次整体亮相
styles.descriptionEn: The interface draws itself as blueprint linework first, then a glowing amber scanline sweeps left to right, solidifying wireframe into real UI.

cards.summaryEn: Two in-place wall reveals: sequential bento lights and a wireframe drawing itself into a finished interface.
cards.useEn: The whole reveal of feature walls / card walls / whole-page interfaces; passages where the content is already in place and needs to "manifest" rather than "flood in"
cards.intentionEn: "How does a wall of content appear" had only one answer in the library before — deck-deal-flyin: high-energy, displacement-type, "things flood in". But not every wall should flood: the brand passage needs solemnity, and "from design to physical object" needs to show the process. The two styles here share non-displacement batch entrance — elements manifest in place, the layout is valid from the first frame, and the audience watches "a wave-front of state change sweeping across a wall" rather than "objects flying". Ask first when choosing: should this wall "flood in" or "light up"? Flooding goes to deck-deal-flyin; lighting up comes to this card.
cards.energyEn: Medium

cards.name: white-flash-logo-simplify-cut
cards.summary: 液态金属质感的彩色词标静置流光，蓄力后从字心炸出一记白闪过曝，曝光回落时同一位置已是扁平版字标——一次闪白完成质感降维
cards.use: 品牌段落收束（华丽演绎→干净定妆）；情绪从炫技切换到正式宣告的转场拍
cards.duration: 约 4s（120f@30fps；演出 0–34f · 蓄力 34–46f · 冲白 44–54f · 曝光回落 54–76f · 锁定 72–96f · hold 至 120f）
cards.energy: 中高（一次脉冲式重音，前后都是静场）
cards.intention: 先给足华丽（虹彩液态金属在字面上流动、一次斜向高光扫过），再用一次白闪把它"净化"成扁平单色字标——观众读到的是"演出结束，这就是它的正式形象"。降维是修辞：从感性质感切到理性识别。两版同字号同位置，读作"同一个字标被净化了"，不是换了张图。

styles.label: white-flash-logo-simplify-cut
styles.description: 液态金属质感的彩色词标静置流光，蓄力后从字心炸出一记白闪过曝，曝光回落时同一位置已是扁平版字标——一次闪白完成质感降维
styles.descriptionEn: A liquid six-color gradient wordmark shimmers in place, the frame flash-burns to white with a blur-and-brightness pulse, and a flat gradient wordmark fades in and settles on the white.

cards.summaryEn: A liquid six-color gradient wordmark shimmers in place, the frame flash-burns to white with a blur-and-brightness pulse, and a flat gradient wordmark fades in and settles on the white.
cards.useEn: Brand-passage resolution (gorgeous performance → clean close-up); the transition shot where the mood switches from showboating to formal announcement
cards.intentionEn: Give the gorgeousness in full first (iridescent liquid metal flowing across the word surface, one diagonal highlight sweep), then use one white flash to "purify" it into a flat single-colour wordmark — the audience reads "the show is over, this is its official image". The dimensional reduction is rhetoric: from sensuous texture to rational recognition. Both versions at the same size and position, read as "the same wordmark got purified", not as a swap to another picture.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (one pulse-style accent; still scenes before and after)

cards.name: wipe-transitions
cards.summary: 几何擦除转场——blinds-slice 百叶窗切条（12 根 3D 叶片错峰翻面成波，波扫过后整页由 A 换成 B）
cards.use: 新旧页都不动、一条几何边界扫过完成交接的通用转场；不依赖构图里有合适元素，哪儿都能用
cards.energy: 中
cards.intention: 转场库已有三族：穿越系（钻进去）、藏切系（遮住切）、体块系（页面是 实体）。本卡是第四族**几何擦除系**——新旧页都不动，一条几何边界扫过 完成交接，擦除的形状即语义：条扫是"百叶窗逐叶翻面换页"。与 shot-transitions C 式穿窗（元素遮罩擦除）的区别：C 用页面内真实元素当遮罩 （依赖构图），本卡是纯几何形——通用性即定位。适合横向推进、翻页语义。

styles.label: blinds-slice
styles.description: 几何擦除转场——blinds-slice 百叶窗切条（12 根 3D 叶片错峰翻面成波，波扫过后整页由 A 换成 B）
styles.use: 翻页/推进语义；横向阅读动线页面
styles.descriptionEn: Twelve vertical slats flip in a staggered wave — the old page collapsing at one edge as the new one expands from the other, a bright seam riding the wave.

cards.summaryEn: A geometric wipe: twelve staggered vertical blinds flipping in a wave.
cards.useEn: The universal transition where both old and new pages stay still and one geometric boundary sweeps across to complete the handover; doesn't depend on suitable elements in the composition — usable anywhere
cards.intentionEn: The transition library already had three families: travel (boring in), hidden cut (cover and cut), solid body (the page is an object). This card is the fourth family, geometric wipe — both old and new pages stay still, one geometric boundary sweeps across to complete the handover, and the shape of the wipe is the semantics: the bar sweep is "venetian blinds flipping leaf by leaf for the page change". The difference from shot-transitions style C's through-the-window (element-mask wipe): C uses a real element inside the page as the mask (dependent on composition); this card is pure geometry — universality is its positioning. Suited to horizontal advances, page-turning semantics.
cards.energyEn: Medium

cards.name: word-relay-filmstrip
cards.summary: 左列黑白相间等高页面卡步进滚动（焦点卡全亮、邻卡离焦压暗）、右侧衬线大词原位接力（名词恒定+动词轮换）——切词瞬间才滚动一格，词块垂直中心与当前页面卡中点精确对齐
cards.use: "一个主体 × 多种能力"的枚举段（Motion Studio frames/builds/ships…）；作品集/案例流展示；产品多场景巡礼
cards.energy: 中低（编辑部气质，节奏靠切词的"咔哒"感）
cards.intention: 左边是证据（页面截图胶片），右边是论点（大词）：动词换一次， 胶片就步进一格给出新证据——文字与画面互为注脚。命门是**步进制**： 左列平时完全静止，只在切词瞬间滚动一格（滚动=换证据的机械动作）， 持续滚动会让左列沦为背景装饰、切词失去"咔哒"感。第二命门是 **对齐**：大词块垂直中心必须与当前页面卡中点精确对齐（像素级）， 歪了整个版式的"编辑部严谨感"就塌了。

styles.label: word-relay-filmstrip
styles.description: 左列黑白相间等高页面卡步进滚动（焦点卡全亮、邻卡离焦压暗）、右侧衬线大词原位接力（名词恒定+动词轮换）——切词瞬间才滚动一格，词块垂直中心与当前页面卡中点精确对齐
styles.descriptionEn: A filmstrip of page cards steps vertically while a serif word relay swaps only its verb, each swap aligned to the center of the current card.

cards.summaryEn: A filmstrip of page cards steps vertically while a serif word relay swaps only its verb, each swap aligned to the center of the current card.
cards.useEn: Enumeration passages for "one subject × many capabilities" (Motion Studio frames/builds/ships…); portfolio / case-flow showcases; product multi-scene tours
cards.intentionEn: The left is evidence (a filmstrip of page screenshots), the right is the argument (the big word): the verb swaps once, the filmstrip steps one frame to give new evidence — text and image glossing each other. The make-or-break is the step mechanism: the left column is completely still normally, scrolling exactly one frame only at the instant of the word swap (the scroll = the mechanical action of changing evidence); continuous scrolling would reduce the left column to background decoration and strip the word swap of its "click". The second make-or-break is alignment: the big word block's vertical centre must align exactly (pixel-level) with the current page card's centre — tilt it and the whole layout's "editorial rigour" collapses.
cards.energyEn: Medium-low (editorial temperament; the rhythm rides on the word swap's "click")

cards.name: word-relay-geometry
cards.summary: 三个利益词各带一套专属几何接力——虚线大圆减速自转 + 彗星弧飞跑 → 三实线圆 trim 依次生长后收拢咬紧 → 镀铬金属 sheen 扫过后一拍收成纯白；旧词缩到 0.86 淡出，新词描边→填充揭示
cards.use: 三点式利益陈述（更快/更好/更强）；品牌价值观段落；需要"一词一世界"的中段推进
cards.energy: 中高（三拍推进 + 全程几何运动 + 背景粒子，无静止帧）
cards.intention: 三点式利益陈述最容易做成三张字卡硬切。接力的做法是给每个词配一套 **只属于它的几何**：虚线圆是"在转"（快）、三圆相扣并收拢是"互相咬合"（紧 / 好）、 金属扫光是"材质硬"（强）——几何本身就在替形容词做论证。第三个词 留了升格待遇（sheen 扫光 + 收白），因为它是结论。背景微尘、共用舞台光与底部 三段进度条把三拍缝成一个连续空间，不然还是三张卡。

styles.label: word-relay-geometry
styles.description: 三个利益词各带一套专属几何接力——虚线大圆减速自转 + 彗星弧飞跑 → 三实线圆 trim 依次生长后收拢咬紧 → 镀铬金属 sheen 扫过后一拍收成纯白；旧词缩到 0.86 淡出，新词描边→填充揭示
styles.descriptionEn: Three benefit words hand off in turn, each with its own geometry — a spinning dashed circle, three interlocking circles that trim into view, and a metallic sheen that resolves to pure white.

cards.summaryEn: Three benefit words hand off in turn, each with its own geometry — a spinning dashed circle, three interlocking circles that trim into view, and a metallic sheen that resolves to pure white.
cards.useEn: Three-point benefit statements (faster / better / stronger); brand-values passages; mid-film advancement that needs "one word, one world"
cards.intentionEn: The easiest way to botch a three-point benefit statement is three word cards hard-cut. The relay approach gives each word a geometry that belongs to it alone: the dashed circle is "spinning" (fast), three interlocking circles drawing together are "meshing" (tight / better), the metal sheen is "hard material" (strong) — the geometry itself argues for the adjective. The third word gets the promotion treatment (sheen sweep + closing white) because it is the conclusion. The background dust, the shared stage light and the three-segment progress bar at the bottom sew the three beats into one continuous space; without them it is still three cards.
cards.energyEn: Medium-high (three-beat advancement + geometry in motion throughout + background particles; no still frames)
